actions.description: Send or approve IMU
actions.how: IMU token transfer(to, amount) / approve(spender, amount) on Ethereum, 18 decimals

actions.name: pay-bounty
actions.description: A project pays a whitehat for a report on Immunefi
actions.how: approve each ERC-20 to the Splitter, then Splitter.payWhitehat(referenceId, whitehat, [(token, amount)], nativeAmount, gas, feeBps) with msg.value = native amount + native fee; normally done from the Immunefi dashboard

actions.name: pledge-imu
actions.description: Back a security researcher with IMU (Hacker Pledging)
actions.how: Only through the immunefi.com/hacker-pledging web app with a connected wallet; no official contract address published

risks: IMU is an upgradeable proxy (EIP-1967; implementation 0x39eacef0ee562109df742c989e9d5227d4c17d2e, proxy admin 0xb91d57d8f7bd2898f1251239e5816d2de45db228 at research time) with MINTER_ROLE, PAUSER_ROLE and DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE: role holders can mint, pause transfers and upgrade the logic.
Token unlocks: early backers (16%) unlock over three years and team (26.5%) over 36 months; 47.5% ecosystem/community and 10% reserve are released on a schedule the Foundation updates quarterly.
The splitter contracts are owned by Immunefi (owner 0x23261Bb09D0857E9788a2B9A9cEb9dD487268219), which can change the fee recipient and, on the older one, the fee (up to maxFee 15%).
Bounty outcomes, mediation and pledging rewards are decided off chain by Immunefi; on-chain contracts only move funds.
notes: IMU address comes from the Immunefi Foundation docs (token-claiming page). Checked on Ethereum: name Immunefi, symbol IMU, 18 decimals, total supply 10,000,000,000. The two splitter addresses come from Immunefi's own bug bounty program scope (assets labelled 'Vault' and 'Splitter'). Their ABIs (verified on Sourcify) are both reward splitters. Left out: (1) the newer Safe-based Vaults System (Immunefi Guard/Module, RewardSystem, Arbitration; code at https://github.com/immunefi-team/vaults). No official deployment addresses are published, and each project's vault is its own Safe. Immunefi's own bounty vault is 0xf4a8714f6ca5Bf232F10b308C693448738be0661 per its program page, but it is project-specific. (2) Hacker Pledging. No contract address appears on the official pledging page; the addresses on it are pledgers' wallets. (3) A public bounties API: none confirmed from an official source. DefiLlama lists only Ethereum; no other official IMU deployments found.

name: Inverse Finance
description: DAO behind the DOLA stablecoin and FiRM, a fixed-rate CDP on Ethereum: deposit collateral into a per-collateral market, borrow DOLA, and pay interest by holding DBR (burned at 1 DBR per DOLA borrowed per year). Agents can also stake DOLA as sDOLA, INV as sINV, or provide first-loss cover with jrDOLA.

keyFunctions.description: DOLA balance (18 decimals).
Approve a FiRM market (to repay), sDOLA (to deposit) or another spender.
Transfer DOLA.
Spendable DBR (18 decimals) after subtracting what open FiRM debt has consumed (1 DBR per 1 DOLA of debt per year, accrued per second). Returns 0 when in deficit.
DBR owed beyond the balance. If > 0 the user cannot borrow more or withdraw collateral, and anyone can forceReplenish them (adding DOLA debt at the replenishment price, ~54.75% APR per the docs).
Balance minus accrued burn as a signed int (negative = deficit).
User's total DOLA debt across all FiRM markets (drives the DBR burn rate).
DOLA charged per DBR on forced replenishment, in bps of 1 DOLA.
Transfer DBR (e.g. top up a borrower's wallet). DBR is bought on the DBR auction (inverse.finance/dbr/auction) or on DEXs such as the Curve triDBR pool.
Deposit DOLA (approve sDOLA first): (assets, receiver). Returns shares. DOLA is staked in the DOLA Savings Account.
Mint an exact number of shares: (shares, receiver).
Burn shares for DOLA: (shares, receiver, owner). Instant, no queue. Reverts if it would leave fewer than MIN_SHARES (1e18) or less than 0.01 DOLA in the vault.
Withdraw an exact DOLA amount: (assets, receiver, owner).
DOLA per given shares (exchange rate; rises as DBR revenue is sold for DOLA).
Shares for a DOLA amount.
Exact DOLA a redeem would return now.
Max DOLA withdrawable by owner.
DOLA backing the vault, excluding revenue not yet streamed (each week's revenue is released linearly over the following week).

Buy DBR from the vault's virtual xy=k auction: (exactDolaIn, exactDbrOut, to). The contract warns not to call this directly from a UI because the price moves every second; compute exact amounts with getDolaReserve()/getDbrReserve() in the same transaction or use a helper contract.
Deposit INV (approve sINV first): (assets, receiver). Note: INV in sINV loses on-chain governance voting rights.
Burn sINV for INV: (shares, receiver, owner). No waiting period per the docs.
INV per given sINV.
INV backing the vault.

contracts.name: jrDOLA v2 (Junior DOLA, first-loss ERC-4626 vault)

keyFunctions.description: Returns sDOLA (0xb45a...7305): jrDOLA holds sDOLA, not DOLA. Check before depositing.
sDOLA per given jrDOLA.
sDOLA held by the vault.
jrDOLA balance (18 decimals).
INV balance (18 decimals).
Delegate INV voting power (Compound-style; votes count only once delegated).
Votes of an account at a past block.
Deposit collateral (approve the market for the collateral token first; amount in the collateral's decimals). Collateral goes to your personal escrow contract, created on first deposit.
Deposit collateral into another user's escrow: (user, amount). Tokens are pulled from msg.sender.
Deposit collateral and borrow DOLA in one call: (amountDeposit, amountBorrow in DOLA, 18 decimals). You must hold enough DBR first (see borrow).

Borrow DOLA (18 decimals) to msg.sender. Requires: no DBR deficit (DBR.deficitOf == 0), debt <= getCreditLimit, borrows not paused, market daily limit and minimum debt in BorrowController, fresh oracle price, and msg.sender == tx.origin unless the calling contract is allowlisted. While debt is open, DBR in your wallet is burned at 1 DBR per 1 DOLA of debt per year - that is the interest. Hold enough DBR for the planned loan duration.
Repay DOLA debt for a user: (user, amount). Approve DOLA to the market first. Pass 2^256-1 to repay the full debt. Repaying stops further DBR burn on that amount.
Repay your own DOLA debt and withdraw collateral in one call: (repayAmount, withdrawAmount).
Withdraw collateral from your escrow to msg.sender. Fails if it exceeds getWithdrawalLimit or if you have a DBR deficit.
Withdraw the maximum allowed collateral. Only on newer markets (not present on the WETH, sUSDe, CRV and cvxCRV markets); dangerous with open debt.
Max DOLA a user can owe given collateral value x collateralFactorBps (uses the pessimistic view price).
Collateral (token units) the user can withdraw without exceeding the credit limit.
User's collateral value in DOLA (18 decimals).
User's DOLA debt in this market.
Deterministic escrow address of a user (do not send collateral there directly; use deposit).
True if new borrows are paused for this market (e.g. the INV market).
Collateral token accepted by this market.
Collateral factor in basis points (e.g. 8500 = 85%).
Liquidate an underwater user: (user, repaidDebt in DOLA, approve DOLA first). Max repaid = debt x liquidationFactorBps; you receive collateral worth repaidDebt plus liquidationIncentiveBps.

For a user with a DBR deficit: (user, DBR amount <= deficit). Buys the missing DBR for them at the replenishment price, adding DOLA debt; caller earns replenishmentIncentiveBps. forceReplenishAll(address) does the full deficit.

contracts.name: FiRM Stake DAO sDOLA-scrvUSD LP Market
FiRM Stake DAO reUSD-sDOLA LP Market

keyFunctions.description: Max DOLA borrowable per UTC day from a market (0 = no limit).
DOLA already borrowed from a market on a day: (market, block.timestamp / 86400).
Minimum debt a borrower must keep in a market.
True if a smart contract may borrow; contracts not on the list are denied (EOAs always pass this check).

(collateralToken, collateralFactorBps) -> DOLA price of 1 whole collateral token scaled by 10^(36 - tokenDecimals) (1e18 for an 18-decimal token). Pessimistic: if the lower of today's and yesterday's daily low implies less borrowing power than spot, it returns a dampened price below spot. Passing collateralFactorBps = 0 returns the plain Chainlink-based price.

contracts.name: DBR Distributor (DBR rewards for INV deposited in FiRM)

keyFunctions.description: DBR claimable by an INV escrow (pass the user's INV-market escrow address from Market.escrows(user), not the wallet). The user claims by calling claimDBR() on their own escrow.

contracts.name: FiRM Fed (mints DOLA supply into FiRM)

actions.name: borrow-dola
actions.description: Open a fixed-rate DOLA loan on FiRM
actions.how: 1) Get DBR >= expected debt x years (DBR auction at inverse.finance/dbr/auction or Curve triDBR). 2) collateral.approve(market, amt). 3) market.depositAndBorrow(amt, dolaAmount) or deposit() then borrow(). Check market.getCreditLimit(you), market.borrowPaused(), BorrowController.dailyLimits/minDebts first. Must be sent by an EOA unless your contract is allowlisted.

actions.name: repay-and-withdraw
actions.description: Close or reduce a FiRM loan
actions.how: DOLA.approve(market, amt); market.repay(you, amt) (2^256-1 = all) then market.withdraw(collateralAmt), or market.repayAndWithdraw(repay, withdraw). Make sure DBR.deficitOf(you) == 0 or withdraw reverts.

actions.name: monitor-position
actions.description: Check a FiRM position
actions.how: market.debts(you), market.getCreditLimit(you), market.getWithdrawalLimit(you); DBR.balanceOf(you) / DBR.debts(you) = years of DBR left; DBR.deficitOf(you) must stay 0.

actions.name: stake-dola
actions.description: Earn yield on DOLA with sDOLA
actions.how: DOLA.approve(sDOLA, amt); sDOLA.deposit(amt, receiver). Exit any time with sDOLA.redeem(shares, receiver, owner).

actions.name: stake-inv
actions.description: Stake INV into sINV
actions.how: INV.approve(sINV, amt); sINV.deposit(amt, receiver); exit with sINV.redeem(shares, receiver, owner). sINV holders do not vote on-chain.

actions.name: liquidate-or-replenish
actions.description: Keeper actions
actions.how: If market.debts(u) > market.getCreditLimit(u): DOLA.approve(market) then market.liquidate(u, repaid). If DBR.deficitOf(u) > 0: market.forceReplenish(u, amount) (or forceReplenishAll(u)) to earn the replenishment incentive.

risks: DBR is consumed continuously while debt is open; if it runs out, the position goes into deficit, cannot withdraw or borrow, and anyone can force-replenish it at a penalty rate (54.75% APR per docs) that is added to DOLA debt, which can lead to liquidation.

FiRM uses a pessimistic oracle (lowest recent ~48h price) so borrowing power lags price rises; borrows are also denied when the Chainlink feed is stale, when the market's daily borrow limit is hit, or below the minimum debt.
Smart contracts (including smart wallets) can only borrow if allowlisted in the BorrowController; EOAs are always allowed.

The INV market has new borrows paused (mill 389). Nine markets were sunset by mill 395 (2026-08-03): borrows paused and Fed ceiling zero; existing borrowers can still repay and withdraw (addresses on the docs page).
Governance (Governor Mills / INV holders) sets collateral factors, limits and oracles; guardian multisigs can pause markets and cancel proposals but not unpause.
DOLA peg risk: DOLA supply is managed by Feds (FiRM Fed, PSM Fed and others); sDOLA and jrDOLA values depend on DOLA holding $1.
jrDOLA is a first-loss tranche: deposits can be slashed to cover FiRM bad debt, withdrawals are time-delayed, and governance can pause withdrawals for up to 90 days (mill 390).
Cross-chain sDOLA (mill 396, 2026-08-11) and sINV (mill 393, 2026-07-21) CCIP lanes are shut down; L2 copies are historical and not bridge destinations.
Past incident (2 Apr 2022): oracle manipulation of the INV price on the legacy Anchor/Frontier money market let an attacker borrow ~$15.6M.

Past incident (16 Jun 2022): flash-loan manipulation of the yvCrv3Crypto LP price on Frontier caused ~$5.8M of bad debt (attacker profit ~$1.2M). Frontier borrowing is paused; FiRM replaced it with isolated escrows and the pessimistic oracle.
notes: All addresses are from the official docs Smart Contracts page (active markets as of October 2026) and were confirmed on-chain on 2026-11-25: each market's collateral(), oracle(), borrowController() and dbr() match the docs, sDOLA.asset() = DOLA, sINV.asset() = INV, jrDOLA.asset() = sDOLA. Market keyFunctions are listed once on the WETH market and come from InverseFinance/FiRM src/Market.sol; all 19 active markets share that interface (selectors checked in bytecode), except withdrawMax() which only exists on newer markets. sDOLA functions come from InverseFinance/dola-savings src/sDola.sol. Left out: the nine sunset FiRM markets (repay/withdraw only, listed on the docs page), historical L2 sDOLA/sINV deployments (CCIP lanes closed), the PSM and PSM Fed (docs list them on the PSM page, but I did not review the PSM source for its function signatures), the DBR auction, ALE/helper contracts and the legacy Frontier contracts, whose addresses are not on the official contracts page. jrDOLA's queued-withdrawal functions are not listed because I could not find its verified source in the official GitHub; use the inverse.finance app or check the verified source before redeeming. DefiLlama tracks FiRM separately as inverse-finance-firm.

name: Jupiter Aggregator
description: Solana's main swap aggregator. An agent asks Jupiter's Swap API for a quote and a ready-to-sign transaction (GET https://api.jup.ag/swap/v2/order with taker), signs it with the user's key and either POSTs it to /swap/v2/execute (Jupiter lands it) or, for custom transactions, gets raw instructions from /swap/v2/build and sends them itself. On-chain the swap runs through the Jupiter Aggregator v6 program.

keyFunctions.signature: route(route_plan: Vec<RoutePlanStep>, in_amount: u64, quoted_out_amount: u64, slippage_bps: u16, platform_fee_bps: u8)
keyFunctions.description: ExactIn swap along route_plan (each step: swap variant + percent + input/output index). Fails if output < quoted_out_amount reduced by slippage_bps. Built by the Swap API (/swap/v1/swap or /swap/v2/build); do not hand-encode the route plan or the per-DEX remaining accounts.

keyFunctions.signature: shared_accounts_route(id: u8, route_plan: Vec<RoutePlanStep>, in_amount: u64, quoted_out_amount: u64, slippage_bps: u16, platform_fee_bps: u8)
keyFunctions.description: Same as route but uses Jupiter's shared program-owned intermediate token accounts (id selects the program authority), so the user needs no intermediate ATAs.

keyFunctions.signature: exact_out_route(route_plan: Vec<RoutePlanStep>, out_amount: u64, quoted_in_amount: u64, slippage_bps: u16, platform_fee_bps: u8)
keyFunctions.description: ExactOut swap: receive exactly out_amount, spending at most quoted_in_amount plus slippage. Only via Swap API V1 /quote?swapMode=ExactOut (V2 /order supports ExactIn only).

keyFunctions.signature: shared_accounts_exact_out_route(id: u8, route_plan: Vec<RoutePlanStep>, out_amount: u64, quoted_in_amount: u64, slippage_bps: u16, platform_fee_bps: u8)
keyFunctions.description: ExactOut variant using shared accounts.

keyFunctions.signature: route_with_token_ledger(route_plan: Vec<RoutePlanStep>, quoted_out_amount: u64, slippage_bps: u16, platform_fee_bps: u8) / shared_accounts_route_with_token_ledger(id: u8, ...)
keyFunctions.description: Swap the amount recorded by a prior set_token_ledger instruction in the same tx (input = balance change), for composing after another instruction whose output amount is unknown in advance.

keyFunctions.signature: route_v2(in_amount: u64, quoted_out_amount: u64, slippage_bps: u16, platform_fee_bps: u16, positive_slippage_bps: u16, route_plan: Vec<RoutePlanStepV2>)
keyFunctions.description: Newer route instruction in the on-chain IDL (u16 platform fee, positive-slippage capture). Variants: shared_accounts_route_v2(id, ...), exact_out_route_v2(out_amount, quoted_in_amount, ...), shared_accounts_exact_out_route_v2. Emitted by current API versions; use the API output as-is.

keyFunctions.signature: route_with_attestation(in_amount: u64, quoted_out_amount: u64, slippage_bps: u16, platform_fee_bps: u16, positive_slippage_bps: u16, route_plan: Vec<RoutePlanStepV2>, attestation: [u8; 74])
keyFunctions.description: Route variant carrying a 74-byte attestation (also shared_accounts_route_with_attestation). Present in the on-chain IDL; used by Jupiter's own routing (e.g. RFQ fills inside Metis routes). Not meant to be built by hand.
Record a token account balance in a token ledger account before *_with_token_ledger routes.
Helper instructions the API adds for wrapping/unwrapping SOL and creating token accounts.
JUP is a classic SPL token with 6 decimals; mint authority and freeze authority are both null (checked on-chain 2026-11-25). Move it with the SPL Token program between associated token accounts.
Read supply and decimals (6).

offchainApis.name: Swap API V2: GET /order (Meta-Aggregator quote + transaction)
offchainApis.use: Recommended path. Query: inputMint, outputMint, amount (input base units, e.g. lamports; ExactIn only), taker (wallet that signs; omit for a quote only, then transaction is null). Optional: slippageBps (0-10000; omit to let Jupiter's RTSE choose), receiver (different wallet to receive output), referralAccount + referralFee (50-255 bps), payer (integrator pays gas; disables Dflow/OKX), priorityFeeLamports, jitoTipLamports, broadcastFeeType (maxCap|exactFee), excludeRouters (metis,jupiterz,dflow,okx), excludeDexes (Metis only), maxSupportedTransactionVersion ('0'|'1'). Response: transaction (base64 unsigned versioned tx), requestId, inAmount, outAmount, otherAmountThreshold, slippageBps, priceImpactPct, routePlan, router, feeBps, feeMint, gasless, errorCode/errorMessage. Keyless works at 0.5 RPS; send x-api-key for higher limits. SOL is wrapped/unwrapped automatically; use mint So11111111111111111111111111111111111111112 for SOL.

offchainApis.name: Swap API V2: POST /execute (managed landing)
offchainApis.use: Body JSON {signedTransaction: base64 of the /order transaction after the taker signs it, requestId: from /order, lastValidBlockHeight?}. Jupiter lands the tx (priority fee set for you, polls confirmation). Response: status (Success|Failed), signature, code, totalInputAmount, totalOutputAmount, inputAmountResult, outputAmountResult, error. Separate rate-limit bucket (keyless 20 RPS, free 50, paid 100). Do not modify the /order transaction before signing (JupiterZ RFQ transactions cannot be modified).

offchainApis.name: Swap API V2: GET /build (Router path, raw instructions)
offchainApis.use: For custom transactions / CPI. Query: inputMint, outputMint, amount, taker (all required); slippageBps (default 50, or 'rtse'), mode=fast, dexes / excludeDexes, platformFeeBps + feeAccount, maxAccounts (default 64), maxBytes, payer, wrapAndUnwrapSol (default true), destinationTokenAccount / nativeDestinationAccount, blockhashSlotsToExpiry (default 150), tipAmount (for tx.jup.ag), computeUnitPricePercentile (medium|high|veryHigh|0-10000), forJitoBundle, transactionVersion ('0'|'1'). Returns quote plus computeBudgetInstructions, setupInstructions, swapInstruction, cleanupInstruction, otherInstructions, tipInstruction and addressesByLookupTableAddress; you assemble a v0 tx, sign, and send via your own RPC or tx.jup.ag. Metis routing only, no Jupiter swap fee.

offchainApis.name: Swap API V1 (Metis): GET /quote, POST /swap, POST /swap-instructions
offchainApis.use: Older two-step flow, still documented and live but superseded by V2. GET /quote?inputMint&outputMint&amount&slippageBps (default 50)&swapMode (ExactIn|ExactOut)&dexes&excludeDexes&restrictIntermediateTokens&onlyDirectRoutes&maxAccounts&platformFeeBps -> quoteResponse. POST /swap {quoteResponse, userPublicKey, wrapAndUnwrapSol (default true), dynamicComputeUnitLimit, prioritizationFeeLamports ({priorityLevelWithMaxLamports:{priorityLevel:'veryHigh',maxLamports:N}} or {jitoTipLamports:N}), feeAccount, destinationTokenAccount, payer} -> {swapTransaction (base64 versioned tx), lastValidBlockHeight, prioritizationFeeLamports}; deserialize, sign, send via your RPC. POST /swap-instructions takes the same body and returns the instructions separately. Use V1 only if you need ExactOut.

offchainApis.name: Program ID to Label
offchainApis.use: Map of DEX program ids to labels (for dexes/excludeDexes and for identifying the failing program in a swap error).

offchainApis.name: Transaction submission (tx.jup.ag)
offchainApis.use: Send-only Solana RPC-compatible endpoint (sendTransaction) that lands any signed transaction through Jupiter's landing infrastructure; requires x-api-key and a SOL tip (min 0.001 SOL; /build tipAmount adds it). Not needed for /order + /execute.

offchainApis.name: Tokens API V2
offchainApis.use: GET ?query=<symbol|name|mint> resolves a ticker to mints with isVerified, organicScore, audit flags (mint/freeze authority, isSus), decimals, tokenProgram, liquidity. Use it to pick the right mint and screen out fakes before swapping.

offchainApis.name: Price API V3
offchainApis.use: GET ?ids=<comma-separated mints, max 50> -> usdPrice, decimals, priceChange24h, liquidity. Tokens without a reliable price are omitted.

offchainApis.name: API keys and plans (Developer Platform)
offchainApis.use: Create an API key (format jup_...) and pass it as the x-api-key header on api.jup.ag. Tiers: Keyless 0.5 RPS (no sign-up), Free 1 RPS, Developer $25/mo 10 RPS, Launch $100/mo 50 RPS, Pro $500/mo 150 RPS; limits per organisation, 60 s sliding window. The old free host lite-api.jup.ag is being phased out in favour of keyless api.jup.ag; ultra-api.jup.ag (Ultra) moved to api.jup.ag/swap/v2 with identical /order and /execute.

actions.name: swap (recommended)
actions.description: Swap an exact input amount of one Solana token for another at the best price
actions.how: 1) GET https://api.jup.ag/swap/v2/order?inputMint=..&outputMint=..&amount=<base units>&taker=<wallet> (optional slippageBps). 2) Check outAmount, priceImpactPct, feeBps and that transaction is non-empty (else read errorMessage). 3) base64-decode transaction to a VersionedTransaction, sign with the taker key (do not alter it). 4) POST https://api.jup.ag/swap/v2/execute {signedTransaction: base64, requestId}. 5) Check status == 'Success' and signature.

actions.name: quote only
actions.description: Get a price quote without a wallet
actions.how: GET /swap/v2/order without taker; read outAmount, priceImpactPct, routePlan, router.

actions.name: custom swap transaction
actions.description: Compose the swap with your own instructions or CPI
actions.how: GET /swap/v2/build?inputMint&outputMint&amount&taker&slippageBps; build a v0 message from computeBudgetInstructions + setupInstructions + swapInstruction + cleanupInstruction + otherInstructions with the returned address lookup tables and a fresh blockhash; sign and send via your RPC (or tx.jup.ag with tipAmount). The swapInstruction targets program JUP6LkbZbjS1jKKwapdHNy74zcZ3tLUZoi5QNyVTaV4.

actions.name: legacy swap (V1)
actions.description: Quote + swap returning a serialized transaction
actions.how: GET https://api.jup.ag/swap/v1/quote?inputMint&outputMint&amount&slippageBps=50, then POST /swap/v1/swap {quoteResponse, userPublicKey, wrapAndUnwrapSol: true, dynamicComputeUnitLimit: true, prioritizationFeeLamports: {priorityLevelWithMaxLamports: {priorityLevel: 'veryHigh', maxLamports: 1000000}}}; deserialize swapTransaction (base64 VersionedTransaction), sign, sendRawTransaction via your RPC and confirm before lastValidBlockHeight.

actions.name: resolve token
actions.description: Find the correct mint for a ticker
actions.how: GET https://api.jup.ag/tokens/v2/search?query=<ticker>; prefer isVerified tokens with high organicScore and liquidity; confirm the mint with the user.

risks: Scam and copycat tokens: anyone can create a token with any name/symbol; always swap by mint address, check isVerified / organicScore / audit flags from the Tokens API, and confirm with the user.

Slippage and price impact: quotes move quickly; set slippageBps deliberately for illiquid tokens (or let RTSE choose on /order), check priceImpactPct and otherAmountThreshold, and get a fresh order right before signing. Transactions expire with the blockhash (~150 slots, about 1 minute).

Routes can go through many third-party DEX programs; a failure or exploit in one pool affects that swap. Jupiter's listing rules decide which markets are routable (new markets get short instant-routing grace periods).

API dependency: keyless access is limited to 0.5 RPS (429 above it, per organisation, 60 s sliding window); production needs an x-api-key. lite-api.jup.ag is being retired and ultra-api.jup.ag replaced by api.jup.ag/swap/v2.
Fees: /order charges a Jupiter platform fee by pair (0 bps on pegged/Jupiter tokens up to about 10 bps on most pairs; shown in feeBps/feeMint); /build has no Jupiter fee.

Never sign a transaction returned by a non-official host; Jupiter's APIs live on api.jup.ag (and tx.jup.ag for submission). Verify that the transaction's swap instruction targets the Jupiter v6 program.
Jupiter programs are upgradeable by Jupiter; the IDL has gained new route instructions (route_v2, *_with_attestation) over time, so build from current API output rather than a cached IDL.
notes: DefiLlama slug 'jupiter-aggregator' (parent 'jupiter'; siblings include Jupiter Perpetual Exchange, Jupiter Lend, Jupiter DCA/Limit, Jupiter Staked SOL, JupUSD). Program id JUP6LkbZbjS1jKKwapdHNy74zcZ3tLUZoi5QNyVTaV4 is named as 'the Jupiter v6 swap aggregator program' on Jupiter's dev docs (RFQ v2 streaming page) and declared in jup-ag/jupiter-cpi (src/lib.rs); confirmed executable on mainnet (BPF upgradeable). Instruction names and args come from the program's on-chain Anchor IDL (fetched 2026-11-25); the older IDL in jup-ag/jupiter-cpi lacks the v2/attestation variants. Related Jupiter products (not separate contracts here): Jupiter Lend program ids from developers.jup.ag/docs/lend/architecture: Liquidity jupeiUmn818Jg1ekPURTpr4mFo29p46vygyykFJ3wZC, Lending/Earn jup3YeL8QhtSx1e253b2FDvsMNC87fDrgQZivbrndc9, Vaults/Borrow jupr81YtYssSyPt8jbnGuiWon5f6x9TcDEFxYe3Bdzi (plus Earn Rewards jup7TthsMgcR9Y3L277b8Eo9uboVSmu1utkuXHNUKar and Borrow Oracle jupnw4B6Eqs7ft6rxpzYLJZYSnrpRgPcr589n5Kv4oc per developers.jup.ag/docs/jupusd/juiced); Lend Earn API at api.jup.ag/lend/v1/earn/*. Jupiter Perps: the dev docs (developers.jup.ag/docs/perps/*) say the Perps API is a work in progress and only link to the Perpetuals program on Solscan (PERPHjGBqRHArX4DySjwM6UJHiR3sWAatqfdBS2qQJu, executable on mainnet) and the single JLP Pool account 5BUwFW4nRbftYTDMbgxykoFWqWHPzahFSNAaaaJtVKsq without a plain statement of the id, so Perps is not listed as a contract. JLP mint left out: no official Jupiter page found that states the JLP mint address (only third-party sites). The Ultra Swap API is not a separate product any more: Jupiter's docs say Ultra users move to /swap/v2/order + /execute with identical parameters. Other Jupiter APIs (Trigger limit orders/DCA, Recurring, Prediction, Studio, Lock) are documented at developers.jup.ag/docs; Jupiter also runs a hosted Trading MCP at https://mcp.jup.ag.

name: Kittenswap Finance
description: ve(3,3) concentrated-liquidity DEX built on Algebra Integral, live on HyperEVM (full stack: swaps, LP NFTs, farming, KITTEN/veKITTEN voting) and Robinhood Chain (swaps and LP only). Agents can quote and swap through the SwapRouter/QuoterV2, open and manage LP positions via the NonfungiblePositionManager, farm positions, and lock KITTEN for veKITTEN.

keyFunctions.description: Single-pool exact-input swap. Tuple: (tokenIn, tokenOut, deployer, recipient, deadline, amountIn, amountOutMinimum, limitSqrtPrice). deployer = 0x000...0 for standard pools (non-zero only for custom-deployer pools); limitSqrtPrice = 0 for no limit. Approve tokenIn to the router first. Payable: to swap native gas token, send it as msg.value with tokenIn = WHYPE 0x5555555555555555555555555555555555555555. Returns amountOut.

Multi-hop exact-input swap. Tuple: (path, recipient, deadline, amountIn, amountOutMinimum). Algebra Integral path encoding: tokenIn(20 bytes) + deployer(20 bytes) + token(20 bytes) [+ deployer + token ...]; no fee field. Returns amountOut.

Single-pool exact-output swap. Tuple: (tokenIn, tokenOut, deployer, recipient, deadline, amountOut, amountInMaximum, limitSqrtPrice). Returns amountIn. When paying with native token, add refundNativeToken() in a multicall.
Multi-hop exact-output swap: (path in REVERSE order, recipient, deadline, amountOut, amountInMaximum). Returns amountIn.
Same tuple as exactInputSingle, for fee-on-transfer tokens.
Batch router calls, e.g. swap to the router (recipient = router address) then unwrapWNativeToken to receive the native token.
Unwrap the router's WHYPE 0x5555555555555555555555555555555555555555 balance to native and send to recipient. Args (amountMinimum, recipient). Use inside multicall.
Return any leftover native token held by the router to msg.sender (use after exact-output swaps paid in native).
Wrapped native token address (WHYPE 0x5555555555555555555555555555555555555555).

Quote (call with eth_call, it is not a view function). Tuple: (tokenIn, tokenOut, deployer, amountIn, limitSqrtPrice). Returns (amountOut, amountIn, sqrtPriceX96After, initializedTicksCrossed, gasEstimate, fee).
Multi-hop quote via eth_call: (path, amountIn). Returns (amountOutList[], amountInList[], sqrtPriceX96AfterList[], initializedTicksCrossedList[], gasEstimate, feeList[]).
Exact-output quote via eth_call. Tuple: (tokenIn, tokenOut, deployer, amount, limitSqrtPrice).
Multi-hop exact-output quote via eth_call; path in reverse order.

Open a concentrated-liquidity position NFT. Tuple: (token0, token1, deployer, tickLower, tickUpper, amount0Desired, amount1Desired, amount0Min, amount1Min, recipient, deadline). token0 < token1 by address; ticks must be multiples of the pool tickSpacing. Approve both tokens first. Returns (tokenId, liquidity, amount0, amount1).
Add to a position: (tokenId, amount0Desired, amount1Desired, amount0Min, amount1Min, deadline). Returns (liquidity, amount0, amount1).
Remove liquidity: (tokenId, liquidity, amount0Min, amount1Min, deadline). Tokens are only credited to the position; call collect() to receive them.
Withdraw owed tokens and fees: (tokenId, recipient, amount0Max, amount1Max); use 2^128-1 for all. Returns (amount0, amount1).
Burn an empty position NFT (liquidity and owed tokens must be 0).
Position data: (nonce, operator, token0, token1, deployer, tickLower, tickUpper, liquidity, feeGrowthInside0LastX128, feeGrowthInside1LastX128, tokensOwed0, tokensOwed1).
Create and initialize a pool: (token0, token1, deployer, sqrtPriceX96, data). Returns pool address.
Batch calls (e.g. decreaseLiquidity + collect, or mint with native token + refundNativeToken).
Number of position NFTs owned.
Enumerate an owner's position tokenIds.
Approve a position for farming: (tokenId, approve, farmingAddress = FarmingCenter). Required before FarmingCenter.enterFarming.
Standard pool address for a token pair (either order); zero address if none. One pool per pair (dynamic fee).
Pool created by a custom deployer: (customDeployer, tokenA, tokenB).
Deterministic standard pool address for (token0, token1).
AlgebraPoolDeployer address.

Stake a position NFT in an eternal-farming incentive. Args: IncentiveKey (rewardToken, bonusRewardToken, pool, nonce) and tokenId. Call NonfungiblePositionManager.approveForFarming(tokenId, true, FarmingCenter) first.
Leave the incentive (IncentiveKey, tokenId).
Accrue rewards for a farmed position; returns (reward, bonusReward). Then claimReward to receive them.
Send accrued rewards: (rewardToken, to, amountRequested); 0 = all. Returns amount.
Active eternal incentiveId (bytes32) for a tokenId; zero if not farmed.
Pending (reward, bonusReward) for (IncentiveKey, tokenId).
Claimable reward balance for (owner, rewardToken).
KITTEN balance (18 decimals).
Approve KITTEN (e.g. to veKITTEN before create_lock, or to the router).
ERC-20 transfer.
Lock KITTEN for a veKITTEN NFT: (amount, lockDurationSeconds). Docs: min 1 week, max 2 years, weekly increments, linear decay. Approve KITTEN first. Locked KITTEN cannot be withdrawn until expiry.
Same as create_lock but mints the NFT to another address.
Add KITTEN to an existing lock: (tokenId, amount).
Extend a lock: (tokenId, newLockDurationSeconds).
Withdraw KITTEN from an expired lock (tokenId).
Merge lock (from, to).
Lock amount and end time for a tokenId.
Current voting power of a veKITTEN NFT.
Whether the NFT has active votes (may block withdraw/transfer until reset).
Enumerate an owner's veKITTEN tokenIds.

actions.name: quote
actions.description: Get a swap quote
actions.how: eth_call QuoterV2.quoteExactInputSingle((tokenIn, tokenOut, 0x0 deployer, amountIn, 0)) and read amountOut.

actions.name: swap
actions.description: Swap ERC-20 tokens
actions.how: tokenIn.approve(SwapRouter, amountIn); SwapRouter.exactInputSingle((tokenIn, tokenOut, 0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000, recipient, deadline, amountIn, minOut, 0)). Set minOut from the quote minus slippage.

actions.name: swap-native
actions.description: Swap HYPE (HyperEVM) or ETH (Robinhood)
actions.how: exactInputSingle with tokenIn = WNativeToken() and msg.value = amountIn. To receive native: multicall([exactInputSingle(... recipient = router ...), unwrapWNativeToken(minOut, me)]).

actions.name: add-liquidity
actions.description: Open a concentrated-liquidity position
actions.how: Find the pool with AlgebraFactory.poolByPair(a,b); approve both tokens to NonfungiblePositionManager; NPM.mint((token0, token1, 0x0, tickLower, tickUpper, amt0, amt1, min0, min1, me, deadline)).

actions.name: remove-liquidity
actions.description: Close or reduce a position
actions.how: NPM.multicall([decreaseLiquidity((tokenId, liquidity, min0, min1, deadline)), collect((tokenId, me, 2^128-1, 2^128-1))]).

actions.name: farm
actions.description: Farm an LP position (HyperEVM)
actions.how: NPM.approveForFarming(tokenId, true, FarmingCenter); FarmingCenter.enterFarming(incentiveKey, tokenId); later collectRewards + claimReward. Incentive keys are easiest to get from the app.

actions.name: lock
actions.description: Lock KITTEN for veKITTEN (HyperEVM)
actions.how: KITTEN.approve(veKITTEN, amt); veKITTEN.create_lock(amt, durationSeconds) with 1 week <= duration <= 2 years; vote in the app.

risks: Concentrated liquidity: positions out of range earn no fees and suffer impermanent loss; the pool fee is dynamic (Algebra plugin), not a fixed tier.

Upgradeable contracts: KITTEN, veKITTEN, Voter, RebaseReward and Minter are EIP-1967 proxies. Docs say proxy ownership moves to the TimelockController and the delay will rise from 1 minute to 24 hours; at research time getMinDelay() on the timelock still returned 60 seconds.
veKITTEN locks are illiquid until expiry (up to 2 years); voting power decays linearly.
Robinhood Chain has swaps and LP only; farming contracts exist there but incentives are not enabled, and veKITTEN/voting is HyperEVM-only. Positions and balances do not bridge between chains.

Older contracts (Phase 1 V2-style PairFactory/Router, Phase 2 CLFactory/NFP/SwapRouter, Phase 3 gauge factories) are deprecated and no longer supported; only use them via legacy.kittenswap.finance to exit old positions.

Audits: Kittenswap contracts reviewed by Pashov Audit Group (3 reports, 2025; the July 2025 one covers the current contracts); the Algebra Integral base is audited by Bailsec, ABDK, MixBytes, Paladin and Hexens per the Kittenswap docs.
notes: Addresses are from Kittenswap's official Deployed Contracts page (docs.kittenswap.finance) and the KITTEN token page; every one was checked with eth_getCode on HyperEVM (rpc.hyperliquid.xyz/evm, chainId 999) and Robinhood Chain (rpc.mainnet.chain.robinhood.com, chainId 4663). The contracts are not on Sourcify and HyperEVMScan needs an API key, so function signatures were taken from the Algebra Integral periphery/farming interfaces (github.com/cryptoalgebra/Algebra, which Kittenswap docs name as its AMM) and each selector was confirmed present in the deployed bytecode. veKITTEN and Voter signatures were matched by selector only (Velodrome-v1 style snake_case VotingEscrow); argument meanings for these are inferred, and other Voter functions (claim bribes/fees, reset, poke) could not be identified, so they are left out - use the app for voting and claiming. Omitted but listed in the docs: HyperEVM Quoter (v1) 0x3aA96eDb755C44F3E50C5408a36abb52f28326Ba, NonfungibleTokenPositionDescriptor, TickLens, RebaseReward 0xDd002E8DF80ccB7A8964BFef6e15ee36D414fC36, Minter (dynamic emissions) 0xac36d3671f21A5056Cd1751E201574d702748C7A and the deprecated Minter; Robinhood AlgebraPoolDeployer 0x45362763166CfED6174d312Fa1449EA1FC37988a, Multicall3, AlgebraEternalFarming 0xc8A85FD6511bf875646B3632Aedd60d5752610BC and FarmingCenter 0xE416C0C29DBDb4Fa25870b835ad904c1E8478CDc (not enabled), USDG 0x5fc5360D0400a0Fd4f2af552ADD042D716F1d168 (6 decimals, third-party stablecoin). Robinhood pool CREATE2 init code hash: 0x62441ebe4e4315cf3d49d5957f94d66b253dbabe7006f34ad7f70947e60bf15c. HyperEVM wrapped native token is WHYPE 0x5555555555555555555555555555555555555555 (read from SwapRouter.WNativeToken()). No official public API or GitHub was found (DefiLlama lists no GitHub).

name: KyberSwap Aggregator
description: DEX aggregator that splits a swap across many on-chain liquidity sources (plus RFQ). An agent gets the best route from the Aggregator API (GET /routes), has the API encode it (POST /route/build), approves the returned routerAddress for the input token, and sends the encoded calldata to the MetaAggregationRouterV2 router, which is deployed at the same address on every supported chain.

keyFunctions.description: Main swap entry. One tuple: (address callTarget, address approveTarget, bytes targetData, SwapDescriptionV2 desc, bytes clientData), where desc = (address srcToken, address dstToken, address[] srcReceivers, uint256[] srcAmounts, address[] feeReceivers, uint256[] feeAmounts, address dstReceiver, uint256 amount, uint256 minReturnAmount, uint256 flags, bytes permit). Returns (uint256 returnAmount, uint256 gasUsed). Do not encode by hand: send the `data` returned by POST /{chain}/api/v1/route/build as the tx calldata to this router, with value = `transactionValue` (non-zero only when selling the native token, 0xEeeeeEeeeEeEeeEeEeEeeEEEeeeeEeeeeeeeEEeE). Reverts if output < minReturnAmount (set from slippageTolerance).

Gas-optimised swap path the API may encode instead of swap(): (address caller, SwapDescriptionV2 desc, bytes executorData, bytes clientData). ERC-20 input only (not payable). Use the API calldata as-is; whichever function the API chose is already encoded in `data`.
Generic-executor variant with the same tuple as swap(). Only used when the API encodes it.
Wrapped native token address used by the router on this chain.
Whether an executor/target is whitelisted by the router owner (only whitelisted executors can be called).
Router owner (KyberSwap admin) who controls the executor whitelist and rescueFunds.

offchainApis.name: Aggregator API: [V1] Get Swap Route
offchainApis.use: GET with query tokenIn, tokenOut, amountIn (base units; native token = 0xEeeeeEeeeEeEeeEeEeEeeEEEeeeeEeeeeeeeEEeE). Optional: includedSources, excludedSources, gasInclude, origin (user wallet), feeAmount/chargeFeeBy/isInBps/feeReceiver for integrator fees. Send header `x-client-id: <your app name>` on every request (requests without it get stricter limits; public limit ~3 rps). Response: data.routeSummary (pass unchanged to /route/build) and data.routerAddress. {chain} is a slug: ethereum, bsc, arbitrum, polygon, optimism, avalanche, base, linea, mantle, sonic, berachain, ronin, unichain, hyperevm, plasma, etherlink, monad, megaeth, robinhood, arc. Do not cache routes for more than ~5-10 s.

offchainApis.name: Aggregator API: [V1] Post Swap Route For Encoded Data
offchainApis.use: POST JSON {routeSummary, sender, recipient, slippageTolerance (bps, 0-2000; 50 = 0.5%), deadline?, origin?, permit?, enableGasEstimation?, source?} with header `x-client-id`. Response data: data (calldata), routerAddress (tx `to`), transactionValue (tx value in wei, non-zero only for native-token input), amountOut, gas, gasUsd. Set enableGasEstimation=true to have the API eth_estimateGas and catch reverts before sending.

offchainApis.name: Aggregator API gateway (keyed)
offchainApis.use: Same /routes and /route/build endpoints behind KyberSwap's API gateway, with an `X-Api-Key` header for higher rate limits. Key is issued by KyberSwap business development (business@kyber.network). The public base URL above stays available but is rate limited.

actions.name: swap (ERC-20 input)
actions.description: Swap an exact amount of one token for another at the best aggregated rate
actions.how: 1) GET https://aggregator-api.kyberswap.com/{chain}/api/v1/routes?tokenIn=..&tokenOut=..&amountIn=.. with header x-client-id. 2) POST .../{chain}/api/v1/route/build with {routeSummary, sender: wallet, recipient: wallet, slippageTolerance: 50} and the same header. 3) If allowance(wallet, routerAddress) < amountIn, send tokenIn.approve(routerAddress, amountIn). 4) Send a tx {to: routerAddress, data: data, value: 0} (use the API's gas estimate plus a margin). Check that routerAddress is one of the official router addresses in this file before approving or sending.

actions.name: swap (native token input)
actions.description: Sell ETH/BNB/POL/etc. directly
actions.how: Use tokenIn=0xEeeeeEeeeEeEeeEeEeEeeEEEeeeeEeeeeeeeEEeE in /routes. No approval needed. After /route/build send {to: routerAddress, data: data, value: transactionValue}.

actions.name: swap without a separate approval (permit)
actions.description: For EIP-2612 tokens, skip the approve tx
actions.how: Sign an EIP-2612 permit with spender = routerAddress and pass the encoded permit in the `permit` field of POST /route/build; then send the returned calldata as usual.

actions.name: quote only
actions.description: Get expected output, price impact and gas cost without trading
actions.how: GET /{chain}/api/v1/routes and read data.routeSummary.amountOut, amountOutUsd and gasUsd. There is no on-chain quoter; quotes come only from the API.

actions.name: charge an integrator fee
actions.description: Take a fee on the swap for your app
actions.how: Add feeAmount, chargeFeeBy (currency_in or currency_out), isInBps=true and feeReceiver to GET /routes; the fee is carried in routeSummary.extraFee and enforced by the router.

risks: KyberSwap Elastic (Kyber's concentrated-liquidity AMM, a separate product) was exploited on 22 Nov 2023 across several chains (press reported losses of roughly $47M or more) and Elastic was discontinued on 23 Nov 2023. The aggregator routers listed here were not the exploited contracts; Elastic pools are no longer a route source.

Approvals: the router pulls tokenIn with transferFrom, so you must approve routerAddress. Approve only the exact amount and only an address listed here; an unlimited approval to the router is exposed if the router or a whitelisted executor is ever compromised.

Calldata from the API is opaque and provided as-is (Kyber's own disclaimer). Before signing, check `to` is an official router, value equals transactionValue, and amountOut/minimum received match expectations; simulate with enableGasEstimation or eth_call.
Routes go stale within seconds; rebuild if the user waits. The tx reverts if output falls below the minimum set by slippageTolerance (max 2000 bps unless ignoreCappedSlippage).
Positive slippage above the quoted amountOut and unconsumed 'dust' accrue to KyberSwap, not the user; the user is only guaranteed the minimum received.
The router is owner-controlled (executor whitelist, rescueFunds); KSAggregationRouterV3 is also pausable.
Public API is rate limited (~3 rps) and some datacenter IPs/regions get HTTP 403/451; always send x-client-id.
notes: Kyber's contracts page states all aggregator contracts share the same address on every supported chain. MetaAggregationRouterV2 (0x6131B5fae19EA4f9D964eAc0408E4408b66337b5) is listed for Ethereum, BSC, Arbitrum, Polygon, Optimism, Avalanche, Base, Linea, Sonic, Berachain, Ronin, Unichain, HyperEVM, Plasma, Etherlink, Monad, MegaETH, Robinhood Chain, Rise and Arc; this file covers the 11 major chains (bytecode spot-checked on each) and the full list is at https://docs.kyberswap.com/developer-guide/aggregator-api/contracts.md. KSAggregationRouterV3 (0x6868D319c8c9A78F7d39DC3602C5c917315132D7) is listed only for Ethereum, BSC, Base and Robinhood Chain; the API still returned MetaAggregationRouterV2 as routerAddress in a Nov 2026 spot check, so always use the routerAddress the API returns (and check it against this list). AggregationExecutorProxy (0x8F10B468b06c6FD214B65F87778827F7D113f996) and InputScalingHelperV2 (0x2f577A41BeC1BE1152AeEA12e73b7391d15f655D, used to rescale API calldata on-chain by at most +/-5%) are also on the official page but are left out as contracts because agents do not call them directly. Function signatures come from the source verified on Sourcify (chain 1). The API is EVM-only. The non-versioned GET /{chain}/route/encode endpoint is legacy; use the [V1] routes + route/build pair (or GET /{chain}/api/v1/swap for a single request).

actions.name: stake

actions.description: Stake ETH straight into wstETH
actions.how: send plain ETH to the wstETH contract (receive), or wstETH referral staker stakeETH(referral)

actions.name: wrap
actions.description: Convert stETH to wstETH
actions.how: stETH.approve(wstETH, amount) then wstETH.wrap(amount)

actions.name: unwrap
actions.description: Convert wstETH to stETH
actions.how: wstETH.unwrap(amount)

actions.name: request-withdrawal
actions.description: Start unstaking stETH or wstETH to ETH
actions.how: approve WithdrawalQueueERC721, then requestWithdrawals(amounts, owner) or requestWithdrawalsWstETH(amounts, owner); split amounts over 1000 stETH into several entries

actions.name: check-withdrawal
actions.description: See whether requests are ready
actions.how: getWithdrawalRequests(owner) then getWithdrawalStatus(ids); isFinalized && !isClaimed means claimable

actions.description: Receive ETH for finalized requests
actions.how: hints = findCheckpointHints(sortedIds, 1, getLastCheckpointIndex()); then claimWithdrawals(sortedIds, hints)

actions.name: bridge-wsteth
actions.description: Move wstETH to an L2
actions.how: use the chain's L1 bridge/gateway listed under contracts (approve wstETH to it first); fetch the exact deposit function with get_abi

risks: stETH is rebasing: balances change roughly once a day with the oracle report, without Transfer events. Store shares (sharesOf) or use wstETH for accounting.
stETH transfers can deliver 1-2 wei less than requested (integer rounding), and a full-balance transfer can leave 1-2 wei behind; use transferShares for exact amounts.

Withdrawals are not instant: normally 1-5 days per Lido's help center, and longer depending on queue size, bunker mode, and the Beacon chain exit queue. Requests cannot be cancelled (the unstETH NFT is transferable).
Each withdrawal request must be between 100 wei and 1000 stETH; larger amounts must be split.
Claimed ETH is normally the value at request time, but can be discounted if significant losses occur before finalization (documented as never having happened on mainnet).
Staking has a rate limit (getCurrentStakeLimit) and can be paused; submit reverts if exceeded or paused.
Bridged wstETH on most L2s is a plain ERC-20: it cannot be unwrapped or withdrawn there, and it has no built-in exchange rate; use Lido/Chainlink rate feeds or bridge back to Ethereum.
Permit-based withdrawal requests can be front-run (griefing, no fund loss); fall back to the approve + requestWithdrawals path.
Core contracts are upgradeable proxies controlled by Lido DAO governance.
notes: Contracts from Lido's official deployed-contracts page; proxies listed by proxy address (implementations omitted). On Ethereum, the Lido contract is the stETH token. Optimism, Unichain and Soneium also have bridged rebasable stETH with an in-protocol rate feed (TokenRateOracle) pushed from L1. BNB Chain wstETH is bridged via Wormhole NTT; Polygon PoS wstETH via the Polygon PoS bridge (ERC20Predicate on Ethereum 0x40ec5B33f54e0E8A33A975908C5BA1c14e5BbbDf). Bridge contracts for zkSync, Scroll, Mantle, Mode, Zircuit, Soneium, Lisk and Swellchain, plus Lido V3 (stVaults: VaultHub, OperatorGrid, etc.), oracles and other core contracts, are on https://docs.lido.fi/deployed-contracts/. Bridge keyFunctions are left empty on purpose: fetch their ABI with get_abi. LidoLocator returns the current addresses of all core protocol contracts.

name: Liquity V2
description: Immutable CDP protocol on Ethereum issuing the BOLD stablecoin. Agents can open Troves against WETH, wstETH or rETH at a self-chosen interest rate, adjust or close them, earn BOLD interest + liquidation gains in each branch's Stability Pool, and redeem BOLD for collateral at face value via the CollateralRegistry.

Approve a spender (e.g. a zapper for repay/close, or a DEX). Not needed for BorrowerOperations.repayBold/closeTrove, StabilityPool.provideToSP or CollateralRegistry.redeemCollateral: those burn/move BOLD directly.
Transfer BOLD.

TroveManager of branch index (use to discover/verify branch contracts).

Redeem BOLD for collateral at face value ($1 of collateral per BOLD, minus fee): (_boldAmount, _maxIterationsPerCollateral, _maxFeePercentage 1e18=100%). Split across branches in proportion to each branch's unbacked debt (debt not covered by its Stability Pool), hitting the lowest-interest-rate Troves first. BOLD is burned from msg.sender; no approve needed. Reverts if the fee exceeds _maxFeePercentage. Use RedemptionHelper if you need a minimum collateral out.
Current redemption fee rate (1e18 = 100%), = decayed baseRate + 0.5% floor. Fee grows with redeemed volume and decays with a 6h half-life.

actions.name: open-trove
actions.description: Borrow BOLD against WETH/wstETH/rETH
actions.how: 1) Pick branch (0 WETH, 1 wstETH, 2 rETH) and rate (e.g. 5e16 = 5%). 2) fee = HintHelpers.predictOpenTroveUpfrontFee(idx, bold, rate). 3) (hint,,) = HintHelpers.getApproxHint(idx, rate, 15*sqrt(SortedTroves.getSize()), seed); (upper, lower) = SortedTroves.findInsertPosition(rate, hint, hint). 4) Approve collateral (+0.0375 WETH gas deposit) to BorrowerOperations. 5) BorrowerOperations.openTrove(owner, ownerIndex, coll, bold, upper, lower, rate, fee*1.01, 0x0, 0x0, 0x0). Keep ICR well above MCR (110% WETH, 120% LSTs) and debt >= 2,000 BOLD. Or use WETHZapper/GasCompZapper.openTroveWithRawETH to pay in ETH.

actions.name: adjust-trove
actions.description: Add/remove collateral, borrow/repay
actions.how: BorrowerOperations.adjustTrove(troveId, collChange, isCollIncrease, boldChange, isDebtIncrease, maxUpfrontFee) (fee from HintHelpers.predictAdjustTroveUpfrontFee when borrowing), or addColl / withdrawColl / withdrawBold / repayBold.

actions.name: set-interest-rate
actions.description: Change a Trove's interest rate
actions.how: Hints as in open-trove for the new rate; fee = HintHelpers.predictAdjustInterestRateUpfrontFee(idx, troveId, newRate) (0 if >= 7 days since last change); BorrowerOperations.adjustTroveInterestRate(troveId, newRate, upper, lower, fee).

actions.name: close-trove
actions.description: Repay all and withdraw collateral
actions.how: debt = TroveManager.getLatestTroveData(troveId).entireDebt; hold that much BOLD (plus a little for interest accrual); BorrowerOperations.closeTrove(troveId).

actions.name: earn-stability-pool
actions.description: Deposit BOLD in a branch Stability Pool
actions.how: StabilityPool.provideToSP(amount, true). Read getCompoundedBoldDeposit / getDepositorYieldGainWithPending / getDepositorCollGain. Exit with withdrawFromSP(amount, true).

actions.name: redeem
actions.description: Redeem BOLD for collateral at $1
actions.how: Check CollateralRegistry.getRedemptionRateForRedeemedAmount(amount); CollateralRegistry.redeemCollateral(amount, maxIterationsPerCollateral (e.g. 50), maxFee 1e18-scaled). For min-out protection use RedemptionHelper.truncateRedemption (eth_call) then redeemCollateral(bold, iters, maxFeePct, minCollPerBranch[3]) after approving BOLD to it.

actions.name: liquidate
actions.description: Liquidate undercollateralized Troves
actions.how: Find Troves with TroveManager.getCurrentICR(id, PriceFeed.lastGoodPrice()) < MCR; TroveManager.batchLiquidateTroves([ids]).

risks: Redemptions: anyone can redeem BOLD for collateral at $1 (minus a fee of at least 0.5%), starting from the Troves with the LOWEST interest rate in each branch. Redeemed borrowers lose collateral equal to the debt repaid (no net loss at the oracle price, but exposure is lost). Keep your rate competitive; MultiTroveGetter.getDebtPerInterestRateAscending shows the debt in front of you.
Zombie Troves: a redemption that leaves debt < 2,000 BOLD marks the Trove 'zombie' (status 4); it stays open but must be fixed with adjustZombieTrove.

Liquidation when ICR < MCR (110% WETH, 120% wstETH/rETH): the Trove loses its collateral (up to the penalty: 5% via the Stability Pool, up to 10% WETH / 20% LST via redistribution) and the 0.0375 WETH gas deposit. Branch TCR below CCR (150% / 160%) restricts borrowing and collateral withdrawals.
Upfront fee: every new borrow (and rate changes within 7 days of the last one) pays 7 days of the branch average interest rate, added to debt and non-refundable.

Branch shutdown: if a branch's TCR falls below SCR (110% WETH, 120% LSTs) or its oracle fails, that branch freezes (only closing and urgent redemptions at a 2% bonus); BOLD stays redeemable against it.
Stability Pool deposits absorb liquidated debt: the BOLD deposit can shrink and is replaced by collateral bought at a discount; that collateral can fall in value.

Incident and redeployment: on 2025-02-12 the team was told of a Stability Pool issue in the first V2 deployment (BOLD 0xb01dd87B29d187F3E3a4Bf6cdAebfb97F3D9aB98), confirmed 2025-02-13 ('could result in the loss of funds held in these contracts'); users were told to exit and that deployment became legacy. The patched V2 relaunched on Ethereum on 2025-05-19 with new addresses (BOLD 0x6440f144...B01D). Never use the legacy addresses still listed on docs.liquity.org/v2-documentation/technical-resources.
Immutable contracts with no admin keys (no upgrades or parameter changes); governance (LQTY staking) only directs part of the protocol revenue. Oracles: Chainlink-based PriceFeeds per branch.

Audits listed in the docs: ChainSecurity (Aug 2024 - May 2025), Dedaub (Aug and Nov 2024, Cantina-fixes review May 2025), Certora formal verification (Dec 2024), Coinspect (Dec 2024 core, Jan 2025 governance, Oct 2025 RedemptionHelper), Recon (Oct 2024), Cantina competition (Mar-Apr 2025).
notes: Addresses are the CURRENT (May 2025 redeployment) Ethereum mainnet deployment, as listed on the docs page docs.liquity.org/v2-documentation/technical-docs-and-audits and in the official GitHub manifest liquity/bold contracts/addresses/1.json (they match). contracts.name: syrupUSDC SPL token (bridged via Chainlink CCIP)
syrupUSDG SPL token (bridged via Chainlink CCIP)

actions.name: check-permission
actions.description: Check whether a wallet may deposit
actions.how: PoolPermissionManager.hasPermission(poolManager, wallet, bytes32("P:deposit")); poolManager from Pool.manager() or SyrupRouter.poolManager()

actions.name: deposit
actions.description: Deposit USDC/USDT/USDG for syrup shares
actions.how: asset.approve(SyrupRouter, amount) then SyrupRouter.deposit(amount, depositData). First-time depositors without permission need a Maple-issued signature for SyrupRouter.authorizeAndDeposit(...); otherwise contact partnerships@maple.finance

actions.name: request-withdrawal
actions.description: Exit a syrup pool
actions.how: Pool.requestRedeem(shares, ownWallet). Assets arrive automatically when Maple processes the FIFO queue (usually fast; up to ~30 days in stress)

actions.name: cancel-withdrawal
actions.description: Reduce or cancel a pending request
actions.how: WithdrawalManagerQueue.removeSharesById(requestId, sharesToRemove) before it is processed

actions.name: price
actions.description: Value syrup shares
actions.how: Pool.convertToAssets(1000000) for display; Pool.convertToExitAssets(1000000) for redemption value

actions.name: bridge
actions.description: Move syrupUSDC/USDT/USDG between chains
actions.how: Chainlink CCIP router send (approve token to the CCIP router first); see the crosschain docs for lanes

risks: Deposits are permissioned: the address must be allowlisted / hold the right permission bitmap in the PoolPermissionManager, or present a Maple-signed authorization via authorizeAndDeposit. Maple's docs: "authorization is required for all Syrup deposits."
syrupUSDC, syrupUSDT and syrupUSDG are not available to residents, citizens or tax residents of restricted jurisdictions (including the United States and Australia), or to anyone accessing from them.

Withdrawals are not instant on-chain: requestRedeem queues shares (FIFO), Maple processes them; docs say normally near-instant, sometimes ~24h, maximum 30 days. Payout uses the exchange rate at processing time, so an impairment lowers it.
Yield comes from loans to institutional borrowers; borrower default/impairment can reduce share value (see unrealizedLosses / convertToExitAssets).
PoolManager, WithdrawalManager and PermissionManager are upgradeable proxies controlled by Maple governance.
Bridged syrup tokens on L2s/Solana rely on Chainlink CCIP; they are not ERC-4626 vaults there and cannot be deposited/redeemed locally except via the CCIP mint/redeem flow.
notes: Ethereum mainnet holds the actual pools; other chains only hold CCIP-bridged syrup tokens (crosschain page also lists Tempo, Robinhood and Arc deployments, omitted here because their chain IDs were not confirmed). Pool managers are not on the integration page; they are taken from Maple's official address registry (github.com/maple-labs/address-registry), which also lists Base L2 contracts (a permissioned Cash Management USDC pool, omitted) and older Maple institutional pools. Function signatures come from Maple's docs and were cross-checked against Sourcify-verified ABIs. Pool and SyrupRouter are not proxies; PoolManager, WithdrawalManagerQueue and PoolPermissionManager are EIP-1967 proxies. DefiLlama lists Bitcoin, Ethereum, XRPL, Hyperliquid L1 and Solana among its chains; the non-EVM TVL there (e.g. BTC yield products) has no agent-callable contracts documented here. Sepolia testnet addresses are on the smart-contract-integration page.

name: Meteora DAMM V1
description: Meteora's legacy Dynamic AMM (DAMM v1) on Solana: constant-product, stable and LST/depeg pools whose reserves sit in Meteora Dynamic Vaults. An agent can swap, add/remove liquidity, create permissionless pools and lock LP via the `amm` program, most easily through @meteora-ag/dynamic-amm-sdk or by routing swaps through Jupiter.

keyFunctions.description: Exact-in swap A->B or B->A on one pool. Amounts in base units of the mints. minimum_out_amount is the slippage guard (SDK: pool.getSwapQuote(inMint, inAmount, slippagePct).minSwapOutAmount, then pool.swap(owner, inMint, inAmount, minOut, referralOwner?)). Input is deposited into one Dynamic Vault and output withdrawn from the other, so vault accounts are required. Stable LST/depeg pools need extra depeg remaining accounts; an optional host-fee (referral) token account receives 20% of the protocol fee. Fee numerators use FEE_DENOMINATOR = 100_000 (default constant-product trade fee 250 = 0.25%, protocol share 20% of the trade fee). Launch pools reject swaps before their activation point. No deadline argument: rely on blockhash expiry.

keyFunctions.signature: add_balance_liquidity(pool_token_amount: u64, maximum_token_a_amount: u64, maximum_token_b_amount: u64)
keyFunctions.description: Mint exactly pool_token_amount LP spending at most the given token A/B amounts. Normal path for constant-product pools. SDK: pool.getDepositQuote(aIn, bIn, balance=true, slippage) then pool.deposit(owner, aIn, bIn, poolTokenAmount).
Deposit arbitrary A/B amounts for at least minimum_pool_token_amount LP. Stable pools only.

Burn LP and withdraw A and B proportionally with minimum-out slippage guards. Still works when the pool is disabled. The LP token account must be owned by the signing user (SPL delegates cannot burn). SDK: pool.getWithdrawQuote(lpAmount, slippage) then pool.withdraw(owner, lpAmount, aOut, bOut).
Burn LP and withdraw a single token. Stable pools only (SDK: getWithdrawQuote(lpAmount, slippage, tokenMint)).

keyFunctions.signature: initialize_permissionless_pool_with_fee_tier(curve_type: CurveType, trade_fee_bps: u64, token_a_amount: u64, token_b_amount: u64)
keyFunctions.description: Create a permissionless pool (pool PDA from curve type, sorted mints and fee tier). Allowed trade_fee_bps: constant product [25, 100, 400, 600], stable [1, 4, 10, 100]. Initial amounts set the price; creator receives LP. Payer funds rent in SOL. SDK: AmmImpl.createPermissionlessPool(...).
Create a permissionless pool with the curve's default fee.

Create a config-based constant-product pool (PDA from sorted mints + config key) inheriting fees/activation from a published config; private configs require the config's pool_creator_authority to sign. SDK: AmmImpl.createPermissionlessConstantProductPoolWithConfig2(...).
Create a customizable launch pool (trade fee 0.25%-15%, activation settings) without a config PDA.
Create the lock-escrow PDA for (pool, owner) before locking LP.
Permanently lock LP tokens into the owner's escrow; locked LP keeps earning fees. Irreversible. SDK: pool.lockLiquidity(owner, amount).
Claim token A/B fees accrued by locked LP (bounded by max_amount, LP-denominated). SDK: pool.claimLockFee2(owner, maxAmount, payer, receiver).
Emits an event with pool token amounts, virtual price and timestamp (simulate the tx to read). Off-chain, AmmImpl.create(connection, pool).poolInfo gives the same data.
Deposit the underlying token into a single-asset vault and mint vault LP (slippage-checked). DAMM v1 pools call this internally; direct use via @meteora-ag/vault-sdk vault.deposit(owner, amount).
Burn vault LP and withdraw underlying from the vault reserve; use withdraw_directly_from_strategy when the reserve is short (the SDK picks automatically).
Withdraw by first pulling from a lending strategy when reserves are insufficient.
Standard SPL Token (Tokenkeg program) mint, 6 decimals; mint and freeze authority are null on-chain. Total supply 1,000,000,000 at TGE (23 Oct 2025), with burns since.

offchainApis.name: DAMM v1 Data API
offchainApis.use: Read-only indexed pool discovery and metrics: GET /pools, GET /pools/search (filter by mints, pool_type, TVL/APR), pool configs, fee configs, alpha vaults, farm-backed pools. Swagger at https://damm-api.meteora.ag/swagger-ui/. Not for exact state when building txs: load pools on-chain with the SDK.

offchainApis.name: @meteora-ag/dynamic-amm-sdk (TypeScript SDK)
offchainApis.use: Official SDK: AmmImpl.create / createMultiple / searchPoolsByToken, getSwapQuote + swap, getDepositQuote + deposit, getWithdrawQuote + withdraw, createPermissionlessPool and config pool creators, lockLiquidity, claimLockFee2. Returns unsigned Transactions. Use v2.0.0+ with program 0.5.7.

actions.name: swap
actions.description: Swap on a DAMM v1 pool
actions.how: Simplest: route through Jupiter (Meteora's own UI swaps via Jupiter Terminal), which includes Meteora pools. Direct: const pool = await AmmImpl.create(connection, poolAddress); const q = pool.getSwapQuote(inMint, inAmount, slippagePct); const tx = await pool.swap(owner, inMint, inAmount, q.minSwapOutAmount); sign and send.

actions.name: find-pool
actions.description: Find DAMM v1 pools for a token
actions.how: GET https://damm-api.meteora.ag/pools/search?include_token_mints=<mint> or AmmImpl.searchPoolsByToken(connection, mint)

actions.name: add-liquidity
actions.description: Deposit into a pool
actions.how: pool.getDepositQuote(aIn, bIn, true, slippage) -> pool.deposit(owner, q.tokenAInAmount, q.tokenBInAmount, q.minPoolTokenAmountOut) (program add_balance_liquidity)

actions.name: remove-liquidity
actions.description: Withdraw from a pool
actions.how: pool.getWithdrawQuote(lpAmount, slippage) -> pool.withdraw(owner, lpAmount, q.minTokenAOutAmount, q.minTokenBOutAmount) (program remove_balance_liquidity)

actions.name: create-pool
actions.description: Create a permissionless pool
actions.how: AmmImpl.createPermissionlessPool(...) with an allowed fee tier, or createPermissionlessConstantProductPoolWithConfig2(...) with a published config key (see https://docs.meteora.ag/developer-guides/damm-v1/pool-fee-configs). Meteora recommends DAMM v2 for new launches.

actions.name: lock-lp
actions.description: Lock LP and keep earning fees
actions.how: pool.lockLiquidity(owner, amount) (create_lock_escrow + lock); claim with pool.claimLockFee2(owner, maxAmount, payer, receiver)

risks: Legacy product: Meteora describes DAMM v1 as legacy and recommends DAMM v2 for new pools; existing pools keep working.

Permissionless pool creation: anyone can create pools for any mint, including scam/copycat tokens and duplicate pools; always verify mints (Meteora's Staying Safe guide points to Rugcheck, JupShield and Jupiter Organic Score).

Programs are upgradeable (BPFLoaderUpgradeable) by Meteora. Admin-only instructions can disable pools (balanced withdrawals still allowed), set pool fees and partner settings, create/close configs and update launch activation points; operator accounts can withdraw/zap protocol fees.

Pool reserves are held in Dynamic Vaults that lend idle liquidity to external Solana lending strategies (managed by Meteora's off-chain Hermes keeper), adding strategy/smart-contract risk of those protocols.
Launch pools can block swaps until an activation point and may have an Alpha Vault with pre-activation access.
LP locks are permanent; locked LP can only claim fees.
Audits listed on Meteora's DAMM v1 audit page: Offside Labs, Halborn, Oak. Dynamic Vault has a separate audit page.
notes: This entry is DAMM v1 only. Other Meteora products have their own programs (from official developer guides): DAMM v2 `cp_amm` cpamdpZCGKUy5JxQXB4dcpGPiikHawvSWAd6mEn1sGG (pool authority HLnpSz9h2S4hiLQ43rnSD9XkcUThA7B8hQMKmDaiTLcC, https://docs.meteora.ag/developer-guides/damm-v2/index) and DLMM `lb_clmm` LBUZKhRxPF3XUpBCjp4YzTKgLccjZhTSDM9YuVaPwxo (https://docs.meteora.ag/developer-guides/dlmm/index); both are separate DefiLlama entries and not listed as contracts here. All DAMM v1/vault/farm program IDs are identical on mainnet and devnet and were confirmed executable via getAccountInfo. Dynamic Vault affiliate program GacY9YuN16HNRTy7ZWwULPccwvfFSBeNLuAQP7y38Du3 is mentioned in the vault guide but omitted (not needed for DAMM v1). Instruction signatures come from the official IDL bundled in the SDK (https://github.com/MeteoraAg/damm-v1-sdk/blob/main/ts-client/src/amm/idl.ts); account lists are long (vaults, vault LP, protocol fee accounts), so build transactions with the SDK. The farming program is being deprecated per Meteora's farming changelog. Sample mainnet pools from the SDK reference: USDT/USDC 32D4zRxNc1EssbJieVHfPhZM3rH6CzfUPrWUuWxD9prG, USDC/SOL 5yuefgbJJpmFNK2iiYbLSpv1aZXq7F9AUKkZKErTYCvs. No standalone swap REST API is offered by Meteora; Jupiter is the usual aggregator path (Jupiter's own API is third-party and not documented here). No specific DAMM v1 security incident was found on official pages.

name: Morpho
description: Permissionless lending: Morpho Blue is one immutable contract holding isolated variable-rate markets (one loan token, one collateral token, an oracle, an IRM and a fixed LLTV each); curated ERC-4626 vaults (Vault V1 'MetaMorpho' and Vault V2) spread deposits across markets. Agents can lend or borrow directly in a market, deposit into a vault, use Bundles for one-transaction flows, and read everything via the public Morpho Read API.

keyFunctions.description: Lend the loan token to one market: (marketParams, assets, shares, onBehalf, data). Set exactly one of assets/shares (other 0); data = empty bytes (non-empty triggers an onMorphoSupply callback). approve(Morpho, assets) on the loan token first. MarketParams = (loanToken, collateralToken, oracle, irm, lltv); lltv scaled by 1e18 (e.g. 860000000000000000 = 86%). Get it from idToMarketParams(marketId) or the Read API.

Withdraw lent assets: (marketParams, assets, shares, onBehalf, receiver). One of assets/shares non-zero; to exit fully pass shares = position(id,user).supplyShares. Reverts if the market lacks liquidity (utilisation 100%). Caller must be onBehalf or authorized by it.
Deposit collateral (not lent out, earns no interest): (marketParams, assets, onBehalf, data=empty). approve(Morpho) on the collateral token first.

Borrow the loan token: (marketParams, assets, shares, onBehalf, receiver). Position LTV must stay below the market's LLTV (collateral valued with the market oracle). Caller must be onBehalf or authorized (setAuthorization).

Repay debt: (marketParams, assets, shares, onBehalf, data=empty). To repay fully pass shares = position(id,user).borrowShares (assets would leave dust as interest accrues). approve(Morpho) on the loan token first; anyone can repay for anyone.
Withdraw collateral: (marketParams, assets, onBehalf, receiver). Reverts if the position would become unhealthy.

(marketId, user) -> (supplyShares, borrowShares, collateral). Collateral in token units; convert shares to assets with market(): assets = shares * (totalAssets + 1) / (totalShares + 1e6) (round up for borrow).

marketId -> (totalSupplyAssets, totalSupplyShares, totalBorrowAssets, totalBorrowShares, lastUpdate, fee). Values exclude interest accrued since lastUpdate; call accrueInterest or use the Read API for live numbers.
marketId -> (loanToken, collateralToken, oracle, irm, lltv). marketId = keccak256(abi.encode(marketParams)).
Let another address (e.g. a bundler or manager contract) manage your positions: borrow / withdraw / withdrawCollateral on your behalf. Revoke with false.
(authorizer, authorized) -> bool.
Accrue interest on a market so market()/position() reads are up to date.
Liquidate an unhealthy borrower (LTV > LLTV): (marketParams, borrower, seizedAssets, repaidShares, data). Set one of seizedAssets/repaidShares. Liquidation incentive depends on LLTV (max 15%).
Free flash loan of any token Morpho holds: (token, assets, data); caller must implement onMorphoFlashLoan and approve repayment.
Permissionless market creation with a governance-enabled IRM and LLTV. Markets are immutable once created.
Deploy a Morpho Vault V2: (owner, asset, salt). For curators.
True if the address is a Vault V2 deployed by this factory. Verify a vault with this before depositing.
[Called on a Vault V2, not on the factory] ERC-4626 deposit: (assets, onBehalf). approve(vault) first. Reverts if a gate blocks the caller.

[On a Vault V2] Withdraw an exact asset amount: (assets, receiver, onBehalf). Served from idle assets and the liquidity adapter; reverts if not enough liquidity (use forceDeallocate or VaultExitBundlesV1).
[On a Vault V2] Burn shares: (shares, receiver, onBehalf).

[On a Vault V2] Assets returned for shares now. Note: Vault V2 maxDeposit/maxMint/maxWithdraw/maxRedeem always return 0 by design (gates make them unpredictable), so do not use them to size withdrawals; use previewRedeem and the Read API's withdrawable_assets.
[On a Vault V2] Total assets under management.
[On a Vault V2] Non-custodial exit: (adapter, data, assets, onBehalf) pulls assets out of an adapter into idle so they can be withdrawn, paying the adapter's forceDeallocatePenalty in shares.
Deploy a Vault V1 (MetaMorpho v1.1): (initialOwner, initialTimelock, asset, name, symbol, salt). For curators; agents normally only deposit into existing vaults.
True if the address is a vault created by this factory. Use it to verify a vault before depositing.

[Called on a Vault V1 created by this factory, not on the factory] ERC-4626 deposit: (assets, receiver). approve(vault, assets) on the vault asset first. Assets are supplied to the curator's Morpho Blue markets following the supply queue.
[On a Vault V1] ERC-4626 withdraw an exact asset amount: (assets, receiver, owner). Limited by liquidity in the underlying markets.
[On a Vault V1] Burn shares for assets: (shares, receiver, owner). Use balanceOf(you) as shares to exit fully.
[On a Vault V1] Max assets the owner can withdraw now (bounded by underlying market liquidity).
[On a Vault V1] Asset value of shares (share price).
True for Vault V1.0 vaults created by this older factory.

Move a Vault V2's liquidity between Blue markets so you can borrow/withdraw where liquidity is short: (vault, deallocateAdapter, deallocateMarketParams, allocateAdapter, allocateMarketParams, assets, penalty). Pass penalty = vaultData(vault).penalty; if non-zero, approve this contract for the penalty amount in the vault asset first. Subject to the vault's caps set in this contract.
Allocate a Vault V2's idle assets to a market: (vault, adapter, marketParams, assets, penalty). Only if vaultData(vault).canPullFromIdle.
vault -> (canPullFromIdle, penalty). penalty is WAD-scaled (1e18 = 100%).
(vault, allocationId) -> cap for allocations through the Public Allocator; allocationId = keccak256(abi.encode("this/marketParams", adapter, marketParams)).
(vault, allocationId) -> whether liquidity may be pulled from that market.

offchainApis.name: Morpho Read API
offchainApis.use: REST reads for agents and apps: /v0/blue/markets (list, filter by chain_id), /v0/blue/markets/{market}/state, /liquidity, /public-allocator-vaults, /users/{address}/position; /v0/vaults-v1 and /v0/vaults-v2 lists, /v1/vaults-v2/{vault}/state (total_assets, share_price_ray, withdrawable_assets), /v0/vaults-v2/{vault}/allocations, user positions, /v0/tokens/{token}/price, /v0/oracles/{oracle}/state, Midnight books. offchainApis.name: Morpho Actions API
offchainApis.use: Builds transaction calls (supply, borrow, vault deposit, etc.) for the user's wallet to sign. API key in the x-api-key header; action requests to api.morpho.org are refused (403).
