actions.name: find markets / vaults
actions.description: Discover markets and vaults (they are not listed one by one here)
actions.how: Read API GET https://api.morpho.org/v0/blue/markets?chain_id=1 or /v0/vaults-v2 (listed vaults). On-chain: CreateMarket events on Morpho give marketParams; idToMarketParams(id) returns them; VaultV2Factory.isVaultV2(addr) / MetaMorpho factory isMetaMorpho(addr) verify a vault is genuine.

actions.name: lend in a market
actions.description: Supply the loan token to one Morpho Blue market
actions.how: approve(Morpho, amount) on the loan token; Morpho.supply(marketParams, amount, 0, you, 0x). Or BlueBundlesV1.blueBundlesV1Supply(...).

actions.name: borrow
actions.description: Borrow against collateral in one market
actions.how: approve(Morpho) on collateral; Morpho.supplyCollateral(marketParams, collAmount, you, 0x); then Morpho.borrow(marketParams, amount, 0, you, you). Keep LTV well under LLTV. One tx: BlueBundlesV1.blueBundlesV1SupplyCollateralAndBorrow with a maxLtv guard (needs Morpho authorization for the bundle, by setAuthorization or signedAuthorization).

actions.name: repay and withdraw collateral
actions.description: Close a loan
actions.how: approve(Morpho) on the loan token; Morpho.repay(marketParams, 0, position(id,you).borrowShares, you, 0x); Morpho.withdrawCollateral(marketParams, position.collateral, you, you).

actions.name: deposit into a vault
actions.description: Earn curated yield
actions.how: Verify the vault with VaultV2Factory.isVaultV2 or isMetaMorpho; approve(vault, amount) on its asset(); vault.deposit(amount, you). Exit: vault.redeem(shares, you, you). Or VaultBundlesV1.vaultBundlesV1Deposit with a maxSharePriceE27 slippage guard.

actions.name: exit an illiquid Vault V2
actions.description: Get funds out when the vault's liquidity is allocated
actions.how: VaultExitBundlesV1.vaultExitBundlesV1ForceWithdrawVaultV2 (pays the forceDeallocate penalty) or vaultExitBundlesV1InKindRedemptionVaultV2 (take Blue supply positions in kind).

actions.name: source extra liquidity
actions.description: Borrow more than a market currently holds
actions.how: Check /v0/blue/markets/{id}/public-allocator-vaults, then BluePublicAllocator.reallocate(...) or pass reallocations to a BlueBundlesV1 entrypoint.

risks: Liquidation: if a borrower's LTV (debt / collateral valued by the market's oracle) exceeds the market's immutable LLTV, anyone can liquidate it and seize collateral with an incentive of up to 15% (MAX_LIQUIDATION_INCENTIVE_FACTOR 1.15; the incentive is larger for lower LLTVs).

Oracle risk: each market's oracle is fixed at creation and anyone can create markets with any oracle; a wrong or manipulable oracle can cause unfair liquidations or bad debt. Morpho's docs say no oracle is immune to manipulation; check the oracle (Read API /v0/oracles/{oracle}/state) before using a market.
Bad debt is realised immediately and socialised to that market's lenders (and to vaults allocated there). Markets are isolated, so losses stay in the affected market.
Liquidity risk: lenders can only withdraw what is not borrowed; at 100% utilisation withdrawals revert until borrowers repay (the AdaptiveCurveIrm raises rates sharply to restore liquidity).

Curator risk (vaults): Vault V1 curators/allocators and Vault V2 Owner/Curator/Allocators/Sentinels decide which markets and adapters the vault uses; a bad allocation means losses for depositors. Most risk-increasing changes are timelocked, gates can block deposits/withdrawals, and fees are capped (Vault V2: performance <= 50%, management <= 5%/yr). Check the vault's curator, timelock and allocations before depositing.
Vault V2 maxDeposit/maxMint/maxWithdraw/maxRedeem always return 0 by design; integrations that rely on these ERC-4626 limits will think the vault is closed.
Counterparty risk on assets: centralised loan or collateral tokens can be frozen or blacklisted by their issuer.

Smart-contract risk: Morpho Blue and the vault contracts are immutable (no admin upgrade); governance (MORPHO holders) can only enable new IRMs/LLTVs and set a fee switch (capped at 25% of interest). Bundler3 and its adapters are deprecated in favour of Bundles; existing deployments stay live but the Morpho app no longer uses them.
notes: Slug: DefiLlama lists Morpho as a parent protocol (api.llama.fi/protocol/morpho) whose main child is 'Morpho Blue' (slug morpho-blue), plus Morpho Midnight and the retired Morpho Optimizers; this file covers the Morpho family. All addresses are from the official docs page https://docs.morpho.org/developers/contracts/addresses (raw markdown at https://docs.morpho.org/developers/contracts/addresses.md) and every one was checked to have contract code (eth_getCode). The Morpho Blue singleton is 0xBBBBBbbBBb9cC5e90e3b3Af64bdAF62C37EEFFCb only on Ethereum and Base; on other chains it has a different address (listed). keyFunctions are given once on the Ethereum entries; same-named contracts elsewhere share the interface. Vault ERC-4626 functions are shown on the factory entries, marked '[On a Vault ...]', because individual vaults are not listed: find them with the Read API (/v0/vaults-v1, /v0/vaults-v2) and verify with isMetaMorpho / isVaultV2. Morpho is on about 40 chains (HyperEVM, Katana, Monad, Sonic, World Chain, Plasma, Sei, Stable, Tempo, Robinhood Chain, etc.); those, plus ChainlinkOracleV2 factories, MorphoRegistry, Vault V2 adapter factories, Universal Rewards Distributors, Bundler3 migration/Paraswap adapters, MidnightBundles, Midnight ratifiers/periphery and the legacy Morpho Optimizers, are on the addresses page but not listed here. The Vault V1 PublicAllocator is intentionally omitted: the docs say retired Vault V1 allocator addresses are left out and integrators should use the Vault V2 Blue Public Allocator. Midnight (fixed-rate, fixed-term order-book markets) is listed on Ethereum and Base without keyFunctions because its interface (offers, ratifiers, callbacks) is complex; use MidnightBundlesV2 and the Midnight docs (https://docs.morpho.org/developers/midnight/resources/all). Legacy MORPHO 0x9994E35Db50125E0DF82e4c2dde62496CE330999 is not transferable; only wrapped MORPHO is. Signatures come from Sourcify full/partial matches (Morpho, factories, Public Allocator, Bundles, MORPHO implementation) and morpho-org GitHub sources (vault-v2 IVaultV2/IERC4626, VaultV2.sol, metamorpho IMetaMorpho). No dated security incidents are included because none were found on an official Morpho page during research.

name: Olympus DAO
description: OHM is a treasury-backed, free-floating reserve currency. Agents can stake OHM into gOHM (wrap/unwrap), borrow USDS against gOHM in Cooler Loans V2 (perpetual, fixed rate, no price liquidations), bid USDS in the Convertible Deposits auction for an option to convert into OHM, sell OHM into the Yield Repurchase Facility's daily Bond Protocol markets, bridge OHM between Ethereum, Arbitrum, Optimism, Base and Berachain through Chainlink CCIP, and vote with gOHM in Governor Bravo.

offchainApis.name: Olympus MCP server
offchainApis.use: Read-only MCP (Streamable HTTP) over Olympus on-chain state, protocol metrics, Cooler loans, supply, governance and docs.

offchainApis.name: Protocol Visualizer Indexer (GraphQL)
offchainApis.use: List Kernel-installed contracts per chain (filter isEnabled: true). It returned 'Application not found' on 2026-11-25; fall back to Kernel.isPolicyActive.

actions.name: stake OHM for gOHM
actions.description: Get gOHM (needed for Cooler collateral and governance).
actions.how: OHM.approve(Staking, amount); Staking.stake(to, amount, false, true).

actions.name: unstake gOHM to OHM
actions.description: Redeem gOHM for OHM at the index (no fee, no delay).
actions.how: Staking.unstake(to, gOhmAmount, false, false).

actions.name: borrow USDS against gOHM
actions.description: Open or increase a Cooler V2 loan.
actions.how: gOHM.approve(MonoCooler, amount); MonoCooler.addCollateral(amount, self, []); MonoCooler.borrow(usdsWad, self, self). Check accountPosition() first; min debt 1,000 USDS. Or use Composites.addCollateralAndBorrow in one tx.

actions.name: repay and withdraw
actions.description: Repay Cooler debt and take back gOHM.
actions.how: USDS.approve(MonoCooler, amount); MonoCooler.repay(amount, self); MonoCooler.withdrawCollateral(type(uint128).max, self, self, []).

actions.name: bid in the convertible deposit auction
actions.description: Deposit USDS for an option to convert into OHM at the locked price.
actions.how: Check isAuctionActive() and previewBid(period, amount); USDS.approve(DepositManager 0xcb4E21Eb404d80F3e1dB781aAd9AD6A1217fbbf2, amount); Auctioneer.bid(period, amount, minOhmOut, false, false). Later: Facility.convert(...) before expiry, DepositRedemptionVault.startRedemption/finishRedemption for the full deposit, or Facility.reclaim(...) for an early exit at a discount.

actions.name: sell OHM to the Yield Repurchase Facility
actions.description: The YRF buys OHM for USDS each day through a Bond Protocol market.
actions.how: Find the current market on the Bond auctioneer (created by the YRF), OHM.approve(BondTeller, amount), BondTeller.purchase(recipient, 0x0, marketId, amount, minOut).

actions.name: bridge OHM
actions.description: Move native OHM between Ethereum, Arbitrum, Optimism, Base and Berachain.
actions.how: OHM.approve(CCIPCrossChainBridge, amount); fee = getFeeEVM(selector, to, amount); sendToEVM(selector, to, amount) with value = fee. Track on the CCIP Explorer.

actions.name: vote
actions.description: Vote on Olympus governance proposals.
actions.how: gOHM.delegate(self) (once, before the proposal snapshot); GovernorBravo.castVote(proposalId, 1).

risks: OHM is not pegged; it floats freely. Range Bound Stability (RBS) is disabled (the Operator is inactive); buybacks come from the YRF and supply growth from the EmissionManager / convertible deposit auctions.
Emissions: when OHM trades above the minimum premium to backing, the EmissionManager sells new OHM through convertible deposit auctions (with a Bond Protocol fallback), diluting holders.

Cooler V2 has no price-based liquidation, but a position becomes liquidatable when accrued interest pushes debt per gOHM above the liquidation LTV; governance sets LTVs and the interest rate and can change them.

Convertible deposits: early reclaim applies a discount; conversion is only possible before the position expiry; redemption takes the full deposit period; loans against redemptions default at their due date.

Admin powers: Olympus V3 is a Kernel of modules and policies; governance (Governor Bravo + multisigs, emergency multisig) can install, upgrade or deactivate policies, pause borrows and change parameters. Check Kernel.isPolicyActive before relying on a policy.
Bridged OHM depends on Chainlink CCIP and per-route rate limits; transfers to Ethereum fail if the Ethereum pool lacks OHM; excess CCIP fee sent is kept by the bridge contract.
Audits listed by Olympus: Cooler V2 (panprog, Electisec, Nethermind, 2025), Convertible Deposits (Guardian, Trust, 2025), CCIP bridge (Electisec 2025, Cyfrin 2026).
notes: All addresses are from the Olympus docs addresses page; each was checked for code on-chain and each Ethereum policy listed was confirmed active with isActive() on 2026-11-25. Left out: modules (TRSRY, MINTR, PRICE, RANGE, ROLES, DLGTE, DEPOS; internal state, not called by users), Heart/EmissionManager/RolesAdmin/TreasuryCustodian and other operator-only policies, the Operator (RBS disabled, active() false), Cooler V1 Clearinghouses and CoolerFactory (marked deprecated; V1 loans can only be repaid), the older YRF 0x30a967eb957e5b1ee053b75f1a57ea6bfb2e907e (isActive false), CCIP token pools (internal to CCIP), Robinhood Chain and Solana OHM (not in the requested chain set; listed on the docs page), and Olympus V1/V2 bond depositories and allocators. The docs list Governor Bravo Delegate 0xa6013bBFd70d6190FA1cc1afD0cB3859847711B4, but the Delegator's implementation() returned 0xdE3F82D378c3b4E3F3f848b8DF501914b3317E96 on 2026-11-25; use the Delegator address (vote selectors confirmed in the live implementation's bytecode). Cooler V2 loans are perpetual, so there is no 'extend' function; extendLoan exists only for convertible-deposit redemption loans. The Bond Teller is a Bond Protocol contract listed as a dependency on the docs page. The docs list gOHM only on Ethereum, Arbitrum and older chains (Avalanche, Polygon, Fantom, Optimism, Boba), not on Base or Berachain. Signatures come from Sourcify-verified sources; Governor and Staking selectors were checked in bytecode. DefiLlama tracks Olympus on Ethereum only.

name: Origin Protocol
description: Yield-bearing rebasing tokens backed 1:1 by a vault: OETH (ETH, Ethereum), OUSD (USDC, Ethereum) and Super OETH (superOETHb, Base), each with an ERC-4626 wrapper (wOETH, wOUSD, wsuperOETHb). Agents mint by depositing WETH/USDC (or ETH via the Zapper), redeem through a two-step withdrawal queue, wrap/unwrap, swap stETH<->WETH on the ARM, and stake OGN for xOGN.

offchainApis.name: Origin analytics API
offchainApis.use: Read APY/APR (apy7, apy30...), totalSupply, rebasing vs non-rebasing supply and prices for ousd, oeth, superoethb, os. Also /api/v2/{token}/apr/trailing/{days} and /api/v2/{symbol}/ratios. Origin says not to rely on it for mission-critical data.

actions.name: mint-oeth
actions.description: Get OETH for ETH/WETH at 1:1
actions.how: ETH: OETHZapper.deposit() with ETH value (or depositETHForWrappedTokens(minWOETH) to receive wOETH). WETH: WETH.approve(OETH Vault, amt) then Vault.mint(amt). Origin recommends also comparing the Curve OETH/ETH price, which can be better.

actions.name: mint-ousd
actions.description: Get OUSD for USDC at 1:1
actions.how: USDC.approve(OUSD Vault, amt) then OUSDVault.mint(amt) (amt in 6-decimal USDC units).

actions.name: mint-superoethb
actions.description: Get superOETHb on Base
actions.how: Base Zapper.deposit() with ETH, or WETH.approve(Super OETH Vault) then Vault.mint(amt).

actions.name: redeem
actions.description: Redeem OETH/OUSD/superOETHb 1:1 for WETH/USDC
actions.how: Vault.requestWithdrawal(amount) -> requestId (event WithdrawalRequested); wait >= withdrawalClaimDelay (600 s) and until withdrawalRequests(id).queued <= withdrawalQueueMetadata().claimable; then Vault.claimWithdrawal(id) from the same address. For an instant exit, swap on Curve/Aerodrome or (stETH) the ARM instead.

actions.name: wrap
actions.description: Convert rebasing token to non-rebasing ERC-4626
actions.how: OToken.approve(wrapper, amt) then wrapper.deposit(amt, receiver); unwrap with wrapper.redeem(shares, receiver, owner).

actions.name: enable-yield-for-contract
actions.description: Let a smart-contract wallet earn rebases
actions.how: From the contract/multisig: OToken.rebaseOptIn(); check with rebaseState(addr) == 2.

actions.name: swap-steth
actions.description: Sell stETH for WETH (or buy) on the Lido ARM
actions.how: stETH.approve(ARM, amt); ARM.swapExactTokensForTokens(stETH, WETH, amt, minOut, to). Expected out = amt * traderate1 / 1e36.

actions.name: stake-ogn
actions.description: Stake OGN for xOGN
actions.how: OGN.approve(xOGN, amt); xOGN.stake(amt, durationSeconds, to, false, -1).

actions.name: exit-os
actions.description: Exit Origin Sonic (wind-down)
actions.how: wOS.redeem(shares, me, me) -> OS; OSVault.requestWithdrawal(amount); after 10 min OSVault.claimWithdrawal(id) -> wS. ARM LPs: OSARM.requestRedeem(shares) then claimRedeem(id).

risks: OETH, OUSD and superOETHb are rebasing: EOA balances rise automatically, but smart contracts (incl. multisigs, AMM pools, vaults) do NOT earn yield unless they call rebaseOptIn(). Use the wrapped ERC-4626 tokens where balances must not change.

Redemptions are asynchronous: requestWithdrawal burns tokens immediately, the claim opens after withdrawalClaimDelay (600 s) and only when the queue has liquidity. Origin docs say OUSD redemptions can take up to ~24 h when funds must be pulled from strategies; OETH liquidity can depend on validator withdrawals.

All core contracts (tokens, vaults, wrappers, ARM, xOGN) are upgradeable proxies controlled by Origin governance (Timelock 0x35918cDE7233F2dD33fA41ae3Cb6aE0e42E0e69F on Ethereum, 5-of-8 Safe admins, and a Guardian Safe that can pause capital). rebase() itself is restricted to the operator/strategist/governor; rebases also happen during user actions and by keeper.

Yield comes from strategies: OETH from ETH staking (Origin native/compounding staking) and Curve AMO; OUSD from Morpho vaults on Ethereum/Base/HyperEVM (bridged via CCTP) and a Curve AMO; superOETHb from bridged wOETH plus Aerodrome/Curve AMOs. Strategy or bridge failure can impair backing; mint reverts if the vault is paused.

Past incident: OUSD was exploited in November 2020 (about $7M lost through a reentrancy bug); OUSD relaunched in January 2021 with upgraded contracts and a compensation plan (the deprecated "OUSD Compensation" contract is listed in the OUSD registry).
Audits: OpenZeppelin, Trail of Bits, Sigma Prime, Certora (formal verification), Nethermind, Narya, Perimeter and others; see the docs Audits page (github.com/OriginProtocol/security).

Origin Sonic (OS, wOS, OS ARM) is being wound down by governance vote: no yield, public minting is disabled (mint is restricted to strategist/governor), only withdrawals remain and dapp support is ending.
Super OETH on Plume (superOETHp) was deprecated on 12 Nov 2025 and no longer earns yield; redemptions only via the Plume explorer since 21 Jan 2026.

ARM LP shares: redemption value is fixed at request but reduced if NAV falls before claim; claims may stay pending until liquidity returns (e.g. via the Lido withdrawal queue). Deposits may be capped by a CapManager. Swaps happen at operator-set prices (traderate0/1), not an AMM curve.
notes: Addresses are from Origin's docs registry (Contracts, OETH, Super OETH, OUSD, OS and ARM registry pages) and the official OS-withdrawal and superOETHp-redemption guides; each was checked on-chain with eth_getCode (Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, Sonic, Plume). Function signatures come from Sourcify-verified sources/ABIs of the current implementations (OETH/OUSD Vault impls on Ethereum, OETHBaseVault, OSVault, OETHZapper, WOETH, LidoARM, ExponentialStaking) and from selector checks of the deployed bytecode. The docs' contracts index lists the OS contracts under "Deprecated"; they are kept here only for exits. Other ARMs on Ethereum (WETH ARM 0x68025A4615407993A680102b08a23A61D11C657C, eETH ARM 0xfB0A3CF9B019BFd8827443d131b235B3E0FC58d2, sUSDe ARM 0xCEDa2d856238aA0D12f6329de20B9115f07C366d, USDC ARM 0x9E3A7026E5767F2d7Ff5e83b0ed011005f45a170) are on the ARM registry page; DefiLlama tracks them as the separate "Origin ARM" protocol, so only the stETH ARM is detailed here. Strategies, oracles, harvesters, bridge adapters, governance Safes and Pool Boosters are omitted (not user-callable). OUSD exists only on Ethereum (its Base/HyperEVM strategies are internal). Arbitrum holds only bridged wOETH (DefiLlama does not list Arbitrum for this protocol). Plume superOETHp and Sonic OS are listed only for exits.

name: Pendle
description: Pendle splits yield-bearing assets (stETH, sUSDe, USDe, etc.) into PT (fixed yield, redeemable 1:1 for the accounting asset at maturity) and YT (all variable yield and points until maturity), traded in a PT/SY AMM. Agents can buy/sell PT and YT, add/remove liquidity, and mint/redeem through PendleRouter V4, ideally with calldata built by Pendle's Hosted SDK (Convert API); PENDLE can be staked into sPENDLE on Ethereum.

keyFunctions.description: Buy PT (fixed yield) with a token: (receiver, market, minPtOut, ApproxParams guessPtOut, TokenInput input, LimitOrderData limit). Returns (netPtOut, netSyFee, netSyInterm). Approve the router for tokenIn first. TokenInput = (tokenIn, netTokenIn, tokenMintSy, pendleSwap, swapData(swapType uint8, extRouter, extCalldata, needScale)). Without an aggregator: tokenIn = tokenMintSy = a token the SY accepts (SY.getTokensIn()), pendleSwap = 0x0, swapData = (0, 0x0, 0x, false). For native ETH use tokenIn = 0x0 and send msg.value. Default ApproxParams (createDefaultApproxParams()): (guessMin=0, guessMax=type(uint256).max, guessOffchain=0, maxIteration=256, eps=1e14); the Hosted SDK instead returns a tight off-chain guess that uses much less gas. Empty limit orders: LimitOrderData = (limitRouter=0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000, epsSkipMarket=0, normalFills=[], flashFills=[], optData=0x) (what createEmptyLimitOrderData() returns).

Sell PT for a token before maturity: (receiver, market, exactPtIn, TokenOutput output, LimitOrderData limit). Approve PT to the router. TokenOutput = (tokenOut, minTokenOut, tokenRedeemSy, pendleSwap, swapData). Without an aggregator: tokenOut = tokenRedeemSy = a token the SY redeems to (SY.getTokensOut()), pendleSwap = 0x0, swapData = (0, 0x0, 0x, false); minTokenOut is your slippage floor. Empty limit orders: LimitOrderData = (limitRouter=0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000, epsSkipMarket=0, normalFills=[], flashFills=[], optData=0x) (what createEmptyLimitOrderData() returns). After expiry use redeemPyToToken instead.
Buy YT (leveraged variable yield, worth 0 at maturity): (receiver, market, minYtOut, ApproxParams guessYtOut, TokenInput input, LimitOrderData limit). Same struct rules as swapExactTokenForPt.
Sell YT for a token: (receiver, market, exactYtIn, TokenOutput output, LimitOrderData limit). Approve YT to the router.

Zap one token into a market's LP: (receiver, market, minLpOut, ApproxParams guessPtReceivedFromSy, TokenInput input, LimitOrderData limit). Returns (netLpOut, netSyFee, netSyInterm). Use default ApproxParams and empty LimitOrderData if not using the SDK.
Exit LP to one token: (receiver, market, netLpToRemove, TokenOutput output, LimitOrderData limit). Approve the LP (market) token to the router first.
Mint equal amounts of PT and YT from a token: (receiver, YT, minPyOut, TokenInput input). Returns (netPyOut, netSyInterm).

Redeem PT+YT (equal amounts, any time) or PT alone after expiry for a token: (receiver, YT, netPyIn, TokenOutput output). Note: the last tuple is the TokenOutput struct (same layout as TokenInput). Approve PT (and YT before expiry) to the router.
Claim accrued YT interest, SY/YT/LP rewards (e.g. PENDLE incentives) for user: (user, sys[], yts[], markets[]). Pass empty arrays for types you do not hold.
Simplified buy-PT without ApproxParams or limit orders: (receiver, market, minPtOut, TokenInput input). Uses more gas for the on-chain search; no limit-order fills.

Preview buying PT: (market, tokenIn, amountTokenIn) -> (netPtOut, netSyMinted, netSyFee, priceImpact, exchangeRateAfter, ...). Use netPtOut minus slippage as minPtOut. Off-chain use only (docs: not for fund-sensitive on-chain logic).
Preview selling PT: (market, exactPtIn, tokenOut) -> (netTokenOut, netSyToRedeem, netSyFee, priceImpact, exchangeRateAfter).
Preview buying YT: (market, tokenIn, amountTokenIn) -> (netYtOut, netSyMinted, netSyFee, priceImpact, exchangeRateAfter, ...).
Preview selling YT: (market, exactYtIn, tokenOut) -> (netTokenOut, netSyFee, priceImpact, ...).
Preview a single-token LP zap: (market, tokenIn, netTokenIn) -> (netLpOut, netPtFromSwap, netSyFee, priceImpact, exchangeRateAfter, ...).
Preview LP exit: (market, netLpToRemove, tokenOut) -> (netTokenOut, netSyFee, priceImpact, ...).
Preview PT+YT (or post-expiry PT) redemption: (YT, netPYToRedeem, tokenOut) -> netTokenOut.
Spot PT price in the SY's accounting asset (1e18 = 1:1) for a market; 1 - rate shows the discount behind the implied APY.
Spot LP price in the accounting asset (1e18 scale) for a market.
For an SY, YT/PT or market: (tokensIn[], tokensOut[]) the SY can be minted from / redeemed to (valid tokenMintSy / tokenRedeemSy values).
(market, user) -> the user's LP, PT, YT balances and claimable rewards in that market (non-view in ABI; call with eth_call).

True if the address is a market created by this factory. Check this before trusting a market address you did not get from the Pendle API. Older markets belong to older factories (marketFactoryV3..V5, listed in the same deployments file).

offchainApis.name: Pendle Hosted SDK - Convert API (v3, recommended)
offchainApis.use: POST JSON {receiver, slippage (0-1, 0.01 = 1%), inputs:[{token, amount}], outputs:[address], enableAggregator?, aggregators?, additionalData?}. One endpoint for every action: token->PT/YT (swap), PT/YT->token, token->LP (add liquidity), LP->token, token->[PT,YT] (mint), [PT,YT] or PT after expiry->token (redeem), token<->SY, LP->LP (transfer liquidity), PT->PT (roll over). Response: action, requiredApprovals [{token, amount}] (approve these to tx.to first), routes[] sorted by output; routes[0].tx = {to (PendleRouter V4), data (ready calldata), from, value}, routes[0].outputs, routes[0].contractParamInfo (method + decoded params, including ApproxParams and limit-order fills), routes[0].data.priceImpact. Tested 2026-11-25: USDe->PT-USDe on chain 1 returned swapExactTokenForPt calldata to 0x888888888889758F76e7103c6CbF23ABbF58F946. Amounts in wei. Rate limit 200 computing units/minute and 200,000/week per IP; each aggregator adds CU.

offchainApis.name: Pendle Hosted SDK - Convert API (v2 GET)
offchainApis.use: Same as v3 with query params tokensIn, amountsIn, tokensOut (comma-separated), receiver, slippage, enableAggregator, aggregators (kyberswap, okx, 0x), additionalData=impliedApy,effectiveApy. Marked deprecated in the API overview; use v3 for new code.

offchainApis.name: Pendle markets API
offchainApis.use: Discover markets across all chains (paginate with skip, limit <= 100; filter e.g. chainId). Each market gives address (market/LP), pt, yt, sy (as '<chainId>-<address>'), expiry, underlyingAsset, inputTokens/outputTokens and details (impliedApy, liquidity, totalTvl, aggregatedApy, ptRoi). Also GET /v1/assets/all, GET /v1/prices/assets, GET /v3/{chainId}/markets/{address}/historical-data.

offchainApis.name: sPENDLE API
offchainApis.use: sPENDLE staking stats; GET /v1/spendle/{address} for per-user reward data.

offchainApis.name: Pendle API reference (Swagger)
offchainApis.use: Interactive reference with the CU cost of each endpoint and the list of supported aggregators.

actions.name: find a market
actions.description: Get the market, PT, YT and SY addresses for an asset and expiry.
actions.how: GET https://api-v2.pendle.finance/core/v2/markets/all?chainId=<id>&limit=100 (page with skip). Strip the '<chainId>-' prefix from pt/yt/sy. On-chain, market.readTokens() returns (SY, PT, YT), market.expiry() the unix maturity and market.isExpired() whether it has matured; MarketFactoryV6.isValidMarket(market) confirms a V6 market. Pick a market whose expiry has not passed.

actions.name: buy PT (lock a fixed yield) - recommended path
actions.description: Swap a token for PT via the Hosted SDK.
actions.how: POST https://api-v2.pendle.finance/core/v3/sdk/<chainId>/convert with {receiver, slippage: 0.005, inputs:[{token: tokenIn, amount: wei}], outputs:[PT]}; for any token not accepted by the SY add enableAggregator: true. Approve each requiredApprovals token to routes[0].tx.to (PendleRouter 0x888888888889758F76e7103c6CbF23ABbF58F946), then send routes[0].tx (to, data, value). The PT matures to 1 accounting-asset unit; hold to expiry for the quoted fixed APY (data.impliedApy with additionalData).

actions.name: buy PT on-chain without the API
actions.description: Build swapExactTokenForPt yourself.
actions.how: Preview with RouterStatic.swapExactTokenForPtStatic(market, tokenIn, amount) -> netPtOut. Approve the router, then router.swapExactTokenForPt(receiver, market, minPtOut = netPtOut*(1-slippage), ApproxParams(0, 2^256-1, 0, 256, 1e14), TokenInput(tokenIn, amount, tokenIn, 0x0, (0, 0x0, 0x, false)), LimitOrderData(0x0, 0, [], [], 0x)). tokenIn must be in SY.getTokensIn().

actions.name: sell PT / YT before maturity
actions.description: Exit a PT or YT position to a token.
actions.how: Convert API with inputs [{token: PT or YT, amount}] and outputs [tokenOut]; or router.swapExactPtForToken / swapExactYtForToken(receiver, market, amountIn, TokenOutput(tokenOut, minOut, tokenOut, 0x0, (0, 0x0, 0x, false)), empty LimitOrderData) after approving the PT/YT to the router.

actions.name: redeem PT at maturity
actions.description: Turn matured PT into the underlying.
actions.how: After market.isExpired(): Convert API inputs [{token: PT, amount}] outputs [token]; or router.redeemPyToToken(receiver, YT, ptAmount, TokenOutput(...)) after approving PT. No protocol fee after maturity. Before maturity redemption needs equal PT and YT.

actions.name: buy YT (long yield / points)
actions.description: Leveraged exposure to the underlying APY and points until maturity.
actions.how: Convert API with outputs [YT], or router.swapExactTokenForYt(receiver, market, minYtOut, default ApproxParams, TokenInput, empty LimitOrderData). Claim yield with router.redeemDueInterestAndRewards(user, [], [YT], []) or the YT's own redeemDueInterestAndRewards(user, true, true).

actions.name: provide liquidity
actions.description: Zap one token into a Pendle pool (LP earns swap fees, PT fixed yield, underlying yield and PENDLE incentives).
actions.how: Convert API outputs [market address] (outputs [market, YT] for zero-price-impact 'keep YT' mode); or router.addLiquiditySingleToken(receiver, market, minLpOut, default ApproxParams, TokenInput, empty LimitOrderData). Exit with inputs [market] outputs [token] or router.removeLiquiditySingleToken. Claim PENDLE with router.redeemDueInterestAndRewards(user, [], [], [market]).

actions.name: stake PENDLE (sPENDLE)
actions.description: Ethereum only.
actions.how: PENDLE.approve(0x999999999991E178D52Cd95AFd4b00d066664144, amt); sPENDLE.stake(amt). Unstake: cooldown(amt), wait 14 days, finalizeCooldown(); or instantUnstake(amt) with a 5% fee.

risks: PT is a zero-coupon claim: it redeems 1:1 for the accounting asset (the asset in brackets, e.g. PT-ezETH (ETH) redeems 1 ETH worth of ezETH, not 1 ezETH) only at maturity. Selling before maturity is at market price, which moves with the implied APY: if implied APY rises after you buy, the PT price falls and you show a loss until maturity.

YT value decays toward 0 and is exactly 0 at maturity. You profit only if the yield (and points) collected exceeds the implied APY paid; if the underlying yield drops or points disappoint, YT can lose most or all of its value.

Every market has an expiry. After expiry you cannot buy PT/YT in it; unredeemed matured PT and LP keep accruing, but that yield and those points are redirected to the Pendle treasury, so redeem promptly.
PT/YT inherit all risks of the underlying yield-bearing asset and its SY wrapper (depeg, hack, slashing, issuer freezes). Newer SY contracts are upgradable proxies controlled by Pendle governance.
Swap fees scale with time to maturity (Fee Tier / 365 x days to maturity); large trades have price impact. Set minPtOut / minTokenOut / slippage; the Convert API's slippage parameter does this.
Pendle charges 5% of all YT yield (including points).
PendleRouter V4 is an upgradeable diamond (EIP-2535) controlled by Pendle; block explorers do not show its full ABI (use IPAllActionV3).
RouterStatic results are previews for off-chain use; Pendle says not to use it for fund-sensitive on-chain logic.
sPENDLE: 14-day cooldown to unstake fee-free, or 5% fee for instant unstake; rewards require meeting active-participation criteria.
notes: Markets (PT/YT/SY/LP) are created continuously and expire, so this file lists none: discover them with GET https://api-v2.pendle.finance/core/v2/markets/all or in the Pendle app (market page > contract addresses). Each market address is also its LP token. All core addresses come from the official deployments folder https://github.com/pendle-finance/pendle-core-v2-public/tree/main/deployments (files <chainId>-core.json, cited per contract), which the docs Deployments page points to. PendleRouter V4 0x888888888889758F76e7103c6CbF23ABbF58F946 is the same on every chain listed; older routers V1 0x41FAD93F225b5C1C95f2445A5d7fcB85bA46713f, V2 0x0000000001e4ef00d069e71d6ba041b0a16f7ea0 and V3 0x00000000005BBB0EF59571E58418F9a4357b68A0 still work but should not be used. Market factory: V6 is the current one (late 2025); earlier markets were created by marketFactory/V3/V4/V5 (addresses in the same file). The limit-order router is 0x000000000000c9B3E2C3Ec88B1B4c0cD853f4321 on Ethereum (field limitRouter). vePENDLE 0x4f30A9D41B80ecC5B94306AB4364951AE3170210 is listed under 'deprecated' in 1-core.json and was replaced by sPENDLE, so it is not included. Chains: the docs Deployments page lists Ethereum, Optimism, BNB, Sonic, HyperEVM, Mantle, Base, Arbitrum, Berachain, Monad, Katana and Ink; Katana (747474) and Ink (57073) files contain no router/market contracts (cross-chain PT infrastructure only), so they are left out. Plasma (9745), X Layer (196) and Robinhood Chain (4663) have full core files in the GitHub folder (and DefiLlama TVL) and are included. Unichain (130) and Tempo (4217) files have no RouterStatic/market factory and Avalanche (43114) has none of these, so they are left out. Market factories and RouterStatic are included only where listed above; for other chains the MarketFactoryV6 address is in that chain's file (key marketFactoryV6). For secondary chains PENDLE is the bridged token deployed by Pendle. Boros (Pendle's funding-rate trading venue on Arbitrum) is a separate product and not covered here. Bytecode was confirmed on every listed address via eth_getCode on 2026-11-25; router selectors were checked against the Ethereum facet bytecode.

name: Polymarket
description: Prediction market on Polygon. Agents discover markets with the Gamma API, trade outcome shares through the off-chain CLOB (EIP-712-signed orders settled on-chain by the CTF Exchange contracts), read positions from the Data API, and split/merge/redeem outcome tokens against pUSD collateral directly on-chain.

EIP-712 hash of an Order {salt, maker, signer, tokenId, makerAmount, takerAmount, side (0 BUY/1 SELL), signatureType (0 EOA,1 POLY_PROXY,2 POLY_GNOSIS_SAFE,3 POLY_1271), timestamp (ms), metadata, builder, signature}. Domain: name 'Polymarket CTF Exchange', version '2', chainId 137, verifyingContract = this address.
Reverts if the order is invalid (bad signature, filled, paused, etc.). Useful to pre-check before posting to the CLOB.

Self-pause: stops the caller's orders from being matched after a block delay (default 100 blocks). On-chain kill switch; V2 removed nonce-based on-chain cancel - cancel normally via the CLOB API.

CTF conditionId for a neg-risk questionId.
ERC1155 position (token) id for a questionId and outcome (true = YES).
Outcome-token balance (passes through to Conditional Tokens).

Convert NO positions (marketId, indexSet bitmask of questions, amount) into the complementary YES positions plus collateral. With pUSD collateral, docs route conversions through NegRiskCtfCollateralAdapter.convertPositions instead.

Required approvals: the CTF Exchange / Neg Risk Exchange to SELL, the Neg Risk Adapter for neg-risk markets, and the selected collateral adapter to merge/redeem.
Check operator approval.

USDC.e balance (6 decimals).
V2 markets: split pUSD into YES+NO. conditionId is the 31-byte V2 id (positionId >> 8); amount in 6 decimals. Approve pUSD to the Router first.

contracts.name: ExchangeV3 (Polymarket Protocol V2 order book settlement)

offchainApis.name: CLOB API (order book and trading)
offchainApis.use: Public (no auth): GET /book?token_id= (tick_size, min_order_size, neg_risk, version), prices, midpoints. L1 auth (EIP-712 ClobAuth, domain {name 'ClobAuthDomain', version '1', chainId 137}, message {address, timestamp, nonce, message 'This message attests that I control the given wallet'}; headers POLY_ADDRESS, POLY_SIGNATURE, POLY_TIMESTAMP, POLY_NONCE): POST /auth/api-key to create or GET /auth/derive-api-key to derive {apiKey, secret, passphrase}. L2 auth (headers POLY_ADDRESS, POLY_API_KEY, POLY_PASSPHRASE, POLY_TIMESTAMP, POLY_SIGNATURE = urlsafe-base64 HMAC-SHA256 keyed by base64-decoded secret over timestamp+METHOD+path+body): POST /order (one signed order), POST /orders (1-15), DELETE /order {orderID}, DELETE /orders [ids], DELETE /cancel-market-orders {asset_id|market}, DELETE /cancel-all, GET /data/orders, GET /data/order/{id}, GET /data/trades, POST /v1/heartbeats (dead-man switch). Orders are EIP-712 'Order' structs signed with domain {name 'Polymarket CTF Exchange', chainId 137, version '2' + verifyingContract CTF Exchange (neg_risk false) or Neg Risk CTF Exchange (neg_risk true); version '3' + ExchangeV3 for v2 books}. Order types GTC, GTD (expiration >= 3 min ahead), FOK, FAK; optional postOnly. BUY: makerAmount = pUSD, takerAmount = shares (6-decimal ints); SELL reversed. Use the official SDK where possible.

offchainApis.name: Gamma API (markets and events metadata)
offchainApis.use: Discover markets: GET /events/keyset, /events/{id}, /events/slug/{slug}, /markets/keyset, /markets/{id}, /markets/slug/{slug}, /public-search?q=, /tags, /series, /sports. Params: closed, limit, after_cursor, tag_id, version (v1 CTF | v2). Market fields: conditionId, clobTokenIds (v1 YES/NO token ids, JSON string), positionIds (v2), version.

offchainApis.name: Data API (positions, activity, value)
offchainApis.use: Read a wallet's positions (GET /v2/positions?user=, status OPEN default), portfolio value (/v2/value?user=), activity (/v2/activity?user=), trades, approvals state (/v2/approvals?user=), price history, holders, open interest.

offchainApis.name: Bridge API (deposits/withdrawals from other chains)
offchainApis.use: POST /deposit returns per-chain deposit addresses (evm, svm, btc, tron) for a Polymarket wallet; funds are bridged and swapped into pUSD on Polygon. GET /supported-assets lists tokens and minimums; GET /status/{address} tracks progress. Withdraw and quote endpoints are documented in the bridge section.

offchainApis.name: Geoblock check
offchainApis.use: GET returns {blocked, ip, country, region}; check before placing orders on behalf of a user.

offchainApis.name: CLOB WebSocket
offchainApis.use: Public order book, price and market lifecycle updates (incl. tick_size_change). Authenticated per-account order/trade updates at wss://ws-subscriptions-clob.polymarket.com/ws/user.

offchainApis.name: Relayer API
offchainApis.use: Submit Polymarket wallet (proxy/safe/deposit wallet) transactions without holding POL for gas.

actions.name: find markets
actions.description: Search events/markets and get token ids
actions.how: GET https://gamma-api.polymarket.com/public-search?q=... or /markets/slug/{slug}; read conditionId, clobTokenIds (v1) or positionIds (v2), version; then GET https://clob.polymarket.com/book?token_id= for tick_size and neg_risk.

actions.name: get pUSD
actions.description: Fund the trading wallet with collateral
actions.how: USDC.e.approve(CollateralOnramp, amt) then CollateralOnramp.wrap(USDC.e, to, amt); or use the Bridge API deposit addresses from other chains (auto-wraps to pUSD).

actions.name: approve trading
actions.description: One-time approvals before trading
actions.how: pUSD.approve(CTF Exchange / Neg Risk Exchange) for BUY; ConditionalTokens.setApprovalForAll(exchange, true) for SELL; for neg-risk markets also approve the Neg Risk Adapter 0xd91E80cF2E7be2e162c6513ceD06f1dD0dA35296 (pUSD and Conditional Tokens). For v2 books: pUSD.approve(ExchangeV3) and PositionManager.setApprovalForAll(ExchangeV3, true). Existing CTF approvals do not carry over to v2.

actions.name: place order
actions.description: Buy or sell outcome shares
actions.how: Derive L2 API creds (L1 ClobAuth signature), build and EIP-712-sign an Order for the correct exchange domain, POST https://clob.polymarket.com/order with L2 headers and {order, owner: apiKey, orderType: GTC|GTD|FOK|FAK}.

actions.name: cancel order
actions.description: Cancel one, several or all orders
actions.how: DELETE https://clob.polymarket.com/order {orderID}, DELETE /orders, DELETE /cancel-market-orders, or DELETE /cancel-all, with L2 headers. On-chain emergency: exchange.pauseUser().

actions.name: read positions
actions.description: List a wallet's positions and value
actions.how: GET https://data-api.polymarket.com/v2/positions?user=<address> and /v2/value?user=; on-chain ConditionalTokens.balanceOf(user, tokenId).

actions.name: split / merge
actions.description: Mint or burn complete YES+NO sets
actions.how: v1 standard: CtfCollateralAdapter.splitPosition/mergePositions(pUSD, 0x0, conditionId, [1,2], amount); v1 neg-risk: NegRiskCtfCollateralAdapter (same signatures); v2: Router.split/merge(bytes31 conditionId, amount).

actions.name: redeem
actions.description: Claim pUSD for winning shares after resolution
actions.how: v1: CtfCollateralAdapter or NegRiskCtfCollateralAdapter .redeemPositions(pUSD, 0x0, conditionId, [1,2]) after ConditionalTokens.setApprovalForAll(adapter, true); v2: Router.redeem(conditionId, outcomeIndex, amount) after PositionManager.setApprovalForAll(Router, true).

actions.name: withdraw
actions.description: Turn pUSD back into USDC.e
actions.how: pUSD.approve(CollateralOfframp, amt) then CollateralOfframp.unwrap(USDC.e, to, amt); or use the Bridge API withdraw flow to other chains.

risks: Geographic restrictions (official geoblock docs, 'due to regulatory requirements and compliance with international sanctions'): fully blocked (frontend and API, no new or closing orders) in Iran, Syria, Cuba, North Korea, and Crimea/Donetsk/Luhansk; close-only on frontend AND API in many countries incl. United States, United Kingdom, France, Germany, Italy, Belgium, Poland, Australia, Singapore, Taiwan, Thailand, Russia, Brazil, Argentina, New Zealand, Canada (Ontario, Quebec, British Columbia, Alberta) and others; close-only on frontend only in Ireland, Japan, Netherlands, South Korea, Malta (sports). Check GET https://polymarket.com/api/geoblock before trading.

Polymarket migrated to pUSD collateral and Protocol V2: markets can be v1 (CTF) or v2 (PositionManager); they use different exchanges, EIP-712 domain versions ('2' vs '3'), approvals and split/merge contracts. Check the market's version and neg_risk before acting.
Orders priced off the current tick size are rejected; GTD orders expire one minute before their stated expiration.
Resolution relies on oracles (UMA Optimistic Oracle adapters, OracleAggregator); disputes can delay payouts.
Exchange contracts are operator-matched and admin-pausable; pUSD and USDC.e wrap/unwrap revert while paused.
pUSD is backed 1:1 by USDC per Polymarket, but it is a Polymarket-issued, upgradeable token with no external listing.
notes: All addresses are Polygon mainnet (137) from https://docs.polymarket.com/resources/contracts. The Polymarket/ctf-exchange-v2 GitHub README lists different addresses for CtfCollateralAdapter (0xADa100874d00e3331D00F2007a9c336a65009718) and NegRiskCtfCollateralAdapter (0xAdA200001000ef00D07553cEE7006808F895c6F1) than the docs; this file uses the docs' addresses, which the docs' positions guide also uses. Other official contracts not detailed here: PermissionedRamp 0xebC2459Ec962869ca4c0bd1E06368272732BCb08, Deposit Wallet Factory 0x00000000000Fb5C9ADea0298D729A0CB3823Cc07, Polymarket Proxy Factory 0xaB45c5A4B0c941a2F231C04C3f49182e1A254052, BinaryModule/NegRiskModule/CombinatorialModule (V2), UmaCtfAdapter v3.1.0 0x157Ce2d672854c848c9b79C49a8Cc6cc89176a49, V2 oracle modules - see the contracts page. The older v1 exchanges (e.g. Neg Risk CTF Exchange 0xC5d563A36AE78145C45a50134d48A1215220f80a in the neg-risk-ctf-adapter repo) are no longer listed in the docs. Exchange V2 removed fillOrder/fillOrders and nonce-based on-chain cancel; only the operator calls matchOrders. ExchangeV3 and AutoRedeemer ABIs were not confirmed, so no key functions are listed for them. Withheld until Polymarket resolves a mismatch: the collateral adapters (CtfCollateralAdapter, NegRiskCtfCollateralAdapter) have different addresses in the docs (0xAdA100Db00Ca00073811820692005400218FcE1f, 0xadA2005600Dec949baf300f4C6120000bDB6eAab) and in the ctf-exchange-v2 GitHub README. Check https://docs.polymarket.com before using them.

name: Pump
description: pump.fun memecoin launchpad on Solana. An agent can create coins on the Pump bonding-curve program, buy and sell coins on their bonding curve, migrate completed curves, and trade or provide liquidity on the PumpSwap AMM after migration.

keyFunctions.signature: create_v2(name: string, symbol: string, uri: string, creator: pubkey, is_mayhem_mode: bool, is_cashback_enabled?: bool, creator_fee_bps?: u16, is_holder_reward?: bool)
keyFunctions.description: Create a new coin as a Token-2022 mint (6 decimals) with its bonding curve. name <= 32 chars, symbol <= 13, uri <= 200. is_cashback_enabled is deprecated and must be false; creator_fee_bps applies only to custom-pair coins; trailing optional args may be omitted. Payer pays rent in SOL.

keyFunctions.signature: create(name: string, symbol: string, uri: string, creator: pubkey)
keyFunctions.description: Legacy coin creation (SPL Token + Metaplex metadata). creator is added to the metadata creators array and need not sign. Prefer create_v2.
Buy exactly `amount` coins (base units) from the bonding curve, spending at most max_sol_cost lamports. Legacy instruction, still works.
Sell exactly `amount` coins to the bonding curve for at least min_sol_output lamports. Legacy instruction, still works.

keyFunctions.signature: buy_v3(amount: u64, max_sol_cost: u64, partial_fill?: OptionBool)
keyFunctions.description: Newest buy: exact base amount out, max quote in (fees included). Supports non-SOL quote mints. partial_fill only applies to mayhem coins. Fails on cashback coins (use v2).

keyFunctions.signature: buy_exact_quote_in_v3(spendable_quote_in: u64, min_tokens_out: u64, partial_fill?: OptionBool)
keyFunctions.description: Spend an exact quote amount (fees included) for at least min_tokens_out coins.
Newest sell: exact base amount in, minimum quote out after fees.
v2 trade instructions; still supported and required for cashback coins (v3 rejects them with CashbackCoinNotSupported).
Permissionless, idempotent: move a completed bonding curve (real_token_reserves == 0) into a PumpSwap pool (index 0); LP tokens are burned.
Permissionless: sweep the creator vault (PDA ["creator-vault", creator]) to the creator. Not usable when the creator vault has moved to a Pump Fees sharing_config.
Read global config: fee recipients, initial curve parameters, fee bps, enable_migrate, pool_migration_fee.

Read virtual/real token and SOL reserves, token_total_supply, complete flag, creator, quote_mint, is_mayhem_mode. Used to quote prices off-chain (Uniswap-V2-style constant product on virtual reserves).
Buy exactly base_amount_out base tokens from a pool, paying at most max_quote_amount_in quote. Fees: 20 bps LP + 5 bps protocol (plus creator fee where applicable).
Sell exactly base_amount_in base tokens for at least min_quote_amount_out quote.
v2 trade instructions (same arguments; buy_exact_quote_in_v2(spendable_quote_in, min_base_amount_out)). v1 keeps working; cashback-coin pools must use v1.
Multi-hop swap across PumpSwap pools; see docs/instructions/MULTI_HOP_SWAP.md for accounts and args.

keyFunctions.signature: create_pool(index, creator, baseMint, quoteMint, baseIn, quoteIn)
keyFunctions.description: Create a pool for (base_mint, quote_mint); pool PDA from (index, creator, base_mint, quote_mint). Initial amounts set the price; creator receives LP tokens.
Mint exactly lp_token_amount_out LP tokens spending at most the given base/quote. No fee.
Burn LP tokens for at least the given base/quote. No fee.
Permissionless: sweep the coin creator vault ATA (authority PDA ["creator_vault", coin_creator]) to the creator's token account.
Read fee config and the 8 protocol_fee_recipients (pick one at random per buy/sell).
Read pool mints, vaults, lp_supply, coin_creator, virtual_quote_reserves. Effective quote reserves = quote vault balance + virtual_quote_reserves.
Compute the fee tier (protocol / LP / creator bps) that applies to a trade.
Set up creator fee sharing for a coin (moves creator fees to a sharing_config); see docs/instructions/CREATOR_FEE_SHARING.md.
Update the shareholders/shares of a fee sharing config (sharing authority only).

actions.name: launch-coin
actions.description: Create a new pump.fun coin
actions.how: Pump program create_v2(name, symbol, uri, creator, is_mayhem_mode=false); or @pump-fun/pump-sdk helpers

actions.name: buy-on-curve
actions.description: Buy a coin still on its bonding curve
actions.how: Pump program buy_v3(amount, max_sol_cost) or buy_exact_quote_in_v3(spendable_quote_in, min_tokens_out); check BondingCurve.complete is false first

actions.name: sell-on-curve
actions.description: Sell a coin on its bonding curve
actions.how: Pump program sell_v3(amount, min_sol_output)

actions.name: migrate
actions.description: Graduate a completed curve to PumpSwap
actions.how: Pump program migrate() (permissionless) once BondingCurve.complete is true

actions.name: swap-after-graduation
actions.description: Trade a graduated coin
actions.how: PumpSwap buy_v2/sell_v2/buy_exact_quote_in_v2 on the canonical pool (index 0); or @pump-fun/pump-swap-sdk

actions.name: add-liquidity
actions.description: LP on PumpSwap
actions.how: PumpSwap deposit(lp_out, max_base_in, max_quote_in); remove with withdraw(lp_in, min_base_out, min_quote_out)

actions.name: claim-creator-fees
actions.description: Collect creator fees
actions.how: Pump collect_creator_fee_v2 (curve) and PumpSwap collect_coin_creator_fee (AMM)

risks: Memecoins: extreme volatility, most coins go to ~zero; no vetting of creators.

Bonding-curve buys/sells pay a 100 bps base fee per the program README; PumpSwap charges 20 bps LP + 5 bps protocol plus a creator fee; actual fee tiers are dynamic (read via Pump Fees fee_config / get_fees or the SDK's computeFeesBps).
Coins created with create_v2 are Token-2022 mints; use the Token-2022 program (TokenzQdBNbLqP5VEhdkAS6EPFLC1PHnBqCXEpPxuEb) for their token accounts.

Programs are upgradeable by Pump; account layouts gain appended fields over time (missing trailing fields read as 0/false), and required accounts on buy/sell have changed before (e.g. fee accounts became mandatory Sept 2025). Build from the latest IDL/SDK.
Mayhem-mode and cashback coins behave differently (cashback coins must use v2 on the curve and v1 on PumpSwap; new cashback coins cannot be created).
notes: Only Solana is confirmed by Pump's official docs (both programs: same ID on mainnet and devnet). DefiLlama lists more chains for 'pump', but no official Pump source found confirming other deployments, so they are left out. Official IDLs: https://github.com/pump-fun/pump-public-docs/tree/main/idl (pump.json, pump_amm.json, pump_fees.json); official TypeScript SDKs @pump-fun/pump-sdk and @pump-fun/pump-swap-sdk. PumpSwap create_pool/deposit/withdraw signatures are written as in PUMP_SWAP_README.md (accounts and args mixed); check pump_amm.json for exact arg names/types. Other addresses from the docs: Mayhem program MAyhSmzXzV1pTf7LsNkrNwkWKTo4ougAJ1PPg47MD4e; Pump Fees fee_config for the Pump program 8Wf5TiAheLUqBrKXeYg2JtAFFMWtKdG2BSFgqUcPVwTt and for PumpSwap 5PHirr8joyTMp9JMm6nW7hNDVyEYdkzDqazxPD7RaTjx. PumpSwap protocol fee recipients are listed in PUMP_SWAP_README.md. No official public REST API is documented; the PUMP token mint was not confirmed from an official Pump source and is omitted.

name: Renzo
description: Liquid restaking on EigenLayer: deposit ETH or stETH on Ethereum for non-rebasing ezETH (value rises against ETH), redeem through the WithdrawQueue (request, cooldown, claim), or mint ezETH directly on L2s (Arbitrum, Base, Linea, BNB Chain, Mode) through xRenzoDeposit contracts. ezETH is an xERC20 on L2s, backed 1:1 by ezETH locked in the Ethereum lockbox. REZ is the governance token.

keyFunctions.description: Deposit ETH (msg.value) and mint ezETH to msg.sender at the current rate (ezETH out = ETH value * ezETH supply / total TVL). No slippage parameter: compare with calculateTVLs() first. Reverts while paused.
Same as depositETH() with a referral id (0 if none).

Deposit an accepted collateral token (approve RestakeManager first) and mint ezETH. Amount in token base units. On 2026-11-25 the only collateral token was stETH (0xae7ab96520DE3A18E5e111B5EaAb095312D7fE84); check getCollateralTokensLength()/collateralTokens(i). actions.name: restake ETH for ezETH (Ethereum)
actions.description: Mint ezETH from ETH on Ethereum.
actions.how: RestakeManager.depositETH() with ETH value. Check paused() first; expected ezETH = amount * ezETH.totalSupply() / calculateTVLs()[2].

actions.name: restake stETH for ezETH
actions.description: Mint ezETH from stETH.
actions.how: stETH.approve(RestakeManager, amount) then RestakeManager.deposit(stETH, amount).

actions.name: mint ezETH on an L2
actions.description: Mint ezETH directly on Arbitrum, Base, Linea (ETH or WETH), Mode (ETH or WETH) or BNB Chain (Binance-Peg ETH).
actions.how: xRenzoDeposit.depositETH(minOut, deadline) with ETH value, or approve WETH and call deposit(...) (signature differs per chain, see contracts). Set minOut from getMintRate() minus the bridge fee.

actions.name: redeem ezETH (standard)
actions.description: Redeem ezETH for ETH at the protocol rate with a cooldown.
actions.how: ezETH.approve(WithdrawQueue, amount); WithdrawQueue.withdraw(amount, 0xEeeeeEeeeEeEeeEeEeEeeEEEeeeeEeeeeeeeEEeE); after coolDownPeriod() (14 days on 2026-11-25) find the request index via getOutstandingWithdrawRequests/withdrawRequests and call claim(index, user).

actions.name: redeem ezETH instantly
actions.description: Redeem immediately for a 1% fee when the buffer allows.
actions.how: Check InstantWithdrawer.getQuote(amount, 0xEeee…) succeeds; ezETH.approve(InstantWithdrawer, amount); InstantWithdrawer.withdraw(amount, 0xEeee…, minOut).

actions.name: exit on an L2
actions.description: There is no withdraw contract on L2s.
actions.how: Sell ezETH on a DEX, or bridge it to Ethereum (Renzo app bridge, powered by Hyperlane), convert xezETH to ezETH with Lockbox.withdraw if needed, then use the WithdrawQueue.

actions.name: stake REZ
actions.description: Stake REZ for governance/rewards.
actions.how: REZ.approve(REZ Staking, amount); stake(amount). Unstake with unStake(amount), then claim(index) after coolDownPeriod().

risks: ezETH is restaked through EigenLayer; operator/AVS slashing can reduce the backing and the ezETH rate.

Standard withdrawals are slow: the on-chain cooldown was 14 days on 2026-11-25 (docs say 7 days if the buffer has assets, 10-15 days otherwise), and requests larger than the buffer wait until it is refilled. The ETH amount is fixed at request time and can only go down at claim.

Instant withdrawals cost a fee (1% on 2026-11-25) and revert when the buffer is near its drawdown limit; on 2026-11-25 the buffer (about 103 ETH) was below the 500 ETH limit, so instant withdrawals were unavailable.
L2 ezETH is minted against an oracle price relayed from Ethereum; deposited ETH is bridged to Ethereum later. L2 ezETH depends on the xERC20 lockbox and bridge mint limits.
Contracts are upgradeable proxies; admin roles can pause deposits/withdrawals, change cooldowns, buffer targets and fees. A risk oracle can lengthen the withdrawal cooldown.
Renzo takes 10% of restaking rewards (split between treasury and node operators).
ezETH trades on DEXs and can trade below its backing rate when withdrawal demand is high.
pzETH and ezSOL minting is discontinued; only withdrawals via the app remain (pzETH 14-21 days, ezSOL about 2 epochs with a 0.2% fee).
Audits listed by Renzo: Halborn (2023, 2024), Sigma Prime (2024), Code4rena (2024), Nethermind (2025).
notes: Main ezETH contracts (RestakeManager, ezETH, WithdrawQueue, lockbox, xezETH) and L2 ezETH/REZ/pzETH tokens are from the Renzo docs contract pages. The docs list xRenzoDeposit 0xf25484650484DE3d554fB0b7125e7696efA4ab99 for Arbitrum and Base and 0x4D7572040B84b41a6AA2efE4A93eFFF182388F88 for Linea, but on those chains these are now deprecated stubs whose newRenzoDeposit() points to the new contracts listed here (0x2EfA… Arbitrum, 0x766A… Base, 0x657e… Linea); the new addresses and the InstantWithdrawer come from the official Renzo app config (app.renzoprotocol.com JS bundle; the chunk name changes with app releases) and match newRenzoDeposit() on-chain. The docs' Ethereum page prints pzETH truncated; the address used is the one in the docs' Etherscan link, which has code. Left out: xRenzoBridge, xERC20 factory, DepositQueue and RenzoOracle (internal, not called by users), EigenLayer StrategyManager (EigenLayer's contract), ezREZ, ezEIGEN, ezBTC, bzSOL, ezJTO and reserve vaults (smaller or separate products), Renzo on Ink (app lists a deposit contract but the docs list no Ink ezETH), and Sei RedETH. Optimism and Blast ezETH appear on DefiLlama but are not on the docs pages, so they are left out. The 24 Apr 2024 ezETH depeg is not described on the Renzo docs pages read, so it is not cited as a fact here. The docs say the WithdrawQueue buffer delay is 3 days, but coolDownPeriod() returned 14 days on-chain on 2026-11-25. No official public HTTP API is documented. Function signatures come from Sourcify-verified sources of the current implementations (Mode deposit implementation unverified; selectors checked in bytecode).

name: Rocket Pool

offchainApis.name: Rocket Pool stats payload
offchainApis.use: Protocol stats used by rocketpool.net: rethAPR (percent, e.g. "1.849" = 1.85%), depositPoolBalance, rethCollateral (ETH available for burns), megapool queue sizes, ethStakingTotal, RPL price. Read-only.

actions.name: stake ETH for rETH
actions.description: Mint rETH from ETH at the protocol rate.
actions.how: Resolve the deposit pool: RocketStorage.getAddress(keccak256(abi.encodePacked("contract.address","rocketDepositPool"))) (0xCE15294273CFb9D9b628F4D61636623decDF4fdC on 2026-11-25). Check amount <= getMaximumDepositAmount() and >= getMinimumDeposit(); call deposit() with ETH value. Expected rETH = rETH.getRethValue(amount * (1 - 0.0005)).

actions.name: redeem rETH (burn)
actions.description: Redeem rETH for ETH directly from the protocol.
actions.how: Check rETH.getTotalCollateral() >= rETH.getEthValue(amount); then rETH.burn(amount). If collateral is insufficient (the usual case, ~0 on 2026-11-25), sell instead.

actions.name: sell rETH
actions.description: Exit rETH via DEX liquidity.
actions.how: On Ethereum: rETH.approve(RocketSwapRouter, amount); eth_call optimiseSwapFrom(amount, 10) for portions; swapFrom(portions[0], portions[1], minOut, idealOut, amount). Or use any DEX/aggregator (docs mention CoW Swap, Balancer, Uniswap). On L2s swap on a DEX; compare against the L2 RocketPriceOracle.rate().

actions.name: buy rETH via router
actions.description: Get rETH through the best of deposit pool and DEXs.
actions.how: eth_call RocketSwapRouter.optimiseSwapTo(amount, 10); swapTo(portions[0], portions[1], minOut, idealOut) with ETH value.

actions.name: restake rETH on EigenLayer
actions.description: Deposit rETH into the EigenLayer rETH strategy.
actions.how: rETH.approve(EigenLayer StrategyManager 0x858646372CC42E1A627fcE94aa7A7033e7CF075A, amount); StrategyManager.depositIntoStrategy(0x1BeE69b7dFFfA4E2d53C2a2Df135C388AD25dCD2, rETH, amount). See the eigencloud entry.

actions.name: value rETH
actions.description: Get ETH value of rETH.
actions.how: Ethereum: rETH.getEthValue(amount) or getExchangeRate(). L2s: RocketPriceOracle.rate() * amount / 1e18 (check lastUpdated()).

risks: Deposit pool cap: deposit() reverts when the amount exceeds getMaximumDepositAmount() or deposits are disabled; the cap was 6,000,000 ETH (plenty of room) on 2026-11-25 but is set by the pDAO.

rETH burn needs ETH collateral: burn() only works up to getTotalCollateral() (rETH contract balance + deposit pool excess). Collateral was ~0 on 2026-11-25, so exits generally go through DEX liquidity and can trade below the protocol rate.
Deposits pay a 0.05% fee (getDepositFee) and mint at the Oracle DAO rate.
Node operator risk: ETH is run by permissionless node operators (megapools/minipools) who bond their own ETH; slashing or poor performance beyond the bond can reduce rETH backing.
Oracle DAO risk: the rETH rate and balances are reported by the Oracle DAO (trusted node set) about daily; a wrong or stale report affects mint/burn prices.
Upgrades: contracts are replaced (not proxied) through pDAO/oDAO governance; always resolve addresses from RocketStorage. rETH and RPL token contracts are not upgradeable.

L2 rETH/RPL are bridged tokens (Arbitrum and Polygon versions are bridge proxies); there is no deposit or burn on L2s, and their value depends on the canonical bridges. L2 rates come from Rocket Pool price oracles updated via bridge messages.
notes: RocketStorage, rETH, RPL and the deposit pool addresses are from the official docs Contracts & Integrations page (list dated 11/11/2026). RocketDepositPool, rocketTokenRETH, rocketTokenRPL, rocketNetworkBalances and rocketDAOProtocolSettingsDeposit were also resolved on 2026-11-25 by calling RocketStorage.getAddress(keccak256(abi.encodePacked("contract.address", name))) on-chain, and matched the docs (deposit pool v1.4 / Saturn 1, version() = 4). RocketSwapRouter is listed on the docs page but is not registered in RocketStorage (docs footnote). L2 rETH/RPL addresses are from the docs token table; L2 RocketPriceOracle addresses are from the official rocket-pool oracle repos (README deployment tables); all were checked for code and returned current rates on 2026-11-25. Also officially listed but left out to keep scope: rETH on zkSync Era (0x32Fd44bB869620C0EF993754c8a00Be67C464806), Scroll (0x53878B874283351D26d206FA512aEcE1Bef6C0dD), Unichain (0x94Cac393f3444cEf63a651FfC18497E7e8bd036a), Starknet, RPL on zkSync, the L1 price messengers and Balancer rate providers (Optimism 0x658843BB859B7b85cEAb5cF77167e3F0a78dFE7f, Base 0x039f7205c2cba4535c2575123ac3d657263892c4, Arbitrum 0xd4E96eF8eee8678dBFf4d535E033Ed1a4F7605b7, Polygon 0xA73ec45Fe405B5BFCdC0bF4cbc9014Bb32a01cd2; getRate() returns the same rate), and node-operator, megapool and DAO contracts. The via-l2 guide still says only Optimism and Arbitrum are supported for L2 swaps, while the contracts page lists more chains. api.rocketpool.net/api/mainnet/payload is the endpoint the official rocketpool.net site loads (seen in its JS bundle); /api/mainnet/apr on the same host returns only yearlyAPR but was not seen referenced by the site. Signatures come from Sourcify-verified sources.

actions.description: Get USDat without KYC
actions.how: Swap USDC->USDat on the Curve pool 0xF4d0CF32908b2C7f1021339c43Df0F77f06896d7 (Ethereum) or USDT->USDat on PancakeSwap (BSC). Direct 1:1 minting needs KYC and an approved wallet.

actions.name: deposit
actions.description: Deposit USDat into sUSDat
actions.how: USDat.approve(sUSDat, amount) then sUSDat.depositWithMinShares(amount, receiver, minShares) (or deposit(amount, receiver))

actions.name: request-withdrawal
actions.description: Queue an sUSDat withdrawal
actions.how: sUSDat.requestRedeem(shares, minSharePrice); returns requestId / NFT receipt in the Withdraw contract

actions.name: claim
actions.description: Claim USDat after processing
actions.how: Withdraw.getUserRequests(user) then Withdraw.claim(tokenId) once status is processed

actions.name: cancel
actions.description: Cancel or reprice a pending request
actions.how: Withdraw.cancelRequest(tokenId) or Withdraw.updateMinSharePrice(tokenId, newMin)

risks: Direct USDat minting requires KYC and an approved wallet (official FAQ); sUSDat deposits/withdrawals do not use that list but "can still be restricted".
sUSDat is not a staked stablecoin: its value moves with STRC price and dividends (100% STRC exposure via Ondo STRCon); returns and a fixed price are not guaranteed.
sUSDat withdrawals are asynchronous (request -> operator processing -> claim); target same-day/T+1 but not guaranteed, not necessarily FIFO, and pay USDat, not USDC. Minimum request 10 shares.
Fees: Regular mode 0% deposit / 0.10% withdraw; Elevated mode 0.25% / 0.50%; the fee in effect at processing applies.

USDat can freeze accounts and force-transfer from frozen accounts; sUSDat has a blacklist and seize function; both are upgradeable (EIP-1967) and pausable. Docs: authorized roles can upgrade contracts, change fees, pause actions or restrict accounts.
Restricted jurisdictions apply (see docs).
notes: Identified via DefiLlama (Saturn: 'Bitcoin-backed credit protocol', url app.saturn.credit, twitter saturn_credit, Certora audit 'Saturn Dollar M0 Extensions'); chains Ethereum, Monad, BSC. All addresses come from Saturn's official Key Addresses page. That page gives no function documentation, so keyFunctions were taken from the Sourcify-verified ABIs of those addresses (USDat, sUSDat and Withdraw are EIP-1967 proxies); the SwapFacility source is not verified, so no functions are listed for it. Mint/redeem routes for USDat run through the app (M0 orders, approved-wallet swaps); the low-level wrap/unwrap calls are not documented for end users and are omitted. BSC and Monad tokens are bridged (Chainlink's CCIP directory lists sUSDat); the docs say routes may differ there. DefiLlama TVL also counts Saturn-co-curated Morpho vaults (Ethereum, Monad) and a Lista USDT vault (BSC), whose addresses are not on the Saturn key-addresses page and are not included. Operational wallets (Fireblocks 2-of-3 MPC) are listed on the key-addresses page but are not callable contracts.

actions.name: deposit (v1 vault)
actions.description: Deposit the vault asset and receive shares.
actions.how: Normally via the Shift app (app.shiftprotocol.xyz). On-chain: baseToken.approve(vault, amount) -> vault.reqDeposit() -> wait for Shift's oracle to call tvlFeed.updateTvlForDeposit(user, tvl, supply) (emits DepositAllowed on the vault) -> vault.deposit(amount) before the request expires (requestValidity, 40 s at research time). Without Shift's off-chain oracle the deposit cannot complete.

actions.name: request withdrawal
actions.description: Queue shares for redemption.
actions.how: vault.reqWithdraw(shares). Check vault.getWithdrawStatus() (eth_call with from = user) until status 3.

actions.name: claim withdrawal
actions.description: Receive the base asset.
actions.how: vault.withdraw() once unlockTime has passed and the batch is resolved.

actions.name: cancel withdrawal
actions.description: Undo a request still in the open batch.
actions.how: vault.cancelWithdraw()

actions.name: read share price / TVL
actions.description: Value a position.
actions.how: vault.getSharePrice() (asset decimals) x vault.balanceOf(user)/1e18; history via tvlFeed.getLastTvlEntries(n).

risks: Custodial-style execution: deposit() transfers assets directly to the vault's executor address, which was an EOA (no contract code) for all four vaults at research time; the strategy then runs off-chain on perp venues (Extended/Starknet, GRVT, Lighter, Hibachi). Share value depends on an oracle-reported TVL, not on assets held by the contract.

Admin powers (ShiftAccessControl roles): DEFAULT_ADMIN can pause, change fees, timelock, max TVL, min deposit, executor and fee collector, and toggle a whitelist; ORACLE_ROLE pushes TVL (sets share price); EXECUTOR_ROLE resolves withdrawal batches and sets the redemption rate.
Withdrawals are not instant: timelock (7 days for extUSD v1, vGRVT, hibaUSD; 4 days for ltLLP) plus batch resolution by the executor; these are minimums, not deadlines.
getSharePrice() returns 0 when TVL data is stale (older than freshness()).
Strategies carry funding, basis, liquidation, venue/custody, bridge and depeg risk; docs say partial or total loss of principal is possible.
Audits: SB Security review of the v1 contracts (2025, in the GitHub repo); the docs Audits page also lists v2 reports. Audits do not cover the off-chain strategy.
Vault contracts are not proxies (immutable bytecode), but the parameters above are mutable by the admin.
notes: Vault and TVL-feed addresses come from Shift's own public API (pub-api.shiftprotocol.xyz, the backend used by shiftprotocol.xyz); the docs site lists no addresses. Each one was checked on-chain on 2026-11-24/25: it has code, name/symbol match (extUSD, vGRVT, ltLLP, hibaUSD), baseToken() = USDC (Base 0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913, Arbitrum 0xaf88d065e77c8cC2239327C5EDb3A432268e5831) or USD₮0 (0xFd086bC7CD5C481DCC9C85ebE478A1C0b69FCbb9), tvlFeed() matches and feed.shiftVault() points back, and all listed function selectors are in the bytecode. Signatures come from the official ShiftVault.sol / ShiftTvlFeed.sol source (repo main, Feb 2026); the deployed vaults report version 1.1.0 in the API. LEFT OUT: (1) risexUSDC, the Ethereum v2 (ERC-4626, async request/settle/claim) vault: Shift's API lists it (vaultId 6, chainId 1) without an address and no official page gives one, so it is omitted (DefiLlama's adapter lists 0x5F70E536190C15E5959DbFeF2F2632E540da74CD but that is not an official source). Ethereum is therefore in `chains` with no contract listed. (2) shiftEUR (v2, Ethereum, deprecated) and ltPARA/sltPARA (Base, decommissioned): no official address. (3) Pendle markets for Shift assets are standard Pendle contracts (addresses in the API's pendleMarket field) and belong to Pendle. (4) Executor EOAs and the access-control contract are not things an agent calls. Shift also runs on Starknet (Extended executor) and Robinhood Chain per the API, but no user-facing contracts there.

actions.name: deposit-splus

actions.description: Acquire SIERRA without AP status

actions.how: vault.getLYTPoolAccountState(holder) or balanceOf(holder) * exchangeRate() / 1e18 (result in USDC, 6 decimals).

actions.name: bridge-sierra
actions.description: Bridge OFT SIERRA from Ethereum to Avalanche
actions.how: fee = OFT.quoteSend((30106, bytes32(recipient), amount, minAmount, 0x, 0x, 0x), false); OFT.send(sendParam, fee, refund) with msg.value = fee.nativeFee.

risks: Custodial/off-chain reserves: deposited USDC goes to a treasury wallet (Fireblocks MPC) and is deployed through OpenTrade into RWA (T-bill MMFs, commercial paper, AAA CLOs, trade finance, corporate bonds) and DeFi (Morpho, Aave etc.) yield sources; holders rely on Sierra Reserve Limited (BVI) and the OpenTrade Cayman SPC structure, not onchain collateral.

Redemptions are not instant: requestRedeem then the issuer processes it (SLA 3 business days for SIERRA, 7 for SPLUS; usually same day). SPLUS charges 10 bps. Daily mint limits and per-wallet/vault request caps apply.
Exchange rate is set onchain by the Sierra/OpenTrade issuer role (setExchangeRate), not computed trustlessly; a wrong or delayed update affects mint/redeem prices.

Admin powers: vaults are upgradeable beacon proxies (same beacon for SIERRA and SPLUS on Ethereum); admins can pause, set rates, process/cancel redemptions and blacklist addresses (BlacklistedAddress, restricted jurisdictions).

SIERRA minting/redeeming at the vault is limited to whitelisted Authorized Participants (deposit reverts NotMarketMaker for others); retail exits depend on DEX liquidity and can trade below the exchange rate.

Two different SIERRA tokens exist on Ethereum: the native vault 0xBcEb... and the LayerZero OFT 0x6bf7... bridged from Avalanche. Native Ethereum SIERRA and Avalanche SIERRA are separate vaults with different exchange rates. Bridged SIERRA also depends on LayerZero (5/5 DVN config per docs).
Audits: OpenTrade LYT protocol audited by Cantina/Spearbit (Aug 2025, no high/critical findings; and Oct 2026). Underlying OpenTrade vaults audited separately.
notes: All four addresses are from Sierra's docs (Blockchain Addresses page; SPLUS also on the Smart Contract Integration page) and were checked onchain on 2026-11-25: SIERRA Ethereum (6 dec, ~25.9M supply, exchangeRate ~1.047), SPLUS (~6.6M, ~1.014), SIERRA Avalanche (~0.84M, ~1.050), SIERRA OFT on Ethereum (~0.50M). The three vaults are OpenZeppelin beacon proxies; the Ethereum implementation (LYTPool) is verified on Sourcify; the Avalanche implementation (0x51c3f2Ce5CA90687d4FcBd51d608909d62C03dFd) is not verified, but every LYTPool selector is present in its bytecode. Left out: the Avalanche-side LayerZero peer of the OFT (0xc472d3a47719de5f9d808ca91d7b70bd2138bcaa, read from OFT.peers(30106)) because no official page lists it; Plume (listed by DefiLlama) because the docs list no Plume contract; access-control, controller and treasury contracts (admin-only). Docs say 'SIERRA and SPLUS... the vault is permissionless' on the integration page but the SIERRA Mint & Redeem page requires Authorized Participant whitelisting, and onchain simulation confirms SIERRA deposit is gated. Amounts: assets and shares 6 decimals, exchange rate 18 decimals. Sierra also runs a GitBook MCP server for its docs (https://docs.sierra.money/~gitbook/mcp). A governance token (SGT) is announced but not live.

actions.name: MKR -> SKY
actions.description: Upgrade MKR to SKY at 1:24000 minus the Delayed Upgrade Penalty.
actions.how: Read MkrSky.fee(); call MkrSky 0xA1Ea1bA18E88C381C724a75F23a130420C403f9a .mkrToSky(recipient, mkrAmt). No approval needed. One-way.

actions.name: stake USDS for rewards
actions.description: Stake USDS in a Sky token-rewards farm.
actions.how: Check farm.periodFinish() > now and rewardRate() > 0 (USDS->SPK 0x173e314C7635B45322cd8Cb14f44b312e079F3af was active at research time; USDS->SKY 0x0650CAF159C5A49f711e8169D4336ECB9b950275 had ended). USDS.approve(farm, amt); farm.stake(amt). Claim with getReward(); leave with exit().

risks: Governance control: Sky governance (SKY holders via executive spells) sets the SSR, DSR, PSM fees (tin/tout), farm rewards and the MKR->SKY penalty, and can halt LitePSM swaps by setting tin/tout to uint256 max. USDS, sUSDS and the bridged L2 tokens are UUPS-upgradeable proxies controlled by governance, so their logic can be changed.

LitePSM has no slippage protection: fees could change in the same block if a governance action executes first. Swaps are capped by the LitePSM DAI buffer (sellGem) and the USDC in its pocket (buyGem), and by the Spark PSM3's balances on L2.

MKR->SKY conversion is one-way and, at research time, charged a 5% Delayed Upgrade Penalty (fee() = 5e16) that governance said may increase over time; the older Sky docs token page describing a fee-free two-way converter is out of date.

USDS and DAI are backed by crypto collateral, real-world-asset vaults, USDC in the PSM and allocations to Sky 'Stars' such as Spark and Grove; a failure in collateral, USDC, or those allocations can affect the peg. Emergency shutdown is possible.
Savings rates (SSR for sUSDS, DSR for sDAI) are variable and set by governance; sDAI and sUSDS are not exchangeable 1:1 because they have different accumulated yield.

L2 USDS/sUSDS are bridged via SkyLink/canonical bridges; L2 sUSDS is a plain ERC-20 priced by a cross-chain rate oracle, and withdrawals to Ethereum through the native bridges take the rollup's challenge period (about 7 days on Arbitrum/OP Stack).
notes: Ethereum addresses come from the official Sky chainlog (chainlog.sky.money API, mirrored on-chain at 0xdA0Ab1e0017DEbCd72Be8599041a2aa3bA7e740F) and the Sky developer docs (LitePSM guide, token-governance-upgrade key info). Base USDS/sUSDS come from the Sky developer docs' SkyLink Base guide; Arbitrum USDS/sUSDS and both PSM3 contracts are only listed by Spark (a Sky 'Star' whose SubProxy is in the chainlog as SPARK_SUBPROXY), so Spark's docs are cited for them. sDAI is a Spark-issued wrapper of the Sky Pot (DSR) and is not in the Sky chainlog; Spark docs are cited. Every address was checked for code on its chain and wiring read on-chain (sUSDS.asset=USDS, DaiUsds dai/usds, MkrSky mkr/sky/rate=24000, LitePSM gem=USDC/dai=DAI/pocket, wrapper.psm=LitePSM, farms' staking/rewards tokens, PSM3 usdc/usds/susds on Base and Arbitrum). Signatures come from Sourcify-verified sources (DssLitePsm, UsdsPsmWrapper, DaiUsds, MkrSky, SUsds, StakingRewards, SavingsDai, PSM3). Mentioned but not listed: stUSDS (STUSDS 0x99CD4Ec3f88A45940936F469E4bB72A2A701EEB9, staked USDS with a variable rate funding SKY-backed borrowing; see developers.skyeco.com/protocol/tokens/stusds), LockstakeEngine (staking engine for SKY with borrowing and delegation; LOCKSTAKE_ENGINE in the chainlog), Vat/Jug/vault (CDP) contracts, SkyLink bridges (BASE_TOKEN_BRIDGE, ARBITRUM_TOKEN_BRIDGE, OPTIMISM_TOKEN_BRIDGE, UNICHAIN_TOKEN_BRIDGE in the chainlog), the legacy MKR->SKY converter V1, and USDS/sUSDS/PSM3 on Optimism and Unichain (listed on Spark's docs pages). Spark's own lending market (SparkLend) is a separate protocol, not part of this entry. The legacy PSM (MCD_PSM_USDC_A) with its separate GemJoin approval target is no longer in the chainlog; the LitePSM takes approvals on itself. MCD_GOV in the chainlog now points to SKY.

name: StackingDAO
description: Liquid staking on Stacks. Agents can deposit STX for stSTX (STX yield in the exchange rate) or stSTXbtc (1:1 with STX, yield paid in sBTC), deposit sBTC for stBTC, swap stSTX <> stSTXbtc fee-free, and exit through an instant (1% fee, idle liquidity) or cooldown withdrawal that mints a claim NFT.

keyFunctions.description: Stake STX for stSTX. stx-amount in micro-STX (1 STX = 1000000). Transfers STX from tx-sender (add an STX post-condition) and mints stSTX = stx-amount * 1e6 / get-stx-per-ststx-up. Reverts with err u26007 if fewer than min-shares-out micro-stSTX would be minted (0 = no slippage check). Returns (ok ststx-amount).

Start a standard withdrawal of ststx-amount micro-stSTX. Moves your stSTX to the core, locks STX at the current ratio and mints a withdrawal NFT (ststx-withdraw-nft-v4) to you. Returns (ok nft-id). Claimable after a fixed cooldown (currently 2,100 Bitcoin blocks, about two weeks; see withdraw-data-stx-v2.get-withdraw-unlock-burn-height).

Claim STX for a withdrawal NFT once burn-block-height >= its unlock-burn-height. tx-sender must own the NFT (err u26003 otherwise; err u26002 if still locked). Burns the NFT and the escrowed stSTX, sends STX. Returns (ok {stx-user, stx-fee}).

Instant unstake: burns ststx-amount micro-stSTX and pays STX from idle reserve liquidity right away, minus the idle fee (get-withdraw-idle-fee, 100 bps = 1% at research time). Reverts err u26006 if the reserve lacks idle STX. Returns (ok {stx-user, stx-fee}).
