actions.name: standard unstake
actions.description: Exit at full ratio after the cooldown.
actions.how: core.init-withdraw(amount) -> nft-id; wait until burn-block-height >= withdraw-data .get-withdrawals-by-nft(nft-id).unlock-burn-height (about 2 weeks for stSTX/stSTXbtc, about 4 weeks for stBTC); then core.withdraw(nft-id) from the NFT owner.

actions.name: switch stSTX <> stSTXbtc
actions.description: Change yield type without unstaking.
actions.how: swap-ststx-ststxbtc-v4.swap-ststx-for-ststxbtc(amount, min-out) or swap-ststxbtc-for-ststx(amount, min-out).

risks: Standard withdrawals take a fixed cooldown: 2,100 Bitcoin blocks (~2 weeks) for stSTX/stSTXbtc and 4,200 (~4 weeks) for stBTC at research time; governance can lengthen it (minimum 2,100 on mainnet). The withdrawal NFT must not be transferred/sold by mistake: only its owner can claim.
Instant unstake charges a 1% fee and only works while the reserve holds enough idle liquidity.

Governance (dao / dao-multisig / dao-executor) can pause deposits and each withdrawal path, change fees, and upgrade contracts by activating new versions; versioned contract names (e.g. core-stx-v2 replaced core-v6) mean integrations must follow the docs.
stBTC depends on the external sBTC token and peg (SM3VDXK3WZZSA84XXFKAFAF15NNZX32CTSG82JFQ4.sbtc-token), outside StackingDAO's control.
Secondary-market prices of stSTX/stSTXbtc on DEXs can deviate from the protocol ratio.
Audited by Clarity Alliance (PoX-5 contracts and earlier versions) and CoinFabrik; Immunefi bug bounty up to $100k. Residents of restricted countries are barred from the app.
notes: Stacks is a Clarity-VM chain (non-EVM), so vm is 'mixed' and chainId is null; addresses are Clarity contract principals (deployer.contract-name), all deployed by SP4SZE494VC2YC5JYG7AYFQ44F5Q4PYV7DVMDPBG. Function signatures are in Clarity form (name(arg type, ...)); call them with a Stacks contract-call transaction and add post-conditions for STX/sBTC/token transfers. Core, data and swap addresses come from the docs' Core Contracts pages; tokens, NFTs, tracker, withdraw-data and native pool come from the official mainnet deployment list (61 contracts) in StackingDAO/stackingdao-smart-contracts. Each listed contract was confirmed to exist via the Hiro API and live parameters (pause flags all false, idle fee 1%, ratios, cooldowns) were read on 2026-11-24. Internal contracts (reserves, strategy, stakers, signer managers, rewards, governance) are left out; see the mainnet README for them. Older cores (stacking-dao-core-v6, stacking-dao-core-btc-v3, swap-ststx-ststxbtc-v2) are superseded and should not be used.

name: StakeStone
description: Omnichain liquid staking / yield tokens: stake ETH for yield-bearing STONE (non-rebasing, price rises) and redeem it through settlement rounds or instant withdrawal; mint SBTC 1:1 from BTC wrappers (WBTC/cbBTC on Ethereum, BTCB on BNB Chain) and STONEBTC from SBTC/LBTC; hold STONEUSD, a yield-bearing stablecoin token. STONE and SBTC bridge between chains via LayerZero.

keyFunctions.description: Stake ETH (msg.value) and mint STONE to msg.sender. Returns STONE minted = amount * 1e18 / sharePrice, where sharePrice = max(last round price, current price).
Same as deposit() but mints STONE to another address.

Queue STONE (shares, 18 decimals) for redemption at the next settlement round. Approve STONE to the vault first (it transferFroms the shares). ETH becomes claimable after rollToNextRound settles the round (rounds are at least rebaseTimeInterval = 3 days apart, often longer).
Cancel (part of) a pending request made in the current round; STONE is returned. Reverts if the round has already been settled.

Withdraw ETH now. Args: _amount = ETH (wei) already claimable from a settled request (see userReceipts), _shares = STONE to redeem instantly at min(last round price, current price); shares are burned from msg.sender (no approve needed). Instant redemption is paid from idle ETH and, if short, by force-withdrawing from strategies; reverts with "still need wait" if not enough ETH. Pass 0 for the part you do not use. A withdrawFeeRate fee (1e6 = 100%) may apply. Returns ETH withdrawn.

Your withdrawal state: (withdrawRound, withdrawShares pending, withdrawableAmount in wei). Shares from a settled earlier round become claimable at that round's price; claim them with instantWithdraw(_amount, 0).
Current ETH per STONE (1e18 = 1 ETH): (idle + strategy value - reserved withdrawals) / supply. Not a view function: use eth_call. Read 1.0766 ETH on 2026-11-25.

actions.name: stake ETH for STONE
actions.description: Mint STONE on Ethereum
actions.how: StoneVault.deposit() with ETH value (or depositFor(user)). Preview: STONE ≈ amount * 1e18 / currentSharePrice() (eth_call).

actions.name: request withdrawal (slow, no slippage)
actions.description: Redeem STONE for ETH at the next settlement
actions.how: STONE.approve(StoneVault, shares); StoneVault.requestWithdraw(shares). After the round settles (check latestRoundID() increased / userReceipts), claim with StoneVault.instantWithdraw(withdrawableAmount, 0). Cancel before settlement with cancelWithdraw(shares).

actions.name: instant withdrawal
actions.description: Redeem STONE for ETH now
actions.how: StoneVault.instantWithdraw(0, shares) — burns STONE at min(last round price, current price); first check getVaultAvailableAmount() idle ETH, otherwise it pulls from strategies or reverts.

actions.name: read STONE price
actions.description: ETH per STONE
actions.how: eth_call StoneVault.currentSharePrice() (or STONE.tokenPrice() on Ethereum). Do not trust tokenPrice() on bridged chains without checking it is fresh.

actions.name: bridge STONE
actions.description: Move STONE between chains
actions.how: STONE.estimateSendFee(dstLzV1ChainId, abi.encodePacked(to), amount, false, 0x) then STONE.sendFrom(from, dstChainId, abi.encodePacked(to), amount, refund, 0x0, 0x) with msg.value = nativeFee.

actions.name: mint / redeem SBTC
actions.description: BTC wrapper <-> SBTC 1:1
actions.how: approve token to SBTCVault; SBTCVault.deposit(token, amount). Redeem: SBTCVault.withdraw(token, sbtcAmount). Check supportedTokens, pause and whitelist flags first.

actions.name: mint STONEBTC
actions.description: Deposit SBTC/LBTC into STONEBTC
actions.how: approve SBTC or LBTC to StoneBTCVault; StoneBTCVault.deposit(token, amount, minStoneBtcOut). Exit only through the StakeStone app / market maker.

risks: STONE redemption is round based: requestWithdraw is settled only when rollToNextRound runs (minimum 3 days apart; observed ~9 days between the last two settlements on 2026-11-25). Instant withdrawals depend on idle ETH and may force-withdraw from strategies, and use the lower of the last round price and the current price.

STONE price is computed by the vault from strategy valuations (StrategyController), not a market price; DEX prices can differ. Bridged STONE on BNB Chain read tokenPrice() = 1.0 on 2026-11-25 while the Ethereum price was ~1.0766: bridged-chain prices can be stale or unset, so read the Ethereum vault.

Bridged STONE (BNB Chain and many L2s) is a LayerZero v1 OFT: Ethereum STONE is locked, not burned, when bridged out; bridging has a daily quota and an enable flag; LayerZero/DVN or misconfiguration risk applies. SBTC uses LayerZero v2 adapters.

Admin powers: StoneVault and STONE owner is 0xc1364aD857462e1B60609D9e56b5E24C5c21a312 (on 2026-11-25); the owner can change the withdraw fee, rebase interval, proposal contract and migrate the vault. Strategy changes go through the OPAP proposal/vote; per the docs strategies are operated by a multisig with partners (Cobo, Coincover).

SBTC vaults have role-based admins who can pause deposits/withdrawals per token, set fees (up to MAX_FEE_RATE), caps and whitelist mode; on Ethereum SBTC mint/redeem was whitelist-only on 2026-11-25. SBTC is redeemable only for whatever BTC tokens the vault holds.

STONEBTC withdrawals cannot be requested by holders on-chain (requestWithdraw is MARKET_MAKER_ROLE only); exits go through StakeStone/market maker, documented as immediate up to seven days. TVL is very small.

STONEUSD is backed mainly by arbitrage strategies run on centralized exchanges (custodial/CEX risk); mint and weekly redemption are permissioned (KYC/KYB whitelist); the token has a blacklist and admin mint role. Its on-chain token contracts expose no exchange-rate function; the rate is shown in the StakeStone app.
Audits listed in the docs: STONE by Quantstamp (2024) and SlowMist (2023-2024), Secure3; SBTC/STONEBTC by SlowMist; STONEUSD by Quantstamp (2025).
notes: All addresses come from the official StakeStone docs address pages and were confirmed as contracts with eth_getCode on Ethereum, BNB Chain and Monad; links between contracts were cross-checked on-chain (Minter.vault() = StoneVault, STONE.minter() = Minter, SBTCVault.stoneBTC() = SBTC, adapters' token() = SBTC, StoneBTCVault.lpToken() = STONEBTC). Function signatures are from the verified Ethereum sources (Blockscout) and the docs API reference; BNB Chain contracts were checked by selector against bytecode. Scope is the three chains DefiLlama tracks (Ethereum, BSC, Monad). The docs also list STONE on Berachain, Scroll, Manta, Mode, Zircuit, Astar zkEVM, Linea, Mantle, Base, Metis, Optimism, Arbitrum, Meter, X Layer, SEI, Merlin (M-STONE), B2 (BStone) and Aptos, and SBTC on Scroll, Zircuit, BOB and Aptos: see the address pages. Left out: Minter 0xEc306E46549A7E8f4fCE823D3058f2D134133B17 (mint/burn callable only by the vault), Proposal 0x3aa0670E24Cb122e1d5307Ed74b0c44d619aFF9b on Ethereum (OPAP voting), StrategyController 0x396aBF9fF46E21694F4eF01ca77C6d7893A017B2, AssetVault 0x9485711f11B17f73f2CCc8561bcae05BDc7E9ad9, MiningPool and G-NFT (governance/internal; listed in the docs). No StakeStone mint/redeem contract for STONEUSD is published, so only the token contracts are listed. The docs API page also describes HTTP endpoints but gives no base URL, so no offchain API is listed. The LayerZero chain IDs given in function descriptions (v1: 101 Ethereum, 102 BNB Chain; v2 eids 30101/30102) are LayerZero's standard IDs, not from StakeStone docs. Same hex, different contracts: Ethereum Proposal 0x3aa0670E24Cb122e1d5307Ed74b0c44d619aFF9b is SBTCVault on BNB Chain, and Ethereum STONE 0x7122985656e38BDC0302Db86685bb972b145bD3C is the SBTC LayerZero Adapter on BNB Chain; always match address with chain.

name: Stargate V2
description: Cross-chain liquidity bridge on LayerZero V2 for same-asset transfers (USDC, USDT, ETH and others): each asset has a StargatePool (native chains) or StargateOFT (Hydra chains) contract per chain implementing the LayerZero IOFT interface. An agent quotes with quoteOFT/quoteSend and bridges with send(), choosing taxi (immediate) or bus (batched, cheaper) mode.

keyFunctions.description: Bridge ETH: send(SendParam(uint32 dstEid, bytes32 to, uint256 amountLD, uint256 minAmountLD, bytes extraOptions, bytes composeMsg, bytes oftCmd), MessagingFee(uint256 nativeFee, uint256 lzTokenFee), address refundAddress). dstEid = LayerZero V2 endpoint ID of the destination (30101 Ethereum, 30102 BSC, 30106 Avalanche, 30109 Polygon, 30110 Arbitrum, 30111 Optimism, 30184 Base, 30183 Linea). to = recipient left-padded to bytes32. oftCmd = 0x (empty) for taxi (immediate), 0x00 (bytes(1)) for bus (batched, cheaper). extraOptions/composeMsg = 0x unless composing. Set minAmountLD from quoteOFT receipt.amountReceivedLD (minus your slippage). msg.value = MessagingFee.nativeFee + amountLD (this pool's token() is address(0), so the ETH being bridged is sent as value; no approval). Returns (MessagingReceipt(bytes32 guid, uint64 nonce, MessagingFee fee), OFTReceipt(uint256 amountSentLD, uint256 amountReceivedLD)).
Same arguments and value as send(), but also returns the bus Ticket(uint72 ticketId, bytes passengerBytes) when riding the bus. Use it if you want to track or drive the bus yourself.

Returns (OFTLimit(uint256 minAmountLD, uint256 maxAmountLD) limit, OFTFeeDetail(int256 feeAmountLD, string description)[] fees, OFTReceipt(uint256 amountSentLD, uint256 amountReceivedLD) receipt). maxAmountLD is capped by the pathway's credits; feeAmountLD > 0 is a fee, < 0 a reward. Use receipt.amountReceivedLD as minAmountLD.

Returns MessagingFee(uint256 nativeFee, uint256 lzTokenFee) for the given SendParam (second arg false = pay in native gas). Call right before send(): quotes go stale with gas prices. For bus mode this returns the bus fare.
Underlying token address; address(0) means native ETH.
True if the caller must approve this contract before send() (ERC-20 pools).

Shared decimals used on the wire (6). Amounts are truncated to this precision (dust below it is not sent).
Add liquidity: deposit(receiver, amountLD) mints LP tokens (lpToken()) to receiver. For the native pool send amountLD as value.
Withdraw liquidity on this chain: redeem(amountLD, receiver) burns LP and returns the asset. Limited by redeemable(owner) and local credits.
How much of an owner's LP can be redeemed locally right now (amountLD).
Total value locked (LP-backed liquidity) in local decimals.
Token balance held by the pool in local decimals.
LP token address for this pool.
Bus fare to dstEid: quoteRideBus(dstEid, nativeDrop) returns MessagingFee(nativeFee, lzTokenFee). The pool's quoteSend already calls this for bus sends.
Low-level taxi quote: TaxiParams(address sender, uint32 dstEid, bytes32 receiver, uint64 amountSD, bytes composeMsg, bytes extraOptions), payInLzToken. Prefer the pool's quoteSend.
Bus state for dstEid: (uint8 maxNumPassengers, uint80 busFare, uint80 busAndNativeDropFare, uint16 qLength, uint72 nextTicketId). Your bus has left when nextTicketId > your ticketId.
Fee to drive (dispatch) the bus to dstEid now for the given encoded passengers.
Dispatch the queued bus to dstEid immediately by paying the remaining fare (msg.value from quoteDriveBus). Optional: buses are also driven by the planner when full or on schedule.

offchainApis.name: Stargate asset metadata
offchainApis.use: Machine-readable list of every current Stargate V2 pool/OFT: chainKey, stargateType (POOL, NATIVE, OFT), contract address, underlying token (address, symbol, decimals), assetId, tokenMessaging address, sharedDecimals. Use it to find the Stargate contract for an asset on chains not listed here.

offchainApis.name: LayerZero Value Transfer API
offchainApis.use: LayerZero's official quote-then-execute API that routes Stargate V2 (route types STARGATE_V2_TAXI and STARGATE_V2_BUS) plus OFT, CCTP and Aori: POST /quotes, POST /build-user-steps (returns the transactions to sign), GET /status/{quoteId}. x-api-key header required on those; GET /chains, /tokens and /metadata are open. Replaces the deprecated stargate.finance/api/v1 quotes API.

actions.name: bridge USDC/USDT (taxi, immediate)
actions.description: Move an ERC-20 stablecoin to the same asset on another chain
actions.how: 1) Pick the source pool (e.g. StargatePoolUSDC on Arbitrum) and dstEid (e.g. 30184 Base). 2) sendParam = (dstEid, bytes32(recipient), amountLD, amountLD, 0x, 0x, 0x). 3) eth_call quoteOFT(sendParam); set minAmountLD = receipt.amountReceivedLD minus slippage; check amountLD <= limit.maxAmountLD. 4) fee = quoteSend(sendParam, false). 5) token.approve(pool, amountLD). 6) pool.send(sendParam, (fee.nativeFee, 0), refundAddress) with value = fee.nativeFee. 7) Track delivery by the tx hash on LayerZero Scan (layerzeroscan.com).

actions.name: bridge ETH
actions.description: Move native ETH between ETH-pool chains (Ethereum, Arbitrum, Optimism, Base, Linea, ...)
actions.how: Same as above on StargatePoolNative (token() = address(0)), no approval; value = fee.nativeFee + amountLD.

actions.name: bridge by bus (cheaper, batched)
actions.description: Lower fee, delivery waits for the bus
actions.how: Use oftCmd = 0x00 (bytes(1)) in SendParam; quoteSend returns the bus fare. Funds are debited instantly on the source chain but are delivered when the bus to dstEid is driven (when full, on schedule, or when someone pays driveBus). Bus mode does not support composeMsg. Use sendToken() to get the ticketId and compare with TokenMessaging.busQueues(dstEid).nextTicketId.

actions.name: bridge to a contract with a follow-up call (compose)
actions.description: Trigger logic on the destination
actions.how: Taxi mode only: set composeMsg and add an lzCompose executor option (gas) in extraOptions via LayerZero OptionsBuilder; the receiver must implement ILayerZeroComposer.lzCompose.

actions.name: provide liquidity
actions.description: Earn fees as an LP
actions.how: approve pool, then pool.deposit(receiver, amountLD) (value = amountLD for native pool); withdraw with pool.redeem(amountLD, receiver), limited by redeemable(owner).

risks: Same-asset only: USDC bridges to USDC, ETH to ETH. Not every asset exists on every chain (e.g. no ETH pool on BSC or Polygon); check the metadata API or quoteOFT before sending.

Fees: a LayerZero messaging fee in native gas (quoteSend, paid as msg.value; overpaid value is refunded to refundAddress) plus a dynamic protocol fee or rebate on the amount, set per pathway by the AI Planning Module (see quoteOFT oftFeeDetails). Quotes go stale with gas prices; quote right before sending.

Delays: taxi is usually minutes (waits for source-chain finality and DVN verification); bus mode can take much longer because delivery waits for the bus to be driven. Source-chain debit is final immediately ('instant guaranteed finality').
Transfer size is capped by the pathway's credits (quoteOFT limit.maxAmountLD); larger sends revert. Amounts are truncated to 6 shared decimals.
Approvals: approve only the exact amount to the official pool address; pools pull tokens with transferFrom.
Wrong dstEid or a recipient that cannot receive on the destination (e.g. a contract without the right code or a non-EVM address format) can lose funds; to must be the bytes32-padded recipient.
Trust: relies on LayerZero V2 endpoints, the DVNs and executor configured by LayerZero Labs for Stargate, and the Stargate admin (pools can be paused, fees and credits are planner-controlled).
notes: Covers the main assets (ETH native pool, USDC, USDT) on Ethereum, BSC, Avalanche, Polygon, Arbitrum, Optimism, Base and Linea from Stargate's official V2 mainnet contracts page, each cross-checked against the official metadata API (mainnet.stargate-api.com) and spot-checked for bytecode. The full per-chain list (Mantle, Scroll, Kava, Metis, Aurora, Core, Sonic, Unichain, Gnosis, Soneium and Hydra OFT chains such as Kaia, Iota, Taiko, Sei, etc., plus mETH and EURC pools on Ethereum) lives at https://stargateprotocol.gitbook.io/stargate/v2-developer-docs/technical-reference/mainnet-contracts and https://mainnet.stargate-api.com/v1/metadata?version=v2. Left out on purpose: (1) the USDT pools on Arbitrum (0xcE8CcA271Ebc0533920C83d39F417ED6A0abB7D0), Optimism (0x19cFCE47eD54a88614648DC3f19A5980097007dD) and Polygon (0xd47b03ee6d86Cf251ee7860FB2ACf9f91B9fD4d7): they are still on the docs page but are absent from the live metadata API and hold little liquidity, which suggests they are no longer the active USDT route (USDT on those chains appears to have moved to USDT0); confirm before using. (2) FeeLib, Treasurer, StargateStaking and StargateMultiRewarder contracts (not called by bridging agents). The docs show the bus Ticket.ticketId as uint56; the verified contract ABI returns uint72. Function signatures come from source verified on Sourcify (chain 1). Stargate developer docs are now hosted by LayerZero (docs.stargate.finance redirects to docs.layerzero.network); the legacy stargate.finance/api/v1 quotes API is deprecated in favour of the LayerZero Value Transfer API. Stargate V1 (the older Router.swap/pool-ID contracts) is a different deployment and is not covered here.

name: STKESOL by SOL Strategies
description: SOL liquid staking pool run by SOL Strategies (Nasdaq: STKE) on the standard SPL Stake Pool program. An agent can deposit SOL (or a stake account) to receive STKESOL, which appreciates against SOL as rewards accrue, and redeem STKESOL for SOL from the pool reserve or for a stake account, or swap it instantly via Jupiter.

keyFunctions.description: Instruction of the SPL Stake Pool program (SPoo1Ku8WFXoNDMHPsrGSTSG1Y47rzgn41SLUNakuHy) against this pool: deposit SOL into the reserve and mint STKESOL to the depositor's token account. Permissionless (no sol_deposit_authority set). Pool deposit fee 0%. Easiest via @solana/spl-stake-pool depositSol(connection, poolAddress, from, lamports) or CLI `spl-stake-pool deposit-sol <pool> <amount>`.
Same as DepositSol with a minimum STKESOL out.

Deposit an active stake account delegated to one of the pool's validators and receive STKESOL. Uses the default program-derived stake deposit authority (7LYfeWY2cHtdgycPkTqcNppQbTqnPc7oP9Votq7dXrB7), so it is permissionless. Pool stake-deposit fee 0%.

Burn STKESOL and receive SOL directly from the pool's reserve stake account. Only works while the reserve has enough SOL. Pool withdrawal fee 0.1%. SDK: withdrawSol(connection, poolAddress, tokenOwner, solReceiver, amount); CLI `spl-stake-pool withdraw-sol`.
Same as WithdrawSol with a minimum lamports out.

Burn STKESOL and receive a split stake account (delegated to a pool validator) that you then deactivate and withdraw after the epoch ends (~2-3 days). Use when the reserve is too small for WithdrawSol. Pool withdrawal fee 0.1%.
Permissionless epoch update; deposits/withdrawals fail if the pool was not updated this epoch. The SDK/CLI (`spl-stake-pool update <pool>`) handles it.

Borsh-decoded StakePool state: total_lamports / pool_token_supply gives the SOL per STKESOL exchange rate; also manager, staker, validator_list (StkemQE9eEzPZViA52YwYQqZU5cnYLvVfvch4p4Lsez), reserve_stake (HHnQYTNjtrbuHgQhERpGQfgu11ngXEvyjiG9qb4ZvbNC), fees. SDK: stakePoolInfo(connection, poolAddress).

keyFunctions.signature: SPL Token transfer / transferChecked(amount: u64, decimals: 9)
keyFunctions.description: Standard SPL Token (Tokenkeg program) mint, 9 decimals. Mint authority is the pool's withdraw-authority PDA; no freeze authority.
Total STKESOL supply; equals pool_token_supply in the stake pool account.

Shared SPL Stake Pool program used by this pool (owner of the pool account). Upgradeable (BPF upgradeable loader), maintained by the Solana program maintainers, not SOL Strategies. See the pool entry above for usage.

actions.name: stake
actions.description: Stake SOL for STKESOL
actions.how: SPL Stake Pool DepositSol(lamports) on pool StKeDUdSu7jMSnPJ1MPqDnk3RdEwD2QbJaisHMebGhw via @solana/spl-stake-pool depositSol(); or swap SOL -> STKESOL (mint stke7uu3fXHsGqKVVjKnkmj65LRPVrqr4bLG2SJg7rh) on Jupiter

actions.name: unstake-instant
actions.description: Redeem STKESOL for SOL now
actions.how: WithdrawSol(pool_tokens) if the reserve holds enough SOL (0.1% fee); otherwise swap STKESOL -> SOL on Jupiter (the SOL Strategies app uses Jupiter for instant withdrawals; market price and price impact apply)

actions.name: unstake-delayed
actions.description: Redeem STKESOL for a stake account
actions.how: WithdrawStake(pool_tokens) to get a stake account, then deactivate it and withdraw SOL after the epoch ends

actions.name: read-rate
actions.description: Get SOL per STKESOL
actions.how: Read the stake pool account: total_lamports / pool_token_supply (or stakePoolInfo() in @solana/spl-stake-pool)

risks: Fees (per SOL Strategies docs and on-chain pool state): 5% of epoch staking rewards, 0% deposit fee, 0.1% withdrawal fee (SOL or stake).

Native unstake goes through stake deactivation (end of the current epoch, ~2-3 days) unless the reserve covers WithdrawSol; instant exits via Jupiter depend on DEX liquidity and may trade below the pool rate.

Validator risk: stake is delegated to 40-80 validators chosen by SOL Strategies using the 30-day mean Wiz Score; validator downtime lowers rewards. Solana has no automatic slashing today, but that could change.
Issuer/manager risk: SOL Strategies is manager and staker (stker2jR6XibQZ3yT5xgEe4fYS5yHR1ZFVUj5fm7i1G) and can change fees (with an epoch delay), validators and authorities.
Program risk: the SPL Stake Pool program is upgradeable by its upgrade authority.
notes: Pool and mint addresses come from the 'Pool addresses' section of the official STKESOL documentation page in the SOL Strategies app (https://app.solstrategies.io/docs). On 2026-11-24 I read that page's text from the app's JavaScript bundle; it is a client-rendered page. The support site support.solstrategies.io was unreachable from this environment. Checked on mainnet: the pool account is owned by SPoo1Ku8WFXoNDMHPsrGSTSG1Y47rzgn41SLUNakuHy, its pool_mint is stke7uu3..., epoch fee 5/100, SOL and stake withdrawal fee 1/1000, deposit fees 0, no sol_deposit_authority or sol_withdraw_authority set, and the stake deposit authority is the default PDA. The mint has 9 decimals, mint authority 5vzKiHVuZNx1XQWQZQEcuqKaq4nfDp6LhuSvowQK2ayd (the pool's withdraw-authority PDA) and no freeze authority. Validator list, reserve and manager addresses come from the on-chain pool account, not from a SOL Strategies page. The SOL Strategies 'STKE' ticker token on DEXs is unrelated to STKESOL. No official public API found.

name: SUNSwap V2
description: Uniswap-V2-style constant-product DEX on TRON run by SUN.io (Factory + Router02 + per-pair contracts, 0.3% fee). An agent can swap TRC-20 tokens and TRX, quote with getAmountsOut, add/remove liquidity and look up pairs on-chain, or get best routes across SunSwap V1/V2/V3/V4, PSM and SunCurve from the official SUN.io routing API.

keyFunctions.description: Quote: amounts along path for an exact input (amountIn in the input token's base units). Includes the 0.3% fee per hop. Use WTRX TNUC9Qb1rRpS5CbWLmNMxXBjyFoydXjWFR in the path for TRX. Apply slippage to the last element to get amountOutMin.
Quote: required input for an exact output along path.

(amountIn, amountOutMin, path, to, deadline). Sell an exact amount of a TRC-20 for another TRC-20. Approve the Router on the input token first. deadline is a Unix timestamp in seconds. Path hops must be existing V2 pairs.
(amountOutMin, path, to, deadline). Sell exact native TRX (callValue in sun, 1 TRX = 1e6 sun); path must start with WTRX TNUC9Qb1rRpS5CbWLmNMxXBjyFoydXjWFR. "ETH" in V2 names means TRX.
(amountIn, amountOutMin, path, to, deadline). Sell a TRC-20 for native TRX; path must end with WTRX. Approve the Router first.
(amountOut, amountInMax, path, to, deadline). Buy an exact output amount spending at most amountInMax.
Same as swapExactTokensForTokens but for tokens that take a fee on transfer; returns nothing.

(tokenA, tokenB, amountADesired, amountBDesired, amountAMin, amountBMin, to, deadline). Add liquidity to a TRC-20/TRC-20 pair (created automatically if missing); LP tokens go to `to`. Approve both tokens to the Router.
(token, amountTokenDesired, amountTokenMin, amountETHMin, to, deadline). Add liquidity to a token/TRX pair; send TRX as callValue (wrapped to WTRX).
(tokenA, tokenB, liquidity, amountAMin, amountBMin, to, deadline). Burn LP for both tokens. Approve the pair (LP token) to the Router first.
(token, liquidity, amountTokenMin, amountETHMin, to, deadline). Burn LP of a token/WTRX pair, receive the token and native TRX.
Returns WTRX TNUC9Qb1rRpS5CbWLmNMxXBjyFoydXjWFR (checked on-chain).
Returns the V2 Factory TKWJdrQkqHisa1X8HUdHEfREvTzw4pMAaY (checked on-chain).
Pair (pool/LP token) address for two tokens; zero address if none. Use WTRX for TRX. Pairs expose standard Uniswap V2 getReserves(), token0(), token1(), totalSupply().
Number of pairs created.
Pair address by index.
Permissionless pair creation (addLiquidity also creates the pair if missing).
Protocol fee recipient (the 0.05% SUN buyback-and-burn share).
Wrap TRX (callValue in sun) into WTRX 1:1. 6 decimals.
Unwrap WTRX to TRX.
Approve a spender such as the V2 Router.
WTRX balance (6 decimals).
SUN balance (18 decimals).
Transfer SUN.
Approve a spender, e.g. the V2 Router.

(path, poolVersion, versionLen, fees, data=(amountIn, amountOutMin, to, deadline)). Multi-protocol swap across SunSwap V1/V2/V3, PSM and curve pools, typically fed by the routing API output (pool names e.g. 'v1','v2','v3'; versionLen counts tokens per segment, first entry +1; fees all 0 except V3 hops, last entry 0). Use address T9yD14Nj9j7xAB4dbGeiX9h8unkKHxuWwb (zero address) for native TRX and send callValue = amountIn. Approve input TRC-20 to this router.

offchainApis.use: GET ?fromTokenAddr&toTokenAddr&inAmount (base units) returns the top 3 paths (roadForAddr, pool per hop, amount, impact, fee) across SunSwap V1/V2/V3/V4, PSM and SunCurve; feed into Smart Router swapExactInput.

offchainApis.use: Read-only REST (GET, JSON): token prices and search, pools/pairs, user positions, transactions, protocol stats, Universal Router quotes, SUN token data. 10 QPS without key; optional X-API-KEY header for higher limits.

offchainApis.use: Official hosted SUN MCP Server: read-only SunSwap data (prices, quotes, pools/APYs, protocol stats, positions) with no wallet credentials. Swaps/liquidity need the self-hosted (local) deployment.

actions.name: quote
actions.description: Quote a V2 swap
actions.how: Router.getAmountsOut(amountIn, [tokenIn, ..., tokenOut]) with WTRX for TRX; or GET https://open.sun.io/apiv2/quote/swap/routingInV2 for best multi-protocol route

actions.name: swap-token-for-token
actions.description: Swap TRC-20 to TRC-20
actions.how: approve(Router, amountIn) on tokenIn, then Router.swapExactTokensForTokens(amountIn, amountOutMin, path, to, nowSec+600)

actions.name: swap-trx-for-token
actions.description: Sell TRX
actions.how: Router.swapExactETHForTokens(amountOutMin, [WTRX, token], to, deadline) with callValue = TRX amount in sun

actions.name: swap-token-for-trx
actions.description: Buy TRX
actions.how: approve Router, then Router.swapExactTokensForETH(amountIn, amountOutMin, [token, WTRX], to, deadline)

actions.name: add-liquidity
actions.description: Provide liquidity
actions.how: approve both tokens to Router; Router.addLiquidity(...) or addLiquidityETH(token, ..., to, deadline) with TRX callValue

actions.name: remove-liquidity
actions.description: Withdraw liquidity
actions.how: Factory.getPair(a,b) -> approve pair LP to Router -> Router.removeLiquidity(...) / removeLiquidityETH(...)

risks: Permissionless pair creation: anyone can list any TRC-20, including scam, copycat or fee-on-transfer/honeypot tokens. Verify token addresses (e.g. against the SUN.io token list) before swapping.

Router and Smart Router addresses have changed: SUN.io marks older mainnet V2 contracts (TXF1xDbVGdxFGbovmmmXvBGu8ZiE3Lq4mR, TMmRKgwC1hx4azzkXoPzujgQThzF48Actq) and older Smart Routers as deprecated. Use only the current addresses from docs.sun.io.
Fee 0.3% per hop: 0.25% to LPs and 0.05% used to buy back and burn SUN.
Uniswap V2 code: Factory feeToSetter can change the protocol fee recipient; Router/Factory/Pairs are not upgradeable proxies (TronGrid shows plain UniswapV2Factory/UniswapV2Router02 contracts).
TRON resource costs: write calls burn energy/bandwidth; set an adequate feeLimit (docs examples use up to 10,000 TRX for Smart Router) or the tx fails and still costs TRX.

Audits: SUN.io states its contracts were audited by SlowMist (https://docs.sun.io/get-started/risks); DefiLlama links https://sunswap.com/docs/audit-report_en.pdf. Standard AMM risks: impermanent loss, slippage, MEV.
notes: VM is TVM (TRON Virtual Machine, EVM-compatible ABI); addresses are base58 T... Every address above is from docs.sun.io and was confirmed via TronGrid getcontract (Router = UniswapV2Router02, Factory = UniswapV2Factory, WTRX, SunToken, SmartExchangeRouter); Router.factory() and Router.WETH() return the listed Factory and WTRX. Testnet (Nile): Factory THomLGMLhAjMecQf9FQjbZ8a1RtwsZLrGE, Router TYMjxCXfqLpMWW1QToP6hbcjpion7EE25p. The often-cited router TKzxdSv2FZKQrEqkKVgp5DcwEXBEKMg2Ax is not on the official contract page and is left out. SUN.io also runs a Universal Router (TQqgNg13s2DjvXhW1ky4v6TsR8wZGvb7Y4, https://docs.sun.io/protocols/universal-router/reference/contract) with Permit2; it is not part of SunSwap V2 and its functions are not documented here. SunSwap V1/V3/V4 are separate protocols. Decimals per SUN CLI docs: TRX/WTRX/USDT 6, SUN/USDD/JST 18. Router function signatures come from the TronGrid ABI and docs.sun.io main-interfaces page. No specific SunSwap V2 exploit was found on official pages.

actions.how: contract USDT.isBlackListed(address) on Ethereum

risks: Centralised issuer: Tether's Terms of Service reserve the right to freeze Tether Tokens, blacklist any address holding them, bar transactions to or from addresses, and seize or recover tokens (tether.to/en/legal).
USDT on Ethereum: owner can addBlackList(address); a blacklisted address cannot transfer, and destroyBlackFunds(address) zeroes its balance and burns it from supply (verified source).
USDT on Ethereum does not return bool from transfer/transferFrom/approve; strict ERC-20 callers that require a bool will revert.
USDT on Ethereum approve reverts when changing a non-zero allowance to another non-zero value; reset to 0 first.
USDT on Ethereum can be deprecated by the owner, after which calls are forwarded to upgradedAddress(); owner can also pause transfers.

Only chains listed on tether.to/en/supported-protocols are issued/redeemed by Tether. Tether lists Algorand, Vaulta/EOS, Kusama, Omni, Bitcoin Cash SLP as deprecated (no longer issued or redeemable obligation), EUR₮ as wound down, and CNH₮ redemption ending February 20, 2027.
notes: Addresses are exactly as listed on https://tether.to/en/supported-protocols/ (EVM ones checksummed here). USDT on Kava is listed by Tether as "Cosmos (via Kava)". Not included: USDT0 / XAUt0 (the LayerZero OFT omnichain versions developed by Everdawn Labs) because tether.to's supported-protocols page does not list them; USDT on chains such as Arbitrum, Polygon, Optimism or BNB Chain is not on Tether's official list (bridged or USDT0 versions exist there) and is omitted. The no-bool / approve-reset behaviour and blacklist functions are confirmed only for the Ethereum USDT contract (verified source); other chains' USDT contracts are different deployments, so read their ABI (get_abi) before relying on return values. Deprecated tokens with addresses on the official page (historical only): EUR₮ Ethereum 0xC581b735A1688071A1746c968e0798D642EDE491, CNH₮ Ethereum 0x6e109e9dd7fa1a58bc3eff667e8e41fc3cc07aef, CNH₮ Tron TCfCGjekyqmdYt1yxfUM5v5SDtaY6tuWik, MXN₮ Tron TDp7Kbp6ajeWeQN9J57Vnw4WyQdKpuARDF, USD₮ Algorand asset 312769, Kusama AssetHub 1984, Omni property #31. name: Turbos Finance
description: Concentrated-liquidity (Uniswap-v3-style CLMM) DEX on Sui. Agents can quote and execute swaps, open/adjust/close LP positions (NFTs), and collect fees and rewards through Move calls or the official TypeScript SDK (turbos-clmm-sdk).

keyFunctions.signature: swap_router::swap_a_b<CoinTypeA,CoinTypeB,FeeType>(pool: &mut Pool<A,B,Fee>, coins_a: vector<Coin<A>>, amount: u64, amount_threshold: u64, sqrt_price_limit: u128, is_exact_in: bool, recipient: address, deadline: u64, clock: &Clock, versioned: &Versioned, ctx)
keyFunctions.description: Entry. Swap coin A -> coin B in one pool. is_exact_in=true: amount = exact A in, amount_threshold = min B out; false: amount = exact B out, amount_threshold = max A in. sqrt_price_limit: use MIN_SQRT_PRICE 4295048016 for no limit. Output and leftover A are sent to recipient. Type args <CoinTypeA, CoinTypeB, FeeType> must equal the pool object's type (read it from the pool, e.g. Pool<SUI, USDC, 0x91bf…::fee3000bps::FEE3000BPS>). clock = 0x6, versioned = Versioned object 0xf1cf…5b6f. deadline is a unix timestamp in milliseconds.

actions.name: swap

actions.how: SDK: q = sdk.trade.computeSwapResultV2({pools:[{pool, a2b, amountSpecified}], address, amountSpecifiedIsInput:true}); tx = sdk.trade.swap({routes:[{pool, a2b, nextTickIndex: sdk.math.bitsToNumber(q[0].tick_current_index.bits)}], coinTypeA, coinTypeB, address, amountA, amountB: q[0].amount_b, amountSpecifiedIsInput:true, slippage:"0.5"}); sign and execute. risks: Upgradeable Move package: the CLMM package has been upgraded many times (on-chain version 22 at research time). Always call the latest published-at id (from contract.json) and pass the Versioned object; old package ids revert on version checks.

Admin powers held via PoolFactoryAdminCap / AclConfig roles: pause/unpause pools (toggle_pool_status), set protocol fee share, add fee tiers, manage rewards, migrate positions, admin decrease_liquidity (decrease_liquidity_admin) and package upgrade.

After the May 2025 Cetus exploit (overflow bug in a shared math library), Verichains reported that the same flawed function existed in the Turbos codebase but was not used; Turbos stated it was not affected.
Concentrated liquidity: positions out of range earn no fees and suffer impermanent loss; set amount_min / slippage and deadlines.

The gitbook Contract Modules page lists some argument orders that differ from the deployed package (increase_liquidity, decrease_liquidity, collect, burn); the signatures here follow the on-chain package and the official Move interface.
notes: Sui is not one of the registry VM types, so vm = "mixed"; the VM is the Sui Move VM and chainId is null. Ids are Sui object/package ids. Mainnet ids come from the official Dev Overview table and the official contract.json (both agree); all were checked on Sui mainnet via GraphQL on 2026-11-25 (PoolConfig, Positions, Versioned are shared objects of the expected 0x91bf… types; the package exposes the listed functions with the listed parameters). Fee-tier Fee objects (needed only to create pools): 10bps 0x49dcf28ac3b5480e65bee812ad2d6e60108ab8037d5a815c3c11bbe7bc47c270, 500bps 0xdfcd1043f54fef3aa649eccd4d0b2b09a3da6c87a8a62736467b686268869365, 3000bps 0x6bc433c8604f58272155d0c65327ae0b316f63869e5de3846f70aef4625d8c46, 10000bps 0xd30c41ec4b4d0eb9b30b0b898c53f81cd53a9eb0f75b5d3273584cd874b2d4c4; full list (100, 1000, 1500, 2000, 2500, 7500, 20000, 40000 bps) in contract.json. The SDK getConfig doc example shows an older PackageId (0x2476…16c8); use contract.json. Vault objects (VaultGlobalConfig 0x2994c75a2ab419adfe16e143bf45ad44c3a5ccfc07c8fe8e31f7c883c8d84c2b, VaultRewarderManager, VaultUserTierConfig) are in contract.json; vault Move functions are not documented beyond the SDK, so no keyFunctions are given (use the SDK vault methods). Not included: Turbos Fun (bonding-curve launchpad, parrot_fun::buy/sell) because its package and config ids are not on an official page; Turbos OMM page is empty; TURBOS on BNB Chain (0xA1E6410bF311C03429B37A76a80C8A5E61616e7F per the token page) is out of scope of the Sui DEX entry. Individual pool ids are not listed: discover them from PoolConfig or the SDK.

name: Uniswap
description: The largest AMM DEX family (v2 constant-product, v3 concentrated liquidity, v4 singleton PoolManager with hooks). An agent can swap tokens (UniversalRouter, SwapRouter02, v2 Router02), get on-chain quotes (QuoterV2, V4Quoter), read pool state (v3 pools, v4 StateView) and open, add to, remove from and collect fees on LP positions (v3 NonfungiblePositionManager, v4 PositionManager).

offchainApis.name: Uniswap Trading API
offchainApis.use: Routed swap quotes and ready-to-sign transactions across v2/v3/v4 and UniswapX: POST /check_approval (does the token need an approval), POST /quote (best route; 'routing' field says what to call next), POST /swap (turn a CLASSIC quote into an unsigned transaction), POST /order (submit a gasless UniswapX order). API key goes in the x-api-key header and must be kept server-side.

actions.name: swap (simple, v3)
actions.description: Swap an exact amount of one token for another through a single v3 pool
actions.how: ERC-20 approve(SwapRouter02, amountIn), then SwapRouter02.exactInputSingle((tokenIn, tokenOut, fee, recipient, amountIn, amountOutMinimum, 0)). Get amountOutMinimum from QuoterV2.quoteExactInputSingle via eth_call minus slippage.

actions.name: swap (best route, v2/v3/v4)
actions.description: Swap across any Uniswap version via the UniversalRouter
actions.how: ERC-20 approve(Permit2, amount); Permit2.approve(token, UniversalRouter, amount, expiration); UniversalRouter.execute(commands, inputs, deadline). Easiest: get the calldata from the Trading API /quote + /swap.

actions.name: quote
actions.description: Get the expected output for a swap without sending a transaction
actions.how: eth_call QuoterV2.quoteExactInputSingle((tokenIn, tokenOut, amountIn, fee, 0)) for v3, or V4Quoter.quoteExactInputSingle((poolKey, zeroForOne, amount, hookData)) for v4.

actions.name: add liquidity (v3)
actions.description: Open a concentrated-liquidity position
actions.how: approve both tokens to NonfungiblePositionManager, then mint((token0, token1, fee, tickLower, tickUpper, amount0Desired, amount1Desired, amount0Min, amount1Min, recipient, deadline)). Add more with increaseLiquidity.

actions.name: remove liquidity / collect fees (v3)
actions.description: Withdraw liquidity and fees from a v3 position NFT
actions.how: NonfungiblePositionManager.multicall([decreaseLiquidity((tokenId, liquidity, amount0Min, amount1Min, deadline)), collect((tokenId, recipient, 2^128-1, 2^128-1))]). Fees only: collect alone.

actions.name: add / remove liquidity (v4)
actions.description: Manage a v4 position
actions.how: approve tokens to Permit2, Permit2.approve(token, PositionManager, amount, expiration), then PositionManager.modifyLiquidities(abi.encode(actions, params), deadline) with MINT_POSITION/INCREASE_LIQUIDITY/DECREASE_LIQUIDITY + SETTLE_PAIR/TAKE_PAIR actions.

actions.name: read pool state
actions.description: Price, tick and liquidity of a pool
actions.how: v3: UniswapV3Factory.getPool(tokenA, tokenB, fee) then pool.slot0() / pool.liquidity(). v4: StateView.getSlot0(poolId) / getLiquidity(poolId).

actions.name: swap / add liquidity (v2)
actions.description: Classic constant-product pools
actions.how: approve UniswapV2Router02, then swapExactTokensForTokens(amountIn, amountOutMin, path, to, deadline) or addLiquidity(...).

risks: Addresses differ per chain: Uniswap's docs say integrators must not assume the same address across chains (e.g. Base, BNB, Avalanche and Unichain v3 contracts differ from Ethereum's).
Always set a minimum-output / maximum-input (slippage) and a deadline; swaps without them can be sandwiched by MEV bots.
QuoterV2 and V4Quoter quote functions are not view functions (they simulate and revert); call them with eth_call only, never as a transaction.
Concentrated liquidity (v3/v4) earns fees only while the price is inside the range and suffers impermanent loss; out-of-range positions hold a single token.

v4 pools can have hooks: arbitrary external contracts that run on swaps and liquidity changes and can change fees or behaviour. Check the hooks address in the PoolKey (zero address = no hook) before using an unknown pool.
UniversalRouter and v4 PositionManager pull tokens through Permit2; Permit2 approvals are separate from ERC-20 approvals and carry an expiration. Revoke unused ones with Permit2.lockdown.
Anyone can create a pool for any token, including scam tokens with the same symbol; verify token addresses.
SwapRouter02 exactInputSingle has no deadline field (unlike the original SwapRouter); wrap it in multicall(deadline, data) to enforce one.
notes: BTB Finance already builds Uniswap V3 deposits itself (build_add_liquidity / add_liquidity_link in the BTB MCP), so for v3 LP agents can use those tools instead of calling NonfungiblePositionManager directly. This file covers the core contracts on 8 major chains only; Uniswap is deployed on about 51 chains (DefiLlama). Full official deployment lists: v3 index https://developers.uniswap.org/docs/protocols/v3/deployments with per-chain pages https://developers.uniswap.org/docs/protocols/v3/deployments/v3-<chain>-deployments for celo, elysium, hyperevm, megaeth, monad, tempo, robinhood-chain, world-chain, xlayer, zksync, zora (plus the 8 chains here); v4 (all chains incl. Zora, Worldchain, X Layer, Ink, Soneium, Celo, Monad, MegaETH, Tempo, Robinhood Chain and testnets) https://developers.uniswap.org/docs/protocols/v4/deployments ; v2 (also Zora, WorldChain, Monad, X Layer, MegaETH, Tempo, Robinhood Chain, HyperEVM, Elysium) https://developers.uniswap.org/docs/protocols/v2/deployments . The old docs.uniswap.org deployment URLs now redirect to developers.uniswap.org. The UniversalRouter listed per chain is the one on both the v3 and v4 deployment pages (Universal Router 2.0, supports v4); the v4 page additionally lists newer 'Universal Router 2.1.1' and '2.1.2' addresses per chain, not included here. The original SwapRouter (0xE592427A0AEce92De3Edee1F18E0157C05861564) and Quoter (v1) are still listed on Ethereum, Arbitrum, Optimism and Polygon but are superseded by SwapRouter02/QuoterV2. Permit2 is at 0x000000000022D473030F116dDEE9F6B43aC78BA3 on all 8 chains. v4 native ETH is address(0) in PoolKeys; v3/v2 use WETH. Unichain v3 page does not list Permit2/UniversalRouter, so those Unichain entries are sourced from the v4 page. All addresses were EIP-55 checksummed from the docs' values (several docs entries are lower-case).

name: up.
description: Native ve(3,3) exchange on Robinhood Chain (chainId 4663): Velodrome-v2-style stable/volatile v2 pools plus Slipstream (Uniswap-v3-style, tickSpacing-keyed) concentrated-liquidity pools, with UP emissions, veUP locks and weekly gauge voting. Agents can quote and swap through the v2 Router or the v3 SwapRouter/QuoterV2, add/remove v2 liquidity, open and manage v3 position NFTs, lock UP into veUP and vote.

keyFunctions.description: Single-pool exact-input swap on a v3 (CL) pool. Tuple: (tokenIn, tokenOut, tickSpacing, recipient, deadline, amountIn, amountOutMinimum, sqrtPriceLimitX96). Pools are keyed by tickSpacing, not fee: enabled spacings are 1, 10, 50, 60, 100, 200, 2000 (read clFactory.tickSpacings()). sqrtPriceLimitX96 = 0 for no limit. Approve tokenIn to this router first. To pay in native ETH send msg.value with tokenIn = WETH 0x0Bd7D308f8E1639FAb988df18A8011f41EAcAD73. Returns amountOut.

Multi-hop exact-input swap. Tuple: (path, recipient, deadline, amountIn, amountOutMinimum). Path = tokenIn (20 bytes) + tickSpacing (int24, 3 bytes) + token (20 bytes) [+ tickSpacing + token ...]. Returns amountOut.

Single-pool exact-output swap. Tuple: (tokenIn, tokenOut, tickSpacing, recipient, deadline, amountOut, amountInMaximum, sqrtPriceLimitX96). Returns amountIn. When paying with native ETH, add refundETH() in the same multicall.
Multi-hop exact-output swap: (path in REVERSE order, recipient, deadline, amountOut, amountInMaximum). Returns amountIn.
Batch router calls, e.g. swap with recipient = router, then unwrapWETH9 to receive native ETH.
Unwrap the router's WETH balance to native ETH and send it to recipient. Args (amountMinimum, recipient). Use inside multicall after a swap whose recipient was the router.
Return leftover native ETH held by the router to msg.sender (use after exact-output swaps paid in ETH).
CL factory this router uses (0x1ac9dB4a2608ba45D6127B1737949b51Bb54B7F3).

Quote via eth_call (not a view function; it simulates and reverts internally). Tuple: (tokenIn, tokenOut, amountIn, tickSpacing, sqrtPriceLimitX96) - note amountIn comes before tickSpacing here. Returns (amountOut, sqrtPriceX96After, initializedTicksCrossed, gasEstimate).
Multi-hop quote via eth_call: (path, amountIn), same path encoding as SwapRouter.exactInput. Returns (amountOut, sqrtPriceX96AfterList[], initializedTicksCrossedList[], gasEstimate).
Exact-output quote via eth_call. Tuple: (tokenIn, tokenOut, amount, tickSpacing, sqrtPriceLimitX96). Returns (amountIn, sqrtPriceX96After, initializedTicksCrossed, gasEstimate).
Multi-hop exact-output quote via eth_call; path in reverse order.

Open a concentrated-liquidity position NFT. Tuple: (token0, token1, tickSpacing, tickLower, tickUpper, amount0Desired, amount1Desired, amount0Min, amount1Min, recipient, deadline, sqrtPriceX96). token0 < token1 by address; ticks must be multiples of tickSpacing. sqrtPriceX96 = 0 for an existing pool (non-zero creates and initializes the pool if it does not exist). Approve both tokens to this contract first. Returns (tokenId, liquidity, amount0, amount1).
Add to a position: (tokenId, amount0Desired, amount1Desired, amount0Min, amount1Min, deadline). Returns (liquidity, amount0, amount1).

Remove liquidity: (tokenId, liquidity, amount0Min, amount1Min, deadline). Tokens are only credited to the position; call collect() to receive them. A position staked in a gauge must be withdrawn from the gauge first.
Withdraw owed tokens and fees: (tokenId, recipient, amount0Max, amount1Max); use 2^128-1 for all. Returns (amount0, amount1).
Burn an empty position NFT (liquidity and owed tokens must be 0).
Position data: (nonce, operator, token0, token1, tickSpacing, tickLower, tickUpper, liquidity, feeGrowthInside0LastX128, feeGrowthInside1LastX128, tokensOwed0, tokensOwed1).
Number of position NFTs held (staked positions are held by the gauge, not the wallet).
Enumerate an owner's position tokenIds.
Approve a position NFT to a gauge before gauge.deposit(tokenId). Find the pool's gauge with Voter.gauges(pool).
Batch calls (e.g. decreaseLiquidity + collect, or mint with native ETH + refundETH).
CL pool for (tokenA, tokenB, tickSpacing), either token order; zero address if none.
Enabled tick spacings. At research time: 1, 10, 50, 60, 100, 200, 2000.
Current swap fee (pips) for a pool; may differ from the default because a dynamic-fee module can set it.
Extra fee taken from unstaked liquidity's fees for a pool (pips).
Number of CL pools.
Whether an address is a pool from this factory.
Create a CL pool: (tokenA, tokenB, tickSpacing, sqrtPriceX96). tickSpacing must be enabled. Usually done via NonfungiblePositionManager.mint with non-zero sqrtPriceX96 instead.
Quote a v2 route. Args (amountIn, routes); each Route = (from, to, stable, factory), factory = v2 PoolFactory 0xFA5429AEBa338BEa2BFcc1b9a889862Ee395bc28. Returns amounts[] (last = output).
Swap on v2 pools: (amountIn, amountOutMin, routes, to, deadline). Approve the first token to the router first. Returns amounts[].
Swap native ETH (msg.value) for tokens: (amountOutMin, routes, to, deadline). routes[0].from must be WETH 0x0Bd7D308f8E1639FAb988df18A8011f41EAcAD73.
Swap tokens for native ETH: (amountIn, amountOutMin, routes, to, deadline). Last route's `to` must be WETH.
Same as swapExactTokensForTokens for fee-on-transfer tokens; returns nothing.
Preview addLiquidity: (tokenA, tokenB, stable, factory, amountADesired, amountBDesired) -> (amountA, amountB, liquidity).

Add v2 liquidity: (tokenA, tokenB, stable, amountADesired, amountBDesired, amountAMin, amountBMin, to, deadline). Creates the pool if it does not exist. Approve both tokens first. Returns (amountA, amountB, liquidity). LP tokens can then be staked in the pool's gauge (Voter.gauges(pool)).
Add token + native ETH liquidity: (token, stable, amountTokenDesired, amountTokenMin, amountETHMin, to, deadline) with ETH as msg.value.
Preview removeLiquidity: (tokenA, tokenB, stable, factory, liquidity) -> (amountA, amountB).
Remove v2 liquidity: (tokenA, tokenB, stable, liquidity, amountAMin, amountBMin, to, deadline). Approve the pool's LP token to the router first.

actions.name: quote a v3 swap
actions.description: Price a swap through a concentrated-liquidity pool.
actions.how: eth_call QuoterV2.quoteExactInputSingle((tokenIn, tokenOut, amountIn, tickSpacing, 0)). Find which tickSpacing has a pool with CLFactory.getPool(tokenA, tokenB, tickSpacing) for each value in CLFactory.tickSpacings().

actions.name: swap (v3)
actions.description: Swap through a CL pool.
actions.how: approve tokenIn to SwapRouter 0xC062b870E813fcA720f1e002c234369Ab3aB9415, then SwapRouter.exactInputSingle((tokenIn, tokenOut, tickSpacing, recipient, deadline, amountIn, amountOutMinimum, 0)). Set amountOutMinimum from the quote minus slippage; Robinhood Chain pools can be thin.

actions.name: swap (v2)
actions.description: Swap through stable/volatile v2 pools.
actions.how: Router.getAmountsOut(amountIn, [(from, to, stable, 0xFA5429AEBa338BEa2BFcc1b9a889862Ee395bc28)]) to quote, approve tokenIn to Router 0xf5198743240fAC98db71868F34c70139b1eb0474, then Router.swapExactTokensForTokens(amountIn, amountOutMin, routes, to, deadline).

actions.name: add v2 liquidity
actions.description: Provide liquidity to a v2 pool.
actions.how: Router.quoteAddLiquidity(...) to size, approve both tokens to the Router, then Router.addLiquidity(tokenA, tokenB, stable, amountADesired, amountBDesired, amountAMin, amountBMin, to, deadline). Optionally stake the LP token in Voter.gauges(pool) via gauge.deposit(amount) to earn UP instead of fees.

actions.name: open a v3 position
actions.description: Provide concentrated liquidity.
actions.how: approve token0 and token1 to NonfungiblePositionManager 0x07F44c47743A2f36414A82b9F558ECFCf0EEdCEf, then mint((token0, token1, tickSpacing, tickLower, tickUpper, amount0Desired, amount1Desired, amount0Min, amount1Min, recipient, deadline, 0)). To farm UP: NonfungiblePositionManager.approve(gauge, tokenId) then gauge.deposit(tokenId) where gauge = Voter.gauges(pool); claim with gauge.getReward(tokenId), exit with gauge.withdraw(tokenId).

actions.name: remove a v3 position
actions.description: Withdraw liquidity and fees.
actions.how: If staked, gauge.withdraw(tokenId) first. Then NonfungiblePositionManager.multicall([decreaseLiquidity((tokenId, liquidity, amount0Min, amount1Min, deadline)), collect((tokenId, recipient, 2^128-1, 2^128-1))]).

actions.name: lock and vote
actions.description: Lock UP for veUP and direct emissions.
actions.how: approve UP to VotingEscrow 0x5d321dE36F0bf98D92b291280514F3878582B7B6, createLock(amount, duration<=126144000), then Voter.vote(tokenId, pools[], weights[]) once per epoch; after the epoch flips claim with Voter.claimFees / claimBribes.

risks: Forked code: the ve(3,3) core descends from Velodrome v2 and the CL engine from Slipstream (Uniswap v3 design), per the official security page. The public GitHub repos are described by the team as a sanitized source snapshot that is not guaranteed to match deployed bytecode byte-for-byte.

One audit listed by the team: Shieldify, July 2026 (up-contracts and up-slipstream), 0 critical, 0 high, 3 medium, 3 low, 4 informational findings; per the team's table all mediums and lows were acknowledged rather than fixed (e.g. permissionless poke() can zero a decayed lock's current-epoch rewards; gauge-cap enforcement can be bypassed via updateFor; fail-open uncapped emission release).

Governance-controlled modules: the CL factory owner is the protocol governance address 0x0eEA30aBa3f07abFA20E4b544F55e0f917d9DFd8 (read on-chain); fee modules (dynamic fees) and gauge emission caps are replaceable modules beside the core, so swap fees can change per pool.
veUP locks cannot be exited early (up to 4 years); the UP token is inflationary via weekly emissions.
Robinhood Chain is a new Arbitrum Orbit L2 and many pools are thin: use generous slippage checks (minimum-out) and quote right before swapping.
Staked LP positions earn UP emissions instead of swap fees; unstaked positions keep fees.
notes: Addresses come from the 'Contract addresses' table on https://up33.xyz/docs/security, which the site generates from its own deployment configuration (the page is client-rendered; the same config is in the site's JS bundle). All 10 were confirmed on-chain on Robinhood Chain (4663): code present, SwapRouter/PositionManager/Quoter.factory() = CLFactory, Router.defaultFactory() = PoolFactory, VotingEscrow.token() = UP, Voter.ve() = VotingEscrow, UP.minter() = Minter; every listed function selector exists in the deployed bytecode. None use an EIP-1967 proxy. WETH on Robinhood Chain (listed by UP as canonical wrapped ETH) is 0x0Bd7D308f8E1639FAb988df18A8011f41EAcAD73. Left out: RewardsDistributor, compounder vault, emission deposit router, lockers, governance and airdrop contracts - they appear in the site's app config but not in the docs' canonical table, so they are not listed here. Individual gauges and reward contracts are per-pool: read them from Voter.gauges(pool), gaugeToFees(gauge), gaugeToBribe(gauge). Subgraphs (Goldsky) are used by the app but not documented as a public API, so none are listed.

name: USDD
description: Over-collateralized, MakerDAO (DSS)-style USD stablecoin on TRON, Ethereum and BNB Chain. Agents can mint/redeem USDD 1:1 against USDT/USDC through the Peg Stability Module (PSM), earn the savings rate by depositing USDD into sUSDD (ERC-4626, Ethereum and BNB Chain), open collateralized vaults (CDPs) via DSProxy + DssProxyActions, and migrate legacy USDDOLD to USDD on TRON.

actions.description: Swap USDT (or USDC) into USDD 1:1 minus tin.
actions.how: Check PSM.sellEnabled()==1 and tin(). approve USDT to the PSM's GemJoin (Ethereum 0x217e42CEB2eAE9ECB788fDF0e31c806c531760A3, BSC 0xe229FdA620B8a9B98ef184830EE3063F0F86B790, TRON TSUYvQ5tdd3DijCD1uGunGLpftHuSZ12sQ), then PSM.sellGem(recipient, amount in USDT decimals: 6 on Ethereum/TRON, 18 on BSC).

actions.name: redeem USDD for USDT (PSM)
actions.description: Swap USDD into USDT (or USDC) 1:1 plus tout.
actions.how: Check buyEnabled()==1, tout() and that the GemJoin holds enough USDT (USDT.balanceOf(gemJoin)). approve USDD (amount*10^(18-gemDecimals) plus fee) to the PSM, then PSM.buyGem(recipient, amount in USDT decimals).

actions.name: earn savings (sUSDD)
actions.description: Deposit USDD into sUSDD on Ethereum or BNB Chain.
actions.how: approve USDD to sUSDD (Ethereum 0xC5d6A7B61d18AfA11435a889557b068BB9f29930, BSC 0x8bA9dA757d1D66c58b1ae7e2ED6c04087348A82d), then sUSDD.deposit(assets, receiver). Exit any time with redeem(shares, receiver, owner). Value: convertToAssets(shares).

actions.name: open a vault
actions.description: Borrow USDD against collateral (e.g. TRX on TRON).
actions.how: ProxyRegistry.build() once to get a DSProxy (read ProxyRegistry.proxies(owner)). Then DSProxy.execute(ProxyActions, abi.encodeWithSignature('openLockTRXAndDraw(address,address,address,address,bytes32,uint256)', cdpManager, jug, TRX-A join TJ1VWPvFVq7sVsN7J7dWJVZz4SLT14qRUr, usddJoin, 'TRX-A', wadD)) with the TRX as call value. Jug and USDD Join addresses are on the deployment-addresses page. Keep collateral ratio well above the ilk minimum or the vault is liquidated (Dutch auction).

actions.name: migrate USDDOLD
actions.description: Convert legacy USDD (USDDOLD, TPYmHEhy5n8TCEfYGqW2rPxsghSfzghPDn) to USDD 2.0 on TRON.
actions.how: approve USDDOLD to TQrq2p1aoAkNK94q3Q69ubJcv5nQ9y675R, then exchange(amount).

risks: Two different tokens named USDD exist on TRON: USDD 2.0 is TXDk8mbtRbXeYuMNS83CfKPaYYT8XWv9Hz; the 2022 token TPYmHEhy5n8TCEfYGqW2rPxsghSfzghPDn is now 'USDDOLD' (issued by TRON DAO Reserve). Always check the contract address. The legacy 2022 Ethereum USDD contract is not the current one.

Peg history: the original USDD (now USDDOLD) traded well below $1 in mid-2022 (widely reported lows around $0.93) and took months to recover. USDD 2.0 relaunched in January 2025 with Maker-style vaults and a PSM.

Collateral includes volatile assets (TRX, sTRX, WBTC, ETH), stablecoins (USDT, USDC via PSM) and protocol-run Smart Allocator ilks (SA001-A/SA002-A), which mint USDD that the team deploys into external yield venues such as Aave; their returns fund the savings rate and they carry those venues' risks.

Admin powers: governance 'wards' can mint USDD, change PSM fees (tin/tout) and disable sellGem/buyGem, change debt ceilings and rates, and trigger emergency shutdown (ESM/End). The USDD token contract itself has no blacklist/freeze or pause function (DAI-style), but USDT and USDC held by the PSM can be frozen by their issuers, and the Ethereum USDT GemJoin stops working if Tether upgrades USDT until governance whitelists the new implementation.
PSM redemption (buyGem) is limited by the stablecoin reserves currently in each GemJoin; reserves and fees differ per chain.
The savings rate (Pot dsr, about 4% APY at research time) is set by governance and can change; sUSDD has no lock-up.

Vaults are liquidated by Dutch auction (Clip) when under-collateralized, with a penalty; vault actions go through a per-user DSProxy that executes delegatecalls - only call the official ProxyActions address.
Audits listed in the docs: ChainSecurity (USDD v2, PSM, Exchange on TRON, Jan 2025; Ethereum and BSC, Oct 2025) and CertiK (Ethereum, Sep 2025).
notes: Addresses from the official docs (deployment-addresses and collateral-asset-contract-addresses pages); BSC PSM-USDC and its GemJoin only appear in the official USDD MCP server config on GitHub (linked from docs.usdd.io), so that file is cited for them. Every EVM address was checked for code on Ethereum/BSC and wiring confirmed on-chain (PSM.gemJoin/usdd/usddJoin, GemJoin.gem, sUSDD.asset); PSM, GemJoin, sUSDD, USDD, CdpManager and ProxyActions sources are verified on Sourcify. TRON addresses were checked with TronGrid (PSM.gemJoin = TSUYvQ5tdd3DijCD1uGunGLpftHuSZ12sQ, its gem = USDT TR7NHqjeKQxGTCi8q8ZY4pL8otSzgjLj6t, PSM.usdd = TXDk8mbtRbXeYuMNS83CfKPaYYT8XWv9Hz). TRON contracts mostly have no on-chain ABI; signatures there follow the TRON ABIs where published (PSM, ProxyActions, CdpManager, Migration) and the identical EVM contracts otherwise. sUSDD/Savings exists only on Ethereum and BNB Chain per the docs. Not listed individually (all on the deployment-addresses page): Jug, Dog, Vow, Flap, Flop, Spot, End, ESM, Pause, PauseProxy, price feeds (PIP_*), auction (CLIP_*) contracts, and the other collateral joins (TRON TRX-B/TRX-C/USDT-A/sTRX-A/WBTC-A/WBTC-B; Ethereum ETH-A 0x75a3a7075867AF105a9ca4b0D25a6806cd682079, ETH-B, ETH-C, WBTC-A/B/C and SA001-A on the collateral page). At research time Ethereum ETH/WBTC ilks had debt ceilings but no debt. The docs label 0x3dbA111255d3888c723242320595588754Cf493e (Ethereum) as GovActionsProxy while the MCP config calls it proxyActionsProxy; it was left out because its purpose is unclear. Contracts whose proxy status is unknown (TRON USDD has no published ABI) are marked null.

name: Usual USD0

Agents can mint or redeem USD0 against eligible RWA tokens through DaoCollateral, swap USDC and USD0 through the SwapperEngine order book, lock USD0 into the bUSD0 bond (matures 11 June 2028) and unlock it again with rt-bUSD0, save in sUSD0 (ERC-4626), and stake USUAL in USUALx.

A redemption fee of redeemFee() bps of 10,000 is charged in USD0 (5 = 0.05% on-chain on 2026-11-25; the docs quote 0.10%). If the Counter Bank Run mechanism is on, the RWA amount is cut by cbrCoef. actions.name: buy USD0 with USDC (permissionless)
actions.description: Place a USDC order in the SwapperEngine; it is filled with USD0 at the oracle USDC price when a USD0 seller or collateral provider takes it.
actions.how: USDC.approve(SwapperEngine 0xB969B0d14F7682bAF37ba7c364b351B830a812B2, amount); SwapperEngine.depositUSDC(amount in 6 decimals, >= minimumUSDCAmountProvided()). Cancel the unfilled rest with withdrawUSDC(orderId). For small amounts the docs point to secondary markets (Curve USD0/USDC).

actions.name: sell USD0 for USDC (permissionless)
actions.description: Fill open USDC orders in the SwapperEngine with USD0.
actions.how: Find active orders with getNextOrderId() and getOrder(id); USD0.approve(SwapperEngine, amount); SwapperEngine.swapUsd0(recipient, USD0 amount in wei, orderIds, true).

actions.name: mint or redeem USD0 against RWAs
actions.description: Direct path for holders of eligible permissioned RWA tokens (e.g. USYC).
actions.how: Mint: rwa.approve(DaoCollateral 0xde6e1F680C4816446C8D515989E2358636A38b04, amt); DaoCollateral.swap(rwa, amt, minUsd0Out). Redeem: DaoCollateral.redeem(rwa, usd0Amount, minRwaOut); fee = redeemFee() bps.

actions.name: lock USD0 into bUSD0
actions.description: Get bUSD0 (daily USUAL rewards) plus rt-bUSD0, 1:1 with USD0.
actions.how: USD0.approve(bUSD0 0x35D8949372D46B7a3D5A56006AE77B215fc69bC0, amt); bUSD0.mint(amt). The docs note bUSD0 may be cheaper on Curve when it trades below par.

actions.name: exit bUSD0 early
actions.description: Three on-chain exits before 11 June 2028.
actions.how: At par with rt-bUSD0: bUSD0.reconstruct(amount, recipient) (needs equal rt-bUSD0). At the floor: bUSD0.unlockUsd0ppFloorPrice(amount) for amount * getFloorPrice()/1e18 USD0. Or sell on a DEX. After maturity: bUSD0.unwrap().

actions.name: save USD0 in sUSD0
actions.description: Earn T-bill yield on USD0 in an ERC-4626 vault, no lockup.
actions.how: USD0.approve(sUSD0 0xd861bE82dEe3223CFBEd160791f6550b0704D406, amt); sUSD0.deposit(amt, receiver). Exit with sUSD0.redeem(shares, receiver, owner) (withdrawFeeBps applies).

actions.name: stake USUAL
actions.description: Stake USUAL in USUALx; optionally lock USUALx for boosted rewards.
actions.how: USUAL.approve(USUALx 0x06B964d96f5dCF7Eae9d7C559B09EDCe244d4B8E, amt); USUALx.deposit(amt, receiver). To lock: USUALx.approve(Lockup 0x85B6F9BDdb10c6B320d07416a250F984f0F0E9ED, shares); Lockup.lock(receiver, shares, 2628000 * months).

risks: Minting USD0 directly needs a permissioned RWA token (e.g. USYC by Hashnote/Circle), which requires KYC with its issuer. Retail users reach USD0 through the SwapperEngine order book (minimum order size) or DEXs; secondary prices can deviate from $1.

bUSD0 is a bond: the USD0 inside is locked until 11 June 2028. Early exit at par needs an equal amount of rt-bUSD0; without it the protocol only pays the DAO floor price (0.92 USD0 on 2026-11-25) or you sell at market. bUSD0 has traded well below $1: in January 2025 a change to the then-USD0++ early-exit rules (floor redemption) was followed by a drop to roughly $0.89-0.92 (press reports, e.g. The Block; not on a current official page).
USUALx charges a withdrawal fee on unstaking (10% on-chain on 2026-11-25; the docs say a 10% fee may apply). sUSD0 charges 3 bps.

Admin powers: all core contracts are upgradeable transparent proxies; role holders can pause tokens, DaoCollateral and the SwapperEngine, blacklist addresses (USD0, bUSD0, USUAL, sUSD0, USUALx), change the redemption fee (capped by MAX_REDEEM_FEE) and the bUSD0 floor price, and turn on the Counter Bank Run mechanism, which cuts the RWA paid out on redemptions.
USD0 backing is off-chain-issued tokenized T-bills (USYC, M by M0, USDtb, USDC wrappers, etc.), so holders carry the issuers' custody and redemption risk.
USUAL rewards for bUSD0 are claimed with Merkle proofs produced by Usual off-chain; there is no documented public API for the proofs.

Audits listed by Usual: Cantina/Spearbit (May and Nov 2024), a Cantina public competition (June 2024), Paladin (L2 tokens and OFT adapters, Oct 2024), Halborn and Sherlock (V1, Nov 2024); DefiLlama also links a Hexens bUSD0 review (Nov 2025).
notes: All addresses are from Usual's official Contract Deployments page (tech.usual.money); every one has code on its chain and is an EIP-1967 proxy whose implementation is verified on Sourcify, where the signatures were taken. On-chain values (fees, floor price, maturity, minimum order) were read on 2026-11-25. Left out on purpose: USD0a, EUR0 (+ sEUR0) and ETH0, which are separate Usual stablecoins with their own DaoCollateral/SwapperEngine (listed on the same page); TAC-chain deployments (no RPC check done); registry, token-mapping, oracle, treasury and bridge adapter contracts (LayerZero OFT adapters and CCIP pools are listed on the same page); USUALS/USUALSP and the airdrop contracts (legacy); the documented USD0RewardsClaim contract, because the Revenue Distribution Module currently points its reward-claim buckets at a different, undocumented contract; and the usUSDS++ investment vault. Arbitrum also has a bUSD0 bridge; Base and BNB use Chainlink CCIP for USD0 and USUAL. DefiLlama lists Ethereum only, which is where all mint/redeem/bond logic lives.

name: Yield Basis
description: Curve-team protocol on Ethereum that gives BTC/ETH LPs (WBTC, cbBTC, tBTC, WETH) a 2x-leveraged Curve crvUSD-pool position designed to cancel impermanent loss. Agents deposit the asset into a market's LT to get yb-LP shares (yb-WBTC, yb-cbBTC, yb-tBTC, yb-WETH), withdraw, optionally stake shares in the gauge for YB emissions, lock YB as veYB, vote gauges and claim veYB fees.

keyFunctions.description: Number of deployed markets (11 on 2026-11-25: indexes 0-10; 7-10 active, 0-6 deprecated).

Market struct (asset_token, cryptopool, amm (LEVAMM), lt (yb-LP token / vault), price_oracle, virtual_pool, staker (gauge)). Onchain state does not flag deprecated markets; compare with the contract-addresses page.
Curve Emergency DAO multisig that can kill/revive a market.
FeeSplitter that receives LT admin fees.

keyFunctions.description: Deposit WBTC and mint yb-WBTC shares. Pool policy: YBTwocryptoPolicy (use the price rule: debt = assets * pool.price_oracle() // 10**8). Pool = 0x313698667d7FDD6789a9BC70821309ff891E729A, LEVAMM = 0x7b9817eb5C49A99875138A5d52bF64a8B2cFFFFE. contracts.name: yb-tBTC (LT, market 9: tBTC, 2x leveraged tBTC/crvUSD Curve LP)

keyFunctions.description: Deposit tBTC and mint yb-tBTC shares. Args (assets in raw tBTC units, 18 decimals; debt = crvUSD the LEVAMM borrows, raw 18-decimal units; min_shares (18 decimals) slippage floor; receiver). Approve tBTC (0x18084fbA666a33d37592fA2633fD49a74DD93a88) to this LT first. Not ERC-4626 despite the event names. Pool policy: YBTwocryptoPolicy (use the price rule: debt = assets * pool.price_oracle() // 10**18). Pool = 0x4F52C3a81E33521e5a9A47FD9D3BE475D2279c2e, LEVAMM = 0x0e357Af536592F275C6Aa07b8AC2CA6EB3d0cF5a. Reverts 'Debt too high' when the deposit would exceed the market cap (AMM.max_debt()/2), 'Deposit to staker' if receiver is the gauge (use StakeZap to deposit+stake). Simulate before sending.
Expected shares for (assets, debt). Does not run the LT deviation check; reverts 'Debt too high' over the cap.

Burn shares and receive tBTC: (shares, min_assets in raw tBTC units, receiver). Unstake from the gauge first (reverts 'Withdraw to/from staker'). Give a gas margin (reverts 'GAS' if the gauge checkpoint retry lacks 200k gas). If the market is killed: 'We're dead. Use emergency_withdraw'.
Redemption Value: tBTC (raw units) you would get now for a share amount, including the Temporary Redemption Discount (TRD). Use it to set min_assets.

Fundamental Value of one share in tBTC, scaled to 18 decimals regardless of asset decimals (oracle-based; excludes TRD and is not an upper bound). TRD = preview_withdraw(1e18) * 10**(18-18) / pricePerShare() - 1.

Exit when the market is killed or its oracle reverts: (shares, receiver, owner). Returns (asset_out, stables_to_return int256); if negative you must pay that much crvUSD, so approve crvUSD (0xf939E0A03FB07F59A73314E73794Be0E57ac1b4E) to this LT first. No slippage parameter.
Quote (asset_received, stables_to_return) for emergency_withdraw.
True if the market is killed (then only emergency_withdraw works).
yb-tBTC share balance (18 decimals). Staked shares sit in the gauge and are not counted here.
ERC-20 approve, e.g. let the gauge pull shares before staking.

Stake yb-tBTC: (LT shares, receiver); mints gauge shares (ERC-4626 style). Approve this gauge on the LT first. Staked positions earn YB emissions instead of Fundamental Value growth and carry watermark risk.
Unstake an exact amount of LT shares: (assets, receiver, owner).
Unstake by gauge shares: (shares, receiver, owner); returns LT shares.
Claim rewards: (reward token, user). Use YB 0x01791F726B4103694969820be083196cC7c045fF for emissions; claim() with no args claims YB for msg.sender.
Claimable amount of a reward token for a user (raw units).
LT shares for a gauge-share amount (includes the pending staker rebase; can be below 1:1).
LT shares a redeem would return.
Gauge share balance (18 decimals).

Pool = 0x656341Ef90b622c6634e0573772FfB7f3669b9f3, LEVAMM = 0x5f8D24F33Cc5a1D5D1bf012261E6A2214C92233c. Unstake an exact amount of LT shares: (assets, receiver, owner).
Unstake by gauge shares: (shares, receiver, owner); returns LT shares.
Claim rewards: (reward token, user). Use YB 0x01791F726B4103694969820be083196cC7c045fF for emissions; claim() with no args claims YB for msg.sender.

Deposit and stake in one tx: (gauge, assets, debt, min_shares (LT shares, not gauge shares), receiver). Approve the asset to the zap. debt follows the same pool-policy rule as LT.deposit. Returns gauge shares.
Unstake and withdraw in one tx: (gauge, gauge shares, min_assets (raw asset units), receiver). Approve the gauge shares to the zap first. Returns asset amount.
YB balance (18 decimals). Max supply 1,000,000,000 YB; minted only via GaugeController emissions.
Approve veYB (VotingEscrow) before create_lock / increase_amount.
ERC-20 transfer.
Lock YB: (amount raw 18-dec, unlock unix time). Unlock time is rounded down to a week and must be <= now + 4 years. Approve YB first. Mints a veYB NFT; one lock per address.
Add YB to an existing, unexpired lock (two-arg form increase_amount(uint256,address) adds to another address's lock).
Extend the unlock time (rounded down to a week, max 4 years ahead).
Toggle permalock (no decay). Turning it off requires no active gauge votes and restarts a 4-year decay.
Withdraw all YB after the lock expired (permalocks must be toggled off first).
Current voting power (18 decimals); decays linearly to the unlock time. balanceOf() is the NFT count, not voting power.
(amount, end) of an address's lock.
Vote YB emissions to gauges with your veYB: (gauges, weights in basis points, total <= 10000). Max 50 gauges; at most once per gauge every 10 days; lock must not be expired.
Share of emissions a gauge gets (1e18 = 100%).
Raw gauge weight.
Number of gauges; gauges(i) lists them.
YB a gauge will have received by a timestamp (18 decimals).
Claim weekly admin fees (paid as yb-LP tokens) for veYB: (receiver, epoch_count (max 50 per call, default 50), use_vest false for normal users). claim() with no args claims for msg.sender.
Tokens and amounts a claim would pay; marked non-view in the ABI, call it with eth_call.
Anyone: spread newly received fees over the next 4 weekly epochs.

actions.name: find-market
actions.description: Get a market's contracts
actions.how: Factory.markets(i) for i in 7..10 (active) -> (asset, cryptopool, amm, lt, price_oracle, virtual_pool, staker). Check LT.is_killed() == false.

actions.name: deposit
actions.description: Deposit BTC/ETH asset for yb-LP
actions.how: 1) Read pool.POLICY(); compute debt with the price rule (assets * pool.price_oracle() // 10**asset_decimals) on YBTwocryptoPolicy pools (WBTC, cbBTC, tBTC), or with the LEVAMM-book rule on the WETH pool (live YBOraclizedPolicy). 2) expected = LT.preview_deposit(assets, debt); min_shares = expected * (1 - tolerance). 3) asset.approve(LT, assets). 4) Simulate then send LT.deposit(assets, debt, min_shares, receiver).

actions.name: withdraw
actions.description: Redeem yb-LP for the asset
actions.how: If staked, unstake first (gauge.redeem or StakeZap.withdraw_and_unstake). expected = LT.preview_withdraw(shares); compare with pricePerShare to see the TRD; LT.withdraw(shares, expected * (1 - tolerance), receiver) with a gas margin.

actions.name: deposit-and-stake
actions.description: Deposit and stake for YB emissions in one tx
actions.how: asset.approve(StakeZap, assets); StakeZap.deposit_and_stake(gauge, assets, debt, min_shares, receiver).

actions.name: stake
actions.description: Stake existing yb-LP
actions.how: LT.approve(gauge, amount); gauge.deposit(amount, receiver).

actions.name: claim-yb
actions.description: Claim YB emissions
actions.how: gauge.claim(YB, user) or gauge.claim(); preview with gauge.preview_claim(YB, user).

actions.name: lock-yb
actions.description: Lock YB for veYB
actions.how: YB.approve(veYB, amount); veYB.create_lock(amount, unlockTime <= now + 4y). Then GaugeController.vote_for_gauge_weights([gauges],[bps]) and FeeDistributor.claim() weekly.

risks: Leverage: each market holds a 2x-leveraged Curve LP position funded by pooled crvUSD debt (target ~50% debt). Arbitrage keeps it on target; in fast markets or gas spikes leverage can drift. Borrow rate is set by the DAO per market (up to 100%/yr).
Withdrawals can realise a Temporary Redemption Discount (TRD): preview_withdraw can be below pricePerShare for hours to weeks; always set min_assets from preview_withdraw.

Caps: deposits revert 'Debt too high' when a market's LEVAMM would exceed AMM.max_debt()/2 (limited by crvUSD allocation); deposits can also revert 'Unsafe min/max' or 'LT deviation' (WETH oracle-report pool).

Staked positions give up Fundamental Value growth for YB emissions and have a watermark: after losses staked shares can redeem below the deposit until gains close the gap. YB price and gauge weight drive the return.

Kill switch: Factory admin or the Curve Emergency DAO can kill a market; then only emergency_withdraw works and you may have to repay part of the debt in crvUSD from your wallet. If the oracle reverts while not killed, staked holders cannot unstake.

Dependencies: Curve Twocrypto pools, crvUSD (depeg risk), the crvUSD price aggregator, Pyth price reports on the WETH pool's YBOraclizedPolicy, and the wrapped-asset issuers (WBTC/cbBTC custodians, tBTC bridge).

New protocol (live since about September 2025: YB vesting starts 15 Sep 2025 and DefiLlama listed it on 2025-09-25; markets 0-6 are already deprecated and replaced). Core contracts are immutable (not upgradeable). Audits: Statemind, ChainSecurity, Quantstamp, Electisec, Pashov, MixBytes (DAO, Hybrid Vaults), Firepan AI (FeeDistributor), Sherlock contest; audits do not remove all risk.
veYB locks are up to 4 years (or permanent) and cannot be withdrawn early.
notes: All addresses from the official contract-addresses page (docs.yieldbasis.com/user/reference/contract-addresses) and cross-checked onchain: Factory.markets(7..10) return exactly the listed LTs and gauges, and each LT.staker() is the listed gauge. Function signatures from the official yb-core GitHub source (Vyper) and the dev docs; Vyper default arguments also create shorter overloads (e.g. deposit(uint256,uint256,uint256), withdraw(uint256,uint256), claim()). Only active markets 7-10 are listed; deprecated markets 0-6 (old yb-WBTC/yb-cbBTC/yb-tBTC/yb-WETH tokens) are on the same page under 'Deprecated markets' — move positions with LTMigrator 0xd5b450fDD5aF5341436Fc37A46BBEc39CA8F92CB. 'ybBTC' is a marketing name; the onchain share tokens are yb-WBTC, yb-cbBTC and yb-tBTC (I found no separate ybBTC token address in the docs; the ybBTC docs page linked from llms.txt returns 404). Left out on purpose: LEVAMM, VirtualPool, LP oracles, pool policies, Hybrid Vaults (HybridVaultFactory 0xBdC32268851C324c6185809271dfe6d8dab8dC5b, crvUSD-backed vaults across up to 16 markets), net-pressure and lending-oracle contracts, vesting escrows and the Aragon DAO — all on the contract-addresses page. YB LPs and pools trade on Curve; use Curve for YB swaps.
